从这么小的种子能长出那么巨大的树，真是神奇。.en: It's amazing that such a huge tree can grow from such a small seed.

她二十岁就在世界大赛上夺冠，真是了不起。.en: She won the world championship at twenty, that's really impressive.

这次的研究成果预计将对学术界产生重大影响。.en: The results of this research are expected to have a significant impact on the academic community.

那位艺人唱歌很好，演技也很好。.en: That celebrity sings well and also acts well.

最近这位艺人在年轻人中很有人气。.en: Recently, this celebrity is very popular among young people.

是说，说的是（再次确认所听到的内容）.en: You mean, you're saying (to confirm something you heard)

你说昨天看了那部电影？是说真的很有趣吗？.en: You said you watched that movie yesterday? You mean it was really interesting?

你是说明天有考试？都准备好了吗？.en: You mean there's an exam tomorrow? Are you all prepared?

科长今天在会议上表扬了我们团队的成果。.en: The section chief praised our team's results at the meeting today.

科长，麻烦您在这份文件上签个字。.en: Section chief, could you please sign this document?

多亏老师细心的指导，我的韩语水平提高了很多。.en: Thanks to the teacher's careful guidance, my Korean level has improved a lot.

多亏朋友的帮助，搬家的问题轻松解决了。.en: Thanks to my friend's help, the moving problem was easily solved.

这次会议决定以与往年不同的方式进行。.en: This meeting decided to proceed in a different way from previous years.

韩国的传统婚礼真是独特而美丽的仪式。.en: Korean traditional weddings are truly unique and beautiful ceremonies.

那一脚射门非常可惜地擦着门柱偏出。.en: That shot just barely missed the post, which was really unfortunate.

刚练好的技术，还没在比赛中用上就结束了，真可惜。.en: I just practiced that skill, but it ended before I could use it in the game. What a shame.

现在正在准备重要的发表资料，所以不方便接电话。.en: I'm currently preparing important presentation materials, so I can't answer the phone.

他们正在为下周的音乐会准备合奏练习。.en: They are practicing ensemble for next week's concert.

排队时一定要遵守顺序，才不会给别人带来不便。.en: When lining up, you must follow the order so as not to inconvenience others.

看这本书的目录，就能一眼了解各章的主要内容。.en: Looking at the table of contents of this book, you can see the main points of each chapter at a glance.

为了准备考试，你辛苦了。.en: You worked hard preparing for the exam.

辛苦没有白费，我合格了。.en: The hard work paid off — I passed.

考试中犯了错，分数很低。.en: I made a mistake on the exam, so my score was low.

入学教育时我们听了关于学校设施和主要规则的说明。.en: During orientation, we listened to an explanation about school facilities and main rules.

在入学教育期间，我结识了很多同专业的同学。.en: During orientation, I made many friends from the same major.

在新生说明会上听取了关于学校设施和规则的说明。.en: At the freshman orientation, I listened to an explanation about school facilities and rules.

他虽然是新生，但实力不亚于前辈们。.en: Although he is a freshman, his skills are no less than those of his seniors.

好久不见；久违.en: Long time no see; it's been a while

哇，真是好久不见！好像是大学毕业之后第一次见面。.en: Wow, it's really been a long time! I think it's the first time we've met since college graduation.

尝了一口这个食物，是久违的家乡味道。.en: I took a bite of this food, and it was the taste of home after a long time.

他手巧得很，即使没有魔术道具也能自如地表演纸牌魔术。.en: He is so dexterous that even without magic props, he can freely perform card tricks.

小时候被电视上看到的魔术迷住，如今已成为职业魔术师。.en: Fascinated by magic seen on TV as a child, he has now become a professional magician.

这个故事请作为我们俩的秘密。.en: Please keep this story as a secret between the two of us.

他算是很能保守秘密的人。.en: He's pretty good at keeping secrets.

别再吵了，就此和好怎么样？.en: Stop arguing, how about we just make up now?

他太累了，想就此放下工作回家。.en: He's too tired, he wants to just drop work and go home.

感冒的时候喝一杯热生姜茶，喉咙会舒服很多。.en: When you have a cold, drinking a cup of hot ginger tea makes your throat feel much better.

奶奶每天早上煮生姜茶，全家人一起喝。.en: Grandma makes ginger tea every morning, and the whole family drinks it together.

把钱包落下了，该怎么回家呢，怎么办？.en: I left my wallet behind, how do I get home? What should I do?

考试就在眼前了，却一点准备都没有。该怎么办才好呢？.en: The exam is right around the corner, but I haven't prepared at all. What should I do?

偶然发现了小时候写的日记本，因为太害羞脸都红了。.en: I accidentally found my childhood diary, and I blushed because I was so embarrassed.

她每天睡前都有在日记本上整理一天的习惯。.en: She has a habit of writing in her diary every night before bed to organize her day.

我们是从小一起长大的关系，彼此像家人一样亲近。.en: We grew up together, so we're as close as family.

他们表面上看起来很要好，但实际上据说经常吵架。.en: They seem close on the surface, but apparently they often argue.

做错；做得不好.en: to do wrong; to do poorly

如果这个项目中有我做错的部分，我会坦诚承认。.en: If there's something I did wrong in this project, I'll honestly admit it.

他开错了车，迷路了好一阵子才终于到达。.en: He took the wrong car and got lost for a while before finally arriving.

从远处看很平凡，但走近了才知道是件非常精致的雕刻品。.en: From a distance it looks ordinary, but up close you can see it's a very delicate carving.

她即使从远处看到他的走路姿势，也立刻认出他是谁。.en: Even from a distance, she immediately recognized him by the way he walks.

对于犯错的事情，我真心道歉了。.en: I sincerely apologized for the mistake I made.

为迟到而先道歉是礼貌。.en: It's polite to apologize first for being late.

坦诚地表达自己的感情是维持健康关系的秘诀。.en: Honestly expressing your feelings is the key to maintaining a healthy relationship.

这首诗以非常独特的方式表达了爱情的痛苦，令人印象深刻。.en: This poem expresses the pain of love in a very unique way, leaving a strong impression.

从昨天开始一直在下雨。.en: It has been raining continuously since yesterday.

如果一直学习，韩语实力会提高的。.en: If you keep studying, your Korean skills will improve.

他的行为总是有一贯性，值得信赖。.en: His behavior is always consistent and trustworthy.

很多时候，比起言语，用行动来展示更为有效。.en: Many times, showing through actions is more effective than words.

韩语和日语在语法结构上显示出相当大的差异。.en: Korean and Japanese show considerable differences in grammatical structure.

两个产品的价格差异很大，但性能几乎没有差别。.en: The price difference between the two products is large, but there is almost no difference in performance.

明天去郊游的准备物品都带齐了吗？.en: Did you bring all the items to prepare for tomorrow's picnic?

请把美术课需要的准备物品放进包里。.en: Please put the items needed for art class into your bag.

每次吃妈妈给我装的盒饭，都会想起家乡。.en: Every time I eat the lunchbox my mom packs for me, I think of home.

去郊游的前一天晚上，我一个人精心地把紫菜包饭和小菜装进盒饭里。.en: The night before the picnic, I carefully packed kimbap and side dishes into the lunchbox by myself.

全体学生中只有一半通过了考试。.en: Only half of all the students passed the exam.

这张照片是我们全家人一起拍的。.en: This photo was taken with my whole family.

怕孩子们饿，准备了饼干和牛奶当零食。.en: Afraid the kids would get hungry, I prepared cookies and milk as snacks.

学习时饿了的话，吃坚果当零食比较好。.en: If you get hungry while studying, it's better to eat nuts as a snack.

真正的友情是相互理解，在困难时刻给予对方力量。.en: True friendship is understanding each other and giving strength in difficult times.

即使时光流逝也不变的友情，才是人生中最宝贵的财富。.en: A friendship that doesn't change even as time passes is the most precious treasure in life.

如果有其他疑问请提问。.en: If you have any other questions, please ask.

除此之外没有其他费用了。.en: There are no other fees besides this.

学校公告栏上贴有社团招募通知。.en: A club recruitment notice is posted on the school bulletin board.

课程相关资料可以在网上公告栏下载。.en: Course-related materials can be downloaded from the online bulletin board.

A: 喝咖啡吗？ B: 什么都行，没关系。.en: A: Would you like some coffee? B: Anything is fine, no problem.

天气不好，但对我们的计划没关系。.en: The weather is bad, but it doesn't matter for our plans.

不管怎样；再怎么.en: no matter what; no matter how

不管多忙，都不会忘记每天至少联系家人一次。.en: No matter how busy I am, I never forget to contact my family at least once a day.

再怎么努力结果也没有改善，他最终还是放弃了。.en: No matter how hard he tried, the results didn't improve, so he eventually gave up.

拿到成绩单的日子总是很紧张，但这个学期他很有信心。.en: The day you get your report card is always nerve-wracking, but this semester he is confident.

妈妈看了我的成绩单叹了口气，让我更加努力。.en: My mom looked at my report card and sighed, telling me to try harder.

因为独自出国的女儿，母亲每晚都失眠担心。.en: Because of her daughter who went abroad alone, the mother couldn't sleep at night from worry.

与其过早担心，不如先做能做的事情。.en: Rather than worrying too early, it's better to do what you can first.

经过无数争论，最终那个提案被否决了。.en: After countless arguments, the proposal was ultimately rejected.

再怎么努力，最终还是因为时间不够没能完成项目。.en: No matter how hard I tried, in the end I couldn't finish the project because of lack of time.

在韩国，从长辈手中接东西时用双手接是基本礼仪。.en: In Korea, it's basic etiquette to use both hands when receiving something from an elder.

他懂礼貌且语气温和，所以深受大家喜欢。.en: He is polite and gentle in tone, so everyone likes him a lot.

班主任今天和全班所有学生都进行了面谈。.en: The homeroom teacher had a one-on-one meeting with every student in the class today.

我们的班主任总是早早来到教室迎接学生。.en: Our homeroom teacher always comes to class early to greet the students.

上课时一定要记下重要内容，这样以后复习时才有帮助。.en: You must write down important content during class so it helps when you review later.

他努力不漏掉任何讲座内容做笔记，但手太疼了。.en: He tried to take notes without missing any lecture content, but his hand hurt too much.

他的实力属于世界顶级水平，这一点已经毫无争议、非常分明。.en: His skill level is world-class, and that is already beyond dispute and very clear.

虽然那件事的原因并不明确，但结果上确实给团队氛围带来了负面影响。.en: Although the reason for that incident is not clear, it did negatively affect the team atmosphere.

刚才那辆公交车路过了我们家门前。.en: That bus just passed by our house.

走路路过时偶然遇到了朋友。.en: I happened to run into a friend while walking by.

我用父母每月给的零花钱买书和零食。.en: I use the monthly allowance my parents give me to buy books and snacks.

最近物价上涨，很多学生觉得零花钱不够用。.en: Recently, prices have gone up, so many students feel their allowance isn't enough.

动物园里的长颈鹿伸长脖子吃树叶的样子令人印象深刻。.en: The giraffe in the zoo stretching its neck to eat leaves was impressive.

长颈鹿个子太高，与其低头吃草，不如主要吃高处的树叶。.en: Giraffes are so tall that instead of bending down to eat grass, they mainly eat leaves from high up.

他是一个在任何情况下都正直行事的人，值得信赖。.en: He is someone who acts uprightly in any situation and is trustworthy.

诚实的回答有时可能会让人不舒服，但从长远来看是最好的选择。.en: An honest answer can sometimes be uncomfortable, but in the long run it's the best choice.

婴儿的脸胖乎乎的，可爱得让人想摸一摸。.en: The baby's face is so chubby and cute that you want to touch it.

她比以前胖了，脸变得圆润，但看起来更健康了。.en: She's gained weight and her face has become rounder, but she looks healthier.

天气变了很多呢。.en: The weather has changed a lot, hasn't it?

城市的风景在十年间完全变了，找不到以前的模样了。.en: The city's scenery completely changed in ten years, and I couldn't find its former appearance.

人心容易变化，所以维持关系需要努力。.en: People's hearts change easily, so maintaining relationships takes effort.

路两边樱花盛开，形成了壮观的景象。.en: Cherry blossoms are in full bloom on both sides of the road, creating a spectacular scene.

要想谈判成功，必须尊重双方的立场。.en: To succeed in negotiations, you must respect the positions of both sides.

坚持运动后，我感觉到健康在逐渐变好。.en: After consistently exercising, I feel my health gradually getting better.

两人解开误会后，关系好多了。.en: After the two cleared up the misunderstanding, their relationship got much better.

发生紧急情况时，请立即联系管理办公室。.en: In case of an emergency, please contact the management office immediately.

将食物带入客房时，应注意不要产生气味。.en: When bringing food into the guest room, be careful not to create odors.

父母只希望子女不生病，幸福地生活。.en: Parents only hope that their children live happily without getting sick.

我殷切希望这次项目能成功结束。.en: I sincerely hope this project ends successfully.

以前这个小区是安静的乡村，现在开发了很多。.en: This neighborhood used to be a quiet countryside, but now it's been heavily developed.

偶然遇到了以前的朋友，一起聊了大学时期的故事。.en: I ran into an old friend by chance and we talked about our college days.

总统今天召开紧急记者会，发表了经济政策。.en: The president held an emergency press conference today and announced economic policies.

国民期待新总统能带来更美好的未来。.en: The public expects the new president to bring a better future.

第一次独自出国时我很害怕，但现在有了自信。.en: I was very scared when I went abroad alone for the first time, but now I have confidence.

他胆子小，晚上不敢一个人走路。.en: He is timid and doesn't dare to walk alone at night.

朋友说要去旅行，我真的很羡慕。.en: My friend said she's going on a trip, and I'm really envious.

我太羡慕她的厨艺了。.en: I'm so envious of her cooking skills.

我对那部电影的结局太好奇了，忍不了。.en: I'm too curious about the ending of that movie, I can't stand it.

我很好奇那个朋友最近过得怎么样，就联系了一下。.en: I was curious about how that friend was doing lately, so I reached out.

人生短暂，所以应该努力无悔地活着。.en: Life is short, so we should live without regrets.

他退休后开始深入思考人生的意义。.en: After retiring, he began to think deeply about the meaning of life.

如果不集中精神，很容易犯错，所以要小心。.en: If you don't concentrate, it's easy to make mistakes, so be careful.

他在困难的情况下也打起精神，没有放弃。.en: He kept his spirits up even in difficult circumstances and didn't give up.

他拿出一张信纸，开始慢慢地读。.en: He took out a sheet of letter paper and began to read slowly.

抽屉里静静地放着两张照片。.en: Two photos were quietly lying in the drawer.

那位记者亲自到现场采访，传达了生动的新闻。.en: That reporter went to the scene in person to interview and delivered vivid news.

记者招待会上，许多记者涌来，接连提问。.en: At the press conference, many reporters flocked in and asked questions one after another.

那位足球选手伤愈复出，重新站上了球场。.en: That soccer player returned after recovering from injury and stepped back onto the field.

参加奥运会的选手们都拥有最顶尖的实力。.en: The athletes participating in the Olympics all have top-tier skills.

老朋友之间有一种不用言说也能心意相通的感情。.en: Between old friends, there is a feeling that can be understood without words.

她离开故乡时，对多年来积累的感情感到非常不舍。.en: When she left her hometown, she felt very reluctant to part with the feelings she had built up over the years.

他很认生，在初次见面的人面前不太会说话。.en: He is very shy and doesn't talk much in front of people he meets for the first time.

时隔许久见到朋友，他的脸和以前不一样了，我一时有些慌张。.en: After not seeing my friend for a long time, his face looked different from before, and I was a bit flustered for a moment.

每个人的想法可以以不同的方式表达。.en: Everyone's thoughts can be expressed in different ways.

这个问题和之前见过的不同，复杂得多。.en: This problem is different from the one I saw before; it's much more complicated.

剩；遗留.en: to remain; to be left over

食物剩下很多。.en: A lot of food is left over.

希望钱能剩下一些。.en: I hope some money will be left over.

明明锁了门，是谁打开的呢？.en: I clearly locked the door, so who opened it?

他分明知道约定时间。.en: He clearly knows the appointment time.

这次项目被取消是无可奈何的事情。.en: It's unavoidable that this project got canceled.

既然他那样决定了，我也只能无可奈何地接受。.en: Since he decided that way, I have no choice but to accept it.

大多数当地居民积极参与了反对建厂的运动。.en: Most local residents actively participated in the movement against building the factory.

政府决定为污染地区的居民提供免费健康检查。.en: The government decided to provide free health checkups for residents of the polluted area.

打开收音机听了早间新闻。.en: I turned on the radio and listened to the morning news.

把门把手往左拧，门就会打开。.en: If you turn the doorknob to the left, the door will open.

长时间电脑工作时，每隔50分钟休息10分钟对眼睛健康有益。.en: When working on a computer for a long time, taking a 10-minute break every 50 minutes is good for eye health.

为了彻底休息，他关掉所有电子设备，去了安静的山区民宿。.en: To rest completely, he turned off all electronic devices and went to a quiet mountain guesthouse.

她的微笑太甜蜜了，让所有人都心情变好了。.en: Her smile was so sweet that it made everyone feel better.

这道甜点甜而不腻，很受欢迎。.en: This dessert is sweet but not cloying, so it's very popular.

肝脏不好的话，最好避免油腻的食物。.en: If your liver is bad, it's best to avoid greasy food.

这汤咸淡正好，真好吃。.en: This soup has just the right amount of saltiness, it's really delicious.

他经常开玩笑，让气氛变得轻松。.en: He often jokes, making the atmosphere relaxed.

虽然像是在开玩笑，但其实是真心的。.en: Even though it seems like a joke, it's actually sincere.

安心，放心.en: to be relieved, to feel at ease

考试结果很好，现在才放心了。.en: The exam results were good, so now I feel relieved.

听到孩子安全到达的消息，大家都安心了。.en: Hearing that the child arrived safely, everyone felt relieved.

为了安全，请始终系好安全带。.en: For safety, please always fasten your seatbelt.

这个地区晚上也很安全，可以独自出行。.en: This area is safe even at night, so you can go out alone.

出口处贴着醒目的紧急出口标志。.en: A conspicuous emergency exit sign is posted at the exit.

请在地图上标出我们要去的地方。.en: Please mark on the map where we are going.

古埃及的金字塔至今仍藏着许多谜团。.en: The pyramids of ancient Egypt still hold many mysteries.

古希腊哲学对现代思想产生了巨大影响。.en: Ancient Greek philosophy had a huge influence on modern thought.

孩子们说，用智能手机照向星座就会显示该星座信息的增强现实应用程序真的很神奇。.en: The kids said the augmented reality app that shows constellation information when you point your smartphone at the stars is really amazing.

数千年前制作的文物竟能以如此完美的状态保存下来，真是令人称奇。.en: It's amazing that artifacts made thousands of years ago have been preserved in such perfect condition.

那部电影相当有趣，我看了两遍。.en: That movie was quite interesting, I watched it twice.

这个包相当贵，但质量很好。.en: This bag is quite expensive, but the quality is good.

最近比起博客，通过YouTube找信息的人变多了。.en: These days, more people look for information through YouTube rather than blogs.

她运营着一个旅行博客，分享世界各国的故事。.en: She runs a travel blog, sharing stories from around the world.

这个网站上可以免费听课。.en: You can take classes for free on this website.

只有在官方网站上才能购买正品。.en: You can only buy genuine products on the official website.

经过努力学习，终于获得了奖学金。.en: After studying hard, I finally obtained a scholarship.

通过那次经历，我得到了很多教训。.en: Through that experience, I got a lot of lessons.

整理房间后，感觉心情也跟着整理好了。.en: After tidying up the room, I felt like my mind was also organized.

整理了一下这个月的支出，发现比想象中花得多。.en: I organized this month's expenses and found I spent more than I thought.

古代人相信自然现象是神的意志。.en: Ancient people believed that natural phenomena were the will of the gods.

他不信神，但努力过有道德的生活。.en: He doesn't believe in God, but tries to live a moral life.

希望新的一年里健康与幸福相伴的福气降临。.en: I hope the blessing of health and happiness comes in the new year.

今天运气好，等公交车马上就坐上了。.en: I was lucky today — I got on the bus right away.

老实说，那部电影没有我期待的那么有趣。.en: To be honest, that movie wasn't as interesting as I expected.

我老实想听听你的意见，别隐瞒，告诉我吧。.en: I honestly want to hear your opinion, so don't hide it and tell me.

他在三个女儿中尤其疼爱老幺女儿。.en: He especially dotes on his youngest daughter among his three daughters.

老幺女儿结婚后，父母经历了空巢综合征。.en: After the youngest daughter got married, the parents experienced empty nest syndrome.

他从一个小摊车起步，现在做着大生意。.en: He started from a small cart and now runs a big business.

最近经济不景气，生意不好做。.en: Business is tough these days because the economy is bad.

在忙碌的日常中，寻找小小的幸福也很重要。.en: In the midst of a busy daily life, it's also important to find small happiness.

他在社交媒体上坦诚分享自己的日常，粉丝们很喜欢。.en: He openly shares his daily life on social media, and his fans love it.

他在博物馆购入了一台朝鲜时代的陶瓷器。.en: He purchased a piece of Joseon-era pottery at the museum.

一辆出租车突然变道，差点酿成事故。.en: A taxi suddenly changed lanes and almost caused an accident.

钱包里硬币太多太重，所以每次坐公交都用交通卡。.en: The coins in my wallet are too heavy, so I always use a transit card when taking the bus.

他连掉在地上的一枚硬币也不会无视，捡起来放进了慈善箱里。.en: He doesn't ignore even a single coin that falls on the ground; he picks it up and puts it in a charity box.

韩国没有10万韩元的纸币，最大面额是5万韩元。.en: There is no 100,000 won banknote in Korea; the largest denomination is 50,000 won.

把钱包里的纸币都拿出来数了数，才只有一万韩元。.en: I took out all the bills from my wallet and counted them, but there was only 10,000 won.

那位哲学家的思想非常深奥，仅仅阅读很难理解。.en: That philosopher's thoughts are very profound; it's hard to understand just by reading.

他们经过漫长的岁月，彼此建立了深厚的信任。.en: Over a long period of time, they built a deep trust with each other.

求求你住手吧。我再也忍不下去了。.en: Please stop. I can't take it anymore.

拜托帮帮我，让我能通过考试吧。.en: Please help me so I can pass the exam.

洞穴里一片漆黑，阳光完全照不进来。.en: The cave was pitch black, and no sunlight came in at all.

云层终于散开，温暖的阳光开始照耀大地。.en: The clouds finally cleared, and warm sunlight began to shine on the earth.

对于小孩子来说，世间万物都充满了神奇，无异于一本满是学习内容的教科书。.en: For a child, everything in the world is full of wonder, like a textbook full of things to learn.

像小孩子一样用纯真的心去观察艺术，就能获得新的灵感。.en: If you observe art with a pure heart like a child, you can gain new inspiration.

最近在餐厅里自助取餐的方式正变得越来越普遍。.en: Recently, the self-service way of getting food at restaurants is becoming more and more common.

这家咖啡馆是自助服务，所以饮料要自己制作，杯子也要自己整理。.en: This café is self-service, so you have to make your own drinks and clean up your own cups.

那家餐厅改造了传统韩屋，完美再现了韩国式的室内装修。.en: That restaurant renovated a traditional hanok and perfectly recreated Korean-style interior decoration.

韩国式的年龄计算法一出生就算一岁，所以外国人常常感到混淆。.en: In the Korean way of calculating age, you are considered one year old at birth, so foreigners often get confused.

她有了男朋友之后，和朋友见面的时间明显减少了。.en: After she got a boyfriend, the time she spends with friends has noticeably decreased.

男朋友每个纪念日都亲手写信，真的太让人感动了。.en: My boyfriend writes a letter by hand for every anniversary, it's really touching.

他女朋友住在国外，所以正在谈异地恋。.en: His girlfriend lives abroad, so they are in a long-distance relationship.

女朋友突然说要分手，我问原因，她说是因为积攒了委屈。.en: My girlfriend suddenly said she wanted to break up, and when I asked why, she said it was because she had been holding in a lot of hurt.

大学时期在便利店打工，得以见到了各种各样的人。.en: Working part-time at a convenience store during college, I got to meet all kinds of people.

最近找兼职难如登天，所以积累资历变得很重要。.en: Finding a part-time job these days is as hard as climbing a mountain, so building up experience is important.

青少年时期的经历对成年后价值观的形成有着巨大的影响。.en: Experiences during adolescence have a huge impact on the formation of values in adulthood.

这部电视剧真实地描绘了青少年们的职业苦恼和身份认同混乱。.en: This drama realistically portrays teenagers' career worries and identity confusion.

他以为是开玩笑，把朋友的秘密发到了SNS上，结果闯了大祸。.en: He thought it was a joke and posted his friend's secret on social media, which caused a big problem.

小时候以为是闹着玩的行为，日后可能会给对方留下深深的伤害。.en: What seemed like playful behavior as a child may later leave deep scars on the other person.

脑子里.en: in one's head; in one's mind

发表前夕，脑子里充满了担忧。.en: On the eve of the presentation, my head was full of worries.

他在脑子里瞬间完成了复杂的计算。.en: He completed the complex calculation in his head in an instant.

为了给后代留下洁净的自然，我们必须保护环境。.en: To leave a clean nature for future generations, we must protect the environment.

在日常生活中，有很多可以实践的保护环境的小事。.en: In daily life, there are many small things we can do to protect the environment.

为了减少食物垃圾，最好只采购需要的量。.en: To reduce food waste, it's best to buy only the amount you need.

这家餐厅为了减少食物里程，使用本地农产品。.en: This restaurant uses local produce to reduce food miles.

为了节约纸张，尽可能双面打印文件。.en: To save paper, print documents on both sides whenever possible.

把没用过的纸节省下来用作便条纸也是一个好方法。.en: Saving unused paper to use as note paper is also a good method.

这栋建筑太旧了，急需修缮。.en: This building is too old and urgently needs repairs.

他拿出旧相册，回忆起了童年时光。.en: He took out an old photo album and recalled his childhood.

今年的收成量比去年明显减少了。.en: This year's harvest amount has clearly decreased compared to last year.

应该牢记，食物的质量比数量更重要。.en: You should keep in mind that the quality of food is more important than the quantity.

据预测，如果格陵兰冰盖融化，全球海平面将上升数米。.en: It is predicted that if the Greenland ice sheet melts, global sea levels will rise by several meters.

随着永久冻土融化，大量甲烷气体被释放，加速了温室效应。.en: As permafrost melts, large amounts of methane gas are released, accelerating the greenhouse effect.

敞开，大开；豁然；盛开.en: wide open, fully open; in full bloom

他大大地打开门跑进房间喊道：“合格了！”.en: He opened the door wide and ran into the room shouting, "I passed!"

春天一到，山坡上的樱花盛开了，整个山坡染成了粉红色。.en: When spring came, the cherry blossoms on the hillside bloomed fully, dyeing the entire slope pink.

最近几乎不写信了，连小区里的信箱是什么时候消失的都不知道。.en: I hardly write letters these days, I don't even know when the mailbox in the neighborhood disappeared.

他有每天早上上班路上往信箱里投信的习惯。.en: He has a habit of dropping a letter into the mailbox on his way to work every morning.

古时候有传说，走过石桥时许愿就会实现。.en: In ancient times, there was a legend that if you make a wish while crossing a stone bridge, it will come true.

雨后石桥很滑，必须小心地走过去。.en: The stone bridge is very slippery after rain, so you have to walk across it carefully.

釜山港是韩国最大的贸易港口，连接着世界多个国家。.en: Busan Port is the largest trade port in South Korea, connecting many countries around the world.

黄昏时分停泊在港口的船只构成了一幅美丽的风景。.en: The ships anchored in the port at dusk create a beautiful scene.

坐在海边看海鸥觅食的样子非常平和。.en: Sitting by the sea watching seagulls foraging is very peaceful.

港口附近，成群的海鸥忙着接住游客扔给的零食。.en: Near the port, flocks of seagulls are busy catching snacks thrown by tourists.

统营民宿的老板以用自己捕捞的海鲜准备早餐而远近闻名。.en: The owner of the Tongyeong guesthouse is famous far and wide for preparing breakfast with seafood he catches himself.

旺季时民宿预订竞争激烈，需要提前几周联系。.en: During peak season, booking a guesthouse is very competitive, so you need to contact them a few weeks in advance.

油价连日刷新历史最高纪录，出租车司机的收入大幅减少。.en: As oil prices hit record highs day after day, taxi drivers' income has dropped significantly.

政府为减轻油价负担，决定暂时实施下调燃油税的措施。.en: To ease the burden of oil prices, the government decided to temporarily implement a fuel tax cut.

随着双职工家庭的增加，关于子女养育和教育的烦恼也在随之增大。.en: With the increase in dual-income families, worries about child rearing and education are also growing.

政府为低收入家庭的学生运营着多种奖学金制度。.en: The government operates various scholarship programs for students from low-income families.

随着学费逐年上涨，家长们的经济负担持续增加。.en: As tuition rises year after year, the financial burden on parents continues to increase.

工作量突然增加，员工们的压力也随之增大。.en: The workload suddenly increased, and the stress on employees also grew.

无论多么追逐理想，最终也不得不在现实的墙壁面前妥协。.en: No matter how much you chase your ideals, you eventually have to compromise in the face of reality.

他的计划过于乐观，与现实之间存在巨大差距。.en: His plan was too optimistic, and there is a huge gap between it and reality.

奶奶总是为孙子准备好保暖的衣服，以免他感冒。.en: Grandma always prepares warm clothes for her grandson so he doesn't catch a cold.

他给弟弟准备了便当，以免他在考试期间不吃饭。.en: He prepared a lunchbox for his younger brother so he wouldn't skip meals during exams.

母亲总是把精心准备的饭桌摆在面前，先尝味道。.en: Mother always sets the carefully prepared dining table in front of me and tastes the food first.

一到节日，全家人就会围坐在饭桌旁，谈笑风生。.en: When the holidays come, the whole family sits around the dining table, chatting and laughing.

刚孵出的小鸡们长着柔软的黄色绒毛，非常可爱。.en: The newly hatched chicks have soft yellow down feathers and are very cute.

母鸡把小鸡们护在翅膀下，保护它们免受寒冷和危险的侵害。.en: The hen shelters the chicks under her wings, protecting them from cold and danger.

国立植物园里展示着从稀有兰花到巨大仙人掌的各种植物。.en: The national botanical garden displays various plants from rare orchids to giant cacti.

他每周末都会去植物园，有着观察各种植物生态的爱好。.en: He goes to the botanical garden every weekend and has a hobby of observing the ecology of various plants.

看了那部纪录片之后，我对海洋生态系统产生了兴趣。.en: After watching that documentary, I became interested in the marine ecosystem.

一开始没什么感觉，但听了老师的说明后，我开始对历史产生了兴趣。.en: At first I didn't feel much, but after listening to the teacher's explanation, I started to become interested in history.

他对政治完全没有兴趣，所以对选举也不关心。.en: He has no interest in politics at all, so he doesn't care about elections either.

再好的书，如果没有想读的心情，就不会产生兴趣。.en: No matter how good a book is, if you don't feel like reading it, you won't become interested.

那对双胞胎姐妹不仅长相，连品味都惊人地相似。.en: Those twin sisters are strikingly similar not only in appearance but also in taste.

双胞胎兄弟因为上了不同的大学，第一次分开生活。.en: The twin brothers are living apart for the first time because they went to different universities.

他咂了咂舌头，表示对对方无礼行为的不快。.en: He clicked his tongue, expressing displeasure at the other person's rude behavior.

吃了又辣又烫的食物后，舌头上的味蕾可能会暂时麻痹。.en: After eating spicy and hot food, the taste buds on your tongue may become temporarily numb.

他因为长时间电脑工作导致手腕疼痛严重，于是换成了人体工学鼠标。.en: Because his wrist pain from long hours of computer work was severe, he switched to an ergonomic mouse.

无线鼠标的电池没电了，他急忙去便利店买电池。.en: The wireless mouse's battery died, so he hurried to the convenience store to buy batteries.

那家酒店配有高级餐厅和健身中心。.en: That hotel has a high-end restaurant and a fitness center.

她喜欢在氛围高级的咖啡店里喝咖啡。.en: She likes to drink coffee in a café with a premium atmosphere.

她嘴角泛起的那抹淡淡的微笑说明了一切。.en: The faint smile that appeared at the corner of her mouth said it all.

他在逆境中也不失去微笑的态度感动了很多人。.en: His attitude of not losing his smile even in adversity moved many people.

电影太无聊，本想中途离场，但在朋友的劝阻下还是看完了。.en: The movie was so boring that I wanted to leave halfway through, but my friend talked me into staying until the end.

项目进行到中途时，出现了预料之外的技术问题。.en: Unexpected technical problems arose halfway through the project.

他一整天都待在图书馆里，忙着找论文资料。.en: He spent the whole day in the library, busy looking for thesis materials.

婴儿满脸都是饭粒，却笑得无比灿烂。.en: The baby's face was covered in rice grains, but he was smiling so brightly.

大哥，今天的会议资料都准备好了吗？.en: Big brother, are the meeting materials for today all prepared?

他在组织里很好地扮演了大哥的角色，带领后辈们。.en: He played the role of the older brother well in the organization, leading the juniors.

他肩上扛着一支枪出去打猎了。.en: He went hunting with a gun on his shoulder.

抽屉里连一支圆珠笔都不剩了。.en: There isn't even a single ballpoint pen left in the drawer.

咬，叼，衔.en: bite, hold in mouth, carry in mouth

狗咬了陌生人的腿，差点酿成大事故。.en: The dog bit a stranger's leg and almost caused a big accident.

她紧咬着嘴唇忍住了眼泪。.en: She bit her lip tightly and held back her tears.

爷爷在菜园里亲手栽种并培育了辣椒和生菜。.en: Grandpa planted and grew peppers and lettuce in the vegetable garden with his own hands.

他重视教育，认为这是在孩子们心中播下希望的种子。.en: He values education, believing it plants seeds of hope in children's hearts.

他提着空水桶去井边打水。.en: He carried an empty bucket to the well to fetch water.

垃圾桶满了，再也没有可扔的空间了。.en: The trash can is full; there's no more space to throw anything away.

他大学毕业后在一家知名报社开始当记者。.en: After graduating from college, he started working as a reporter at a well-known newspaper company.

这家报社以专注于地方新闻的报道而闻名。.en: This newspaper company is known for focusing on local news coverage.

随着廉价航空公司的出现，机票价格变得便宜多了。.en: With the emergence of low-cost airlines, ticket prices have become much cheaper.

这家航空公司以优质的客户服务闻名，所以总是预约爆满。.en: This airline is famous for its excellent customer service, so it's always fully booked.

他拥有双重国籍，所以可以在多个国家自由生活。.en: He has dual nationality, so he can live freely in multiple countries.

不论国籍如何，所有申请人都应获得平等的机会。.en: Regardless of nationality, all applicants should receive equal opportunities.

得益于医学技术的发展，过去的不治之症如今也能得到治疗。.en: Thanks to advances in medical technology, diseases that were once incurable can now be treated.

他是一位毕生致力于医学研究的学者，受到许多人的尊敬。.en: He is a scholar who devoted his entire life to medical research and is respected by many.

学习经济学可以培养分析市场动向的能力。.en: Studying economics can help develop the ability to analyze market trends.

那位教授以将经济学理论应用于实际政策的研究而闻名。.en: That professor is famous for his research applying economic theory to actual policy.

历史学并非单纯记忆过去事实的学问，而是探究因果关系的学问。.en: History is not simply the study of memorizing past facts, but a discipline that explores cause and effect.

他在获得历史学博士学位后，出版了一本关于古代文明的书籍。.en: After earning his doctorate in history, he published a book about ancient civilizations.

舅母每逢节日都会寄来亲手做的松饼，我一直很感激。.en: My aunt sends homemade songpyeon every holiday, and I'm always grateful.

妈妈忙的时候，舅母经常照顾我。.en: When my mom was busy, my aunt often took care of me.

婶婶总是用温柔的笑容迎接我们。.en: My aunt always greets us with a warm smile.

婶婶用自己种的蔬菜给我们做了小菜。.en: My aunt made side dishes for us with vegetables she grew herself.

姑父退休后开始画画作为爱好。.en: After retiring, my uncle started painting as a hobby.

姑父是外科医生，经常给我们讲手术的故事。.en: My uncle is a surgeon and often tells us stories about surgeries.

舅舅在海外生活了很久，说英语比韩语更自在。.en: My uncle lived abroad for a long time and is more comfortable speaking English than Korean.

小时候舅舅买给我的童话书至今仍记忆犹新。.en: I still vividly remember the fairy tale books my uncle bought me when I was little.

姨夫汽车修理技术很好，邻居们经常找他。.en: My uncle is very good at car repair, so the neighbors often come to him.

姨夫每天早晨慢跑，管理自己的健康。.en: My uncle jogs every morning to manage his health.

叔叔是大学教授，在大学教授哲学。.en: My uncle is a university professor and teaches philosophy at the university.

叔叔送给了我第一辆汽车。.en: My uncle gave me my first car.

这条路经常走，很熟悉。.en: I often walk this road, so I'm very familiar with it.

我还不习惯韩国食物。.en: I'm not used to Korean food yet.

伯父继承了家业，在务农。.en: My uncle inherited the family business and works as a farmer.

伯父去世后，伯母一个人经营农场。.en: After my uncle passed away, my aunt ran the farm by herself.

伯母腌制泡菜的手艺一流。.en: My aunt's kimchi-making skills are top-notch.

伯母总是为孙子们准备好吃的零食。.en: My aunt always prepares tasty snacks for her grandchildren.

火车窗外展开的乡村风景美得像明信片一样。.en: The rural scenery unfolding outside the train window was as beautiful as a postcard.

城市的夜景虽然华丽，但我反而更想念宁静的山村风景。.en: The city night view is flashy, but I actually miss the quiet mountain village scenery more.

这个地区是著名景点，每到周末就挤满了游客。.en: This area is a famous tourist spot, and it's packed with visitors every weekend.

景点周围密集地分布着纪念品商店和餐厅。.en: Souvenir shops and restaurants are densely packed around the tourist attraction.

庆州有很多新罗时代的遗址，深受学习历史的人们的喜爱。.en: Gyeongju has many historical sites from the Silla period, and it's popular among people studying history.

为了保存遗址，有些区域限制出入。.en: To preserve the historical site, some areas have restricted access.

那家餐厅的位置不太好。.en: That restaurant's location isn't very good.

你知道学校的位置吗？.en: Do you know where the school is?

他以为大家都会赞成，但相反，大多数人表示了反对。.en: He thought everyone would agree, but on the contrary, most people expressed opposition.

人们容易认为要降低成本就得降低人力费用，但相反，提高效率更为重要。.en: People tend to think that to reduce costs, you have to lower labor costs, but on the contrary, improving efficiency is more important.

为了减轻压力，我每周末都去爬山。.en: To alleviate stress, I go hiking every weekend.

吃了这个药，疼痛确实减轻了。.en: After taking this medicine, the pain really subsided.

做拌饭之前，请把辣椒酱和香油跟米饭好好拌匀。.en: Before making bibimbap, please mix the gochujang and sesame oil well with the rice.

他累的时候会揉眼睛，努力保持清醒。.en: When he's tired, he rubs his eyes and tries to stay awake.

菜快做好时撒上芝麻，会增添香喷喷的味道。.en: When the dish is almost done, sprinkle sesame seeds on it to add a fragrant flavor.

春天一到，农民们就开始往田里撒种子。.en: When spring comes, farmers start scattering seeds in the fields.

在韩国，用春季采摘的各种野菜做拌饭是代表性的饮食文化。.en: In Korea, making bibimbap with various wild greens picked in spring is a representative food culture.

妈妈把亲自从山上挖来的野菜凉拌后，作为晚餐小菜端了上来。.en: Mom seasoned the wild greens she personally dug up from the mountain and served them as a side dish for dinner.

牛杂碎汤是用牛肉长时间熬制的食物。.en: Beef offal soup is a dish made by simmering beef for a long time.

冷的时候会想起热乎乎的牛杂碎汤。.en: When it's cold, I think of hot beef offal soup.

要想吃新鲜的生鱼片，还是去活鱼生鱼片中心最好。.en: If you want to eat fresh sashimi, it's best to go to a live fish sashimi center.

生鱼片蘸着醋辣椒酱吃，油腻感会减少，味道更清爽。.en: Eating sashimi with vinegar chili paste reduces the greasiness and makes it taste more refreshing.

下出租车时小心别把东西落在车上。.en: When getting out of the taxi, be careful not to leave anything behind.

结账时找零不够，职员重新算了一遍。.en: The change was short when paying, so the clerk recalculated.

自动售货机没出找零，我打了客服电话。.en: The vending machine didn't give change, so I called customer service.

老幼病残孕专座.en: priority seats for the elderly, children, pregnant women, and the disabled

在地铁上坐在老幼病残孕专座时，老人来了应该让座。.en: When sitting in a priority seat on the subway, you should give it up for an elderly person.

老幼病残孕专座总是空着才是礼貌，但实际上往往不被遵守。.en: Priority seats should always be left empty to be polite, but in reality, this is often not followed.

乘坐公交车时，需要将交通卡在终端机上刷卡。.en: When taking the bus, you need to tap your transit card on the terminal.

如果不提前购买火车票，可能会很难上车。.en: If you don't buy a train ticket in advance, it might be hard to get on.

上下班时间地铁太拥挤，经常晚点。.en: The subway is too crowded during rush hour and often runs late.

上下班路上总是听播客，时间过得很快。.en: I always listen to podcasts on my way to and from work, so time passes quickly.

在站台等车时，应该站在安全线后面。.en: When waiting for the train on the platform, you should stand behind the safety line.

这个站台是1号线和2号线都可以使用的结构。.en: This platform is designed to be used by both Line 1 and Line 2.

越过地铁安全线很危险，必须时刻注意。.en: Crossing the subway safety line is dangerous, so you must always be careful.

站台上设置的安全线是保护乘客的重要设施。.en: The safety line installed on the platform is an important facility for protecting passengers.

这个公交区间票价比其他区间贵，需要考虑换乘。.en: The bus fare for this section is more expensive than other sections, so you need to consider transferring.

从首尔到釜山是大约2小时30分钟的火车区间。.en: The train section from Seoul to Busan is about 2 hours and 30 minutes.

在公交车上让座是基本礼仪。.en: Giving up your seat on the bus is basic etiquette.

在谈判中，双方各让一步才能达成协议。.en: In negotiations, both sides need to give a little to reach an agreement.

韩国共存着多种宗教，各宗教的庆典也会举行。.en: In Korea, many religions coexist, and festivals for each religion are also held.

宗教自由是宪法保障的基本权利。.en: Religious freedom is a fundamental right guaranteed by the constitution.

明天必须参加会议，但不知道时间是否合适。.en: I have to attend the meeting tomorrow, but I'm not sure if the time works.

很多人参加了那个活动，气氛非常好。.en: Many people participated in that event, and the atmosphere was great.

为了解决环境问题，回收利用和节能很重要。.en: To solve environmental problems, recycling and energy conservation are important.

最近随着对环境问题的关注度提高，环保产品大受欢迎。.en: Recently, as interest in environmental issues has increased, eco-friendly products have become very popular.

在银行贷款购房资金时，一定要确认利率。.en: When borrowing money from the bank to buy a house, you must check the interest rate.

在图书馆借书需要会员卡。.en: You need a membership card to borrow books from the library.

从图书馆借的书如果不按时归还，需要交逾期费。.en: If you don't return books borrowed from the library on time, you have to pay a late fee.

使用共享单车后，必须在指定地点归还。.en: After using a shared bike, you must return it to a designated spot.

图书馆阅览室禁止打电话。.en: Making phone calls is prohibited in the library reading room.

一到考试期间，阅览室的座位就很难占。.en: During exam season, it's hard to get a seat in the library.

那家出版社计划今年集中出版人文类书籍。.en: That publishing company plans to focus on publishing humanities books this year.

我把稿子寄给了好几家出版社，但都被拒绝了。.en: I sent my manuscript to several publishing companies, but they all rejected it.

会议将按时开始。.en: The meeting will start on time.

每天早晨按时起床真不容易。.en: It's really hard to get up on time every morning.

为了写论文，我正在图书馆查找相关资料。.en: I'm looking up relevant materials in the library to write my thesis.

在网上查找可靠的资料很重要。.en: It's important to find reliable information online.

我每个月把工资的一部分存到定期存折里。.en: I deposit part of my salary into a fixed-term savings account every month.

我打算去银行存现金，需要账号。.en: I'm planning to deposit cash at the bank, so I need my account number.

这些文件必须在今天之内全部处理完。.en: All these documents must be processed by the end of today.

迅速处理客户的投诉很重要。.en: It's important to handle customer complaints quickly.

我去银行办了一个新存折。.en: I went to the bank and opened a new bankbook.

我查了一下存折余额，发现钱比想象中少。.en: I checked my bankbook balance and found there was less money than I thought.

要接收汇款，必须把账号告诉对方。.en: To receive a remittance, you have to give the other person your account number.

如果账号输错，钱可能会转到别的地方。.en: If you enter the wrong account number, the money might go somewhere else.

随着汇率急剧上升，计划出国旅行的人们纷纷取消了行程。.en: As the exchange rate rose sharply, people who planned to travel abroad canceled their trips one after another.

出口企业为将汇率波动带来的风险最小化，采用了多种对冲策略。.en: Export companies use various hedging strategies to minimize the risk from exchange rate fluctuations.

旅行前最好提前换好钱。.en: It's better to exchange money in advance before traveling.

在市内换钱所换钱比在机场汇率更好。.en: Exchanging money at a currency exchange in the city gives you a better rate than at the airport.

进行海外汇款时，请确认手续费是多少。.en: When making an overseas remittance, please check the fee.

母亲每个月给我汇生活费。.en: My mother sends me living expenses every month.

这家银行的转账手续费比其他银行便宜一些。.en: This bank's transfer fee is a bit cheaper than other banks.

换钱时一定要比较包含手续费在内的实际汇率。.en: When exchanging money, you must compare the actual exchange rate including fees.

如果明天之前不提交申请文件，可能会受到不利影响。.en: If you don't submit the application documents by tomorrow, you may be at a disadvantage.

请仔细阅读合同文件后再签名。.en: Please read the contract documents carefully before signing.

如果丢失驾照，必须向警察局申报后再补办。.en: If you lose your driver's license, you must report it to the police and then get a replacement.

在国外开车可能需要国际驾照。.en: You may need an international driver's license to drive abroad.

因为现金不够，我去银行ATM取钱了。.en: Because I didn't have enough cash, I went to the bank ATM to withdraw money.

从存折取钱时可能需要身份证。.en: You may need an ID to withdraw money from a passbook.

一到银行我就取了号等着。.en: As soon as I got to the bank, I took a number and waited.

民事室人很多，最好先取号。.en: There are many people in the civil affairs office, so it's best to take a number first.

重要文件用挂号信寄比较安全。.en: It's safer to send important documents by registered mail.

挂号信可以追踪配送，很方便。.en: Registered mail can be tracked, which is very convenient.

网上订的包裹预计今天到。.en: The parcel I ordered online is expected to arrive today.

寄包裹时一定要仔细包装里面的东西。.en: When sending a parcel, be sure to carefully wrap the contents.

如果来十个人以上，座位会有点挤。.en: If there are more than ten people, the seats will be a bit cramped.

如果点一万韩元以上，配送是免费的。.en: If you order 10,000 won or more, delivery is free.

要称包裹重量的话，请用邮局的秤。.en: To weigh the parcel, please use the post office scale.

在市场上买水果时，我一定会在秤上确认重量。.en: When buying fruit at the market, I always check the weight on the scale.

妈妈早上煎的饼真的很好吃。.en: The pancakes Mom fried this morning were really delicious.

寄这封信到韩国需要多少邮票？.en: How many stamps do I need to send this letter to Korea?

因为感冒，今天上课缺勤了。.en: I was absent from class today because of a cold.

缺勤太多可能会对成绩有不利影响，请注意。.en: Too many absences may negatively affect your grades, so please be careful.

要去韩国留学，必须先申请签证。.en: To study abroad in Korea, you must first apply for a visa.

最好在签证到期前申请延期。.en: It's best to apply for an extension before your visa expires.

在银行办理重要业务必须本人亲自到访才能处理。.en: For important transactions at the bank, you must visit in person to handle them.

文件上必须由本人签名。.en: The document must be signed by the person themselves.

入境韩国时请确认是否需要签证。.en: When entering Korea, please check if a visa is required.

入境审查比预想的要久，让我很惊讶。.en: The immigration inspection took longer than expected, which surprised me.

办完出国手续后，突然想家了。.en: After completing the departure procedures, I suddenly felt homesick.

出国前最好提前换好钱。.en: It's best to exchange money before going abroad.

不知道放在桌上的文件是谁的。.en: I don't know whose file that is on the desk.

他手里总是放着一杯咖啡。.en: He always has a cup of coffee in his hand.

要延长签证期限，必须在出国前申请。.en: To extend your visa, you must apply before going abroad.

会议时间延长了一个小时。.en: The meeting time was extended by an hour.

申请表上有标明性别的栏位。.en: The application form has a section for gender.

不论性别，任何人都可以申请。.en: Anyone can apply regardless of gender.

坐在公园长椅上读书的老人令人印象深刻。.en: The old man reading a book on a park bench was impressive.

那名选手因伤只能坐在替补席上观看比赛。.en: That player could only watch the game from the substitute bench due to injury.

天气突然变了，所以多穿了些衣服。.en: The weather suddenly changed, so I put on more clothes.

那个人结婚后性格完全变了。.en: That person's personality completely changed after getting married.

交往很久的情侣最终决定分手了。.en: The couple who had been dating for a long time finally decided to break up.

分手时最好说一些互相尊重的话。.en: It's best to say some respectful words when breaking up.

受理截止日期是下周五。.en: The deadline for acceptance is next Friday.

吃烤鱼时挤上柠檬汁会更美味。.en: Squeezing lemon juice on grilled fish makes it more delicious.

在韩国，烤五花肉是最受欢迎的下酒菜之一。.en: In Korea, grilled pork belly is one of the most popular side dishes for drinking.

老师责骂了迟到的学生。.en: The teacher scolded the student who was late.

妈妈因为我没整理房间而责骂了我。.en: My mom scolded me because I didn't clean my room.

昨天工作到很晚，今天疲劳得厉害。.en: I worked late yesterday, so I'm extremely tired today.

那个朋友玩笑开得太过分，周围的人都感到不舒服。.en: That friend's joke went too far, making everyone around uncomfortable.

打车去了机场，但因为堵车迟到了。.en: I took a taxi to the airport, but I was late because of traffic.

夏天在海边待得太久，皮肤晒得黝黑。.en: I stayed at the beach too long in the summer, and my skin got very sunburned.

掉；落；分开；使掉(落)下.en: to fall; to drop; to separate; to make fall/drop

从餐桌上掉落了盘子。.en: A plate fell off the dining table.

手机掉到地上，屏幕碎了。.en: The phone fell to the ground and the screen cracked.

拉；拖；吸引.en: to pull; to drag; to attract

那位演说家以能瞬间吸引听众注意力的讲话方式而闻名。.en: That speaker is famous for a speaking style that instantly grabs the audience's attention.

用叉车拖重物时，不小心在地板上弄出了一大道划痕。.en: When dragging a heavy object with a forklift, I accidentally made a big scratch on the floor.

在登山口看到有人骑驴运货。.en: At the trailhead, I saw someone transporting goods on a donkey.

驴性情温顺，适合孩子们骑乘。.en: Donkeys have a gentle temperament, making them suitable for children to ride.

看到在路边发抖的小狗，觉得非常可怜。.en: Seeing the puppy shivering on the roadside, I felt very sorry for it.

他装可怜想博取人们的同情。.en: He pretends to be pitiful to gain people's sympathy.

今年的会费比去年涨了五千韩元。.en: This year's membership fee went up by 5,000 won compared to last year.

不交会费就无法参加社团活动。.en: If you don't pay the membership fee, you can't participate in club activities.

小时候贫穷的记忆反而让我变得更坚强。.en: Memories of poverty from childhood actually made me stronger.

他出生在贫穷的环境中，但通过努力学习获得了成功。.en: He was born into poverty, but succeeded through hard study.

最近流行长裙，各大百货商店都在热卖。.en: Long skirts are popular these days, and they're selling well at all department stores.

那首歌虽然已经不流行了，但仍有不少人在听。.en: That song is no longer popular, but there are still many people listening to it.

每次地铁经过时，都能感觉到建筑物轻微震动。.en: Every time the subway passes, you can feel the building vibrate slightly.

手机设成了震动模式，所以来电话也没察觉。.en: My phone was set to vibrate mode, so I didn't notice the call.

现在正在通话中，请五分钟后打来。.en: The line is busy right now, please call back in five minutes.

社长正在通话中，所以我留了便条。.en: The boss was on the phone, so I left a note.

这周末我决定和朋友一起去看话剧。.en: I decided to go see a play with my friend this weekend.

那部话剧获得了观众的热烈反响。.en: That play received a strong response from the audience.

售票处前排的队太长了，买票花了三十分钟。.en: The line in front of the ticket office was so long that it took thirty minutes to buy a ticket.

在火车站售票处买往返票会便宜一些。.en: It's a bit cheaper to buy a round-trip ticket at the train station ticket office.

上班路上堵车严重，比约定时间晚了一个小时。.en: The traffic was heavy on the way to work, so I was an hour late for the appointment.

面临大事时思路堵塞，好几天什么都没写出来。.en: When faced with a big task, my thoughts get blocked, and I couldn't write anything for days.

什么事，怎么回事，不知为什么.en: what's up, what happened, for some reason

什么风把你吹得今天这么早回家？有什么好事吗？.en: What brings you home so early today? Did something good happen?

突然下起雨来，不知为什么我竟然没带伞。.en: It suddenly started raining, and for some reason I didn't have an umbrella.

我找到了语言交换伙伴，决定每周见一次面。.en: I found a language exchange partner and decided to meet once a week.

语言交换是一个通过互相教母语来自然提高能力的好方法。.en: Language exchange is a great way to naturally improve by teaching each other your native languages.

负责人换了，我帮您转接电话。.en: The person in charge has changed, I'll transfer your call.

金部长在吗？抱歉，他现在在位子上，我帮您转接电话。.en: Is Director Kim in? Sorry, he's at his desk now, I'll transfer your call.

上班时间堵车很严重，差点迟到了。.en: The traffic was really bad during rush hour, I almost got late.

工作堆积太多，周末也没能休息。.en: Work piled up so much that I couldn't rest even on the weekend.

不要不确认发件人就接电话。.en: Don't answer the phone without checking who the sender is.

电话打不通，所以留了语音短信。.en: The call didn't go through, so I left a voice message.

听了语音短信后马上回复了。.en: I replied right after listening to the voice message.

往首尔打电话时要拨区号02。.en: When calling Seoul, you need to dial area code 02.

拨错了区号，结果连到了别的地区。.en: I dialed the wrong area code and ended up connecting to a different region.

接电话的人.en: the person who answers the phone

接电话的人正在通话中，所以留了言。.en: The person who answered the phone was on a call, so I left a message.

这封信的收件人地址写错了。.en: The recipient's address on this letter is written incorrectly.

一不小心把有约的事给忘了。.en: I accidentally forgot about the appointment.

忘记带钱包出门了。.en: I forgot to bring my wallet when I went out.

抱歉，今天有约在先，下次见面吧。.en: Sorry, I have a prior engagement today. Let's meet next time.

那天我已经提前说过有约在先了。.en: I already mentioned that day that I had a prior engagement.

因为有急事，看来得推迟约定了。.en: Because of an urgent matter, I'll have to postpone the appointment.

推迟约定不太礼貌，但我也没办法。.en: Postponing an appointment isn't very polite, but I have no choice.

因为身体不舒服，只好取消了约定。.en: Because I wasn't feeling well, I had to cancel the appointment.

对方突然取消了约定，让我很慌张。.en: The other person suddenly canceled the appointment, which caught me off guard.

怕错过讲课内容，就用手机录了音。.en: Afraid of missing the lecture content, I recorded it with my phone.

录音通话内容时需要征得对方同意。.en: You need to get the other person's consent when recording a phone conversation.

请在重要的部分标上星号。.en: Please mark the important parts with an asterisk.

输入密码时显示为星号。.en: When entering a password, it shows as asterisks.

那个传闻很快就传遍了整个小区。.en: That rumor quickly spread throughout the entire neighborhood.

老师让我向学生们转达问候。.en: The teacher told me to convey greetings to the students.

要接受定期健康检查的话，也得做血液检查。.en: If you're going to get a regular health check-up, you also need to get a blood test.

检察官根据证据重建了案件。.en: The prosecutor reconstructed the case based on the evidence.

被蜜蜂蜇了，手肿得很厉害。.en: I got stung by a bee, and my hand swelled up badly.

晚上喝太多水的话，第二天脸有时会肿。.en: If you drink too much water at night, your face sometimes swells the next day.

伤口很深，必须缠上绷带。.en: The wound is deep, so you must wrap it with a bandage.

如果不经常换绷带，可能会感染。.en: If you don't change the bandage often, it might get infected.

夏天食物容易变质，很容易食物中毒。.en: Food spoils easily in summer, so it's easy to get food poisoning.

食物中毒症状很严重，最终去了医院。.en: The food poisoning symptoms were severe, so I ended up going to the hospital.

医生仔细诊察了患者后开了药。.en: The doctor examined the patient carefully and then prescribed medicine.

要接受诊察的话，得先挂号。.en: To get a medical examination, you need to register first.

腹泻很严重，吃完饭马上就吐了。.en: The diarrhea was severe, and I threw up right after eating.

孩子发烧还一直吐，我很担心。.en: The child had a fever and kept throwing up, so I was very worried.

在错的单词上划线删掉了。.en: I drew a line through the wrong word and deleted it.

他用铅笔在纸上划了一条斜线。.en: He drew a diagonal line on the paper with a pencil.

如果不充分吃蔬菜，很容易便秘。.en: If you don't eat enough vegetables, you can easily get constipated.

因为便秘很痛苦，在药店买了药。.en: Because constipation was painful, I bought medicine at the pharmacy.

吃太多油腻的食物可能会消化不好。.en: Eating too much greasy food can cause poor digestion.

压力大的时候好像经常消化不好。.en: When I'm stressed, I often seem to have poor digestion.

吃了变质的食物，闹肚子了。.en: I ate spoiled food and got an upset stomach.

旅行中闹肚子了，很难受。.en: I got an upset stomach during the trip and felt really bad.

天气热的时候食欲下降，就想吃凉快的食物。.en: When the weather is hot, my appetite decreases and I want to eat cool food.

这家餐厅有很多很合口味的菜。.en: This restaurant has many dishes that suit my taste.

开着空调睡了一夜，得了重感冒。.en: I slept with the air conditioner on all night and caught a bad cold.

有重感冒的症状，吃了药早早就睡了。.en: I had symptoms of a bad cold, so I took medicine and went to bed early.

因为感冒去了医院打了针，好了一些。.en: I went to the hospital because of a cold and got a shot, and I felt a bit better.

医生给我开了药，而不是先打针。.en: The doctor prescribed me medicine instead of giving me a shot first.

这种药必须有医生的处方才能在药店买到。.en: This medicine can only be bought at a pharmacy with a doctor's prescription.

我把处方弄丢了，只好再去医院重新开处方。.en: I lost the prescription, so I had to go back to the hospital to get a new one.

昨天在演唱会上喊得太厉害，今天嗓子哑了。.en: I shouted too much at the concert yesterday, so my throat is hoarse today.

嗓子哑了，连电话都没法好好打。.en: My throat is so hoarse I can't even make a phone call properly.

最近压力很大，头痛得厉害了。.en: I've been under a lot of stress lately, and my headache has gotten worse.

头痛得厉害，吃了止痛药躺了一会儿。.en: My head hurt so badly that I took some painkillers and lay down for a while.

因为感冒鼻子不通，呼吸很困难。.en: Because of a cold, my nose is stuffy and it's hard to breathe.

过敏严重的话，鼻子会不通，还会一直打喷嚏。.en: If the allergy is severe, your nose will get stuffy and you'll keep sneezing.

饭吃太多所以吃了消化药。.en: I ate too much, so I took digestive medicine.

消化药饭后马上吃也可以。.en: You can take digestive medicine right after a meal too.

我每天吃一粒维生素保健品。.en: I take one vitamin supplement every day.

最近很累，想买点营养素。.en: I've been really tired lately, so I want to buy some nutrients.

这份报告综合了过去一年的成果来撰写的。.en: This report was written by comprehensively summarizing the results of the past year.

要接受综合健康检查的话，必须提前预约。.en: To get a comprehensive health checkup, you must make a reservation in advance.

开始减肥才一个月，就瘦了很多。.en: It's only been a month since I started dieting, and I've already lost a lot of weight.

最近工作太忙，没能好好吃饭，瘦了。.en: I've been so busy with work lately that I haven't been able to eat properly, and I've lost weight.

压力大的话，脸上容易长痘痘。.en: If you're stressed, you easily get pimples on your face.

痘痘很严重，所以去皮肤科接受治疗。.en: My pimples were really bad, so I went to the dermatologist for treatment.

下午两点预约了牙科诊疗，得去一趟。.en: I have a dental appointment at 2 PM, so I need to go.

诊疗时间结束了，今天不能再接诊患者了。.en: Consultation hours are over, so we can't see any more patients today.

在韩国，所有国民都必须加入健康保险。.en: In Korea, all citizens must enroll in health insurance.

如果不带健康保险证，可能需要全额支付诊疗费。.en: If you don't bring your health insurance card, you may have to pay the full medical fee.

医生说手术后需要住院一周左右。.en: The doctor said I need to stay in the hospital for about a week after surgery.

住院期间医院的饭菜不合胃口，很难熬。.en: The hospital food didn't suit my taste during my stay, so it was hard to endure.

听到医生说可以明天出院，真的很开心。.en: I was really happy to hear the doctor say I can be discharged tomorrow.

出院后一段时间内也不能过度劳累，要好好休息。.en: Even after being discharged, I shouldn't overwork myself for a while and need to rest well.

天气阴沉的话，很多人会感到忧郁。.en: Many people feel depressed when the weather is gloomy.

和朋友聊了之后，忧郁的心情好了一些。.en: After talking with a friend, my depressed mood got a little better.

春天花粉过敏很严重，总是按时吃药。.en: My spring pollen allergy is really bad, so I always take my medicine on time.

我对虾过敏，所以吃海鲜料理时会注意。.en: I'm allergic to shrimp, so I'm careful when eating seafood dishes.

肚子疼所以去了内科。.en: I had a stomachache, so I went to Internal Medicine.

内科治疗感冒或腹泻。.en: Internal Medicine treats colds or diarrhea.

眼睛经常干涩所以去眼科。.en: My eyes are often dry, so I go to Ophthalmology.

在眼科做了视力检查。.en: I had an eye exam at Ophthalmology.

因为事故腿受伤了，直接被送到了外科急诊室。.en: I injured my leg in an accident and was taken straight to the surgery emergency room.

接受外科手术前，收到了需要禁食的通知。.en: Before undergoing surgery, I was told to fast.

因为天气干燥突然流鼻血，吓了一跳。.en: I suddenly got a nosebleed because of the dry weather and was startled.

孩子鼻血止不住，所以带去了医院。.en: My child's nosebleed wouldn't stop, so I took him to the hospital.

一到春天，因为过敏全身发痒，经常失眠。.en: In spring, my whole body itches from allergies and I often can't sleep.

被蚊子咬的地方太痒了，挠着挠着皮肤都破了。.en: The mosquito bite itched so much that I scratched until my skin broke.

他踢足球时腿骨折了，受了重伤。.en: He broke his leg playing soccer and was seriously injured.

铅笔太细了，很容易折断。.en: The pencil is too thin and breaks easily.

食物垃圾如果长时间放置，很容易腐烂发臭。.en: If food waste is left for a long time, it easily rots and smells bad.

这棵树内部已经腐烂，不能再用来做家具了。.en: The inside of this tree has already rotted, so it can't be used for furniture anymore.

因为痘痘去皮肤科。.en: I went to the dermatologist because of pimples.

在皮肤科可以做过敏检查。.en: You can get allergy tests done at the dermatologist.

据说核桃对大脑健康好，所以打算经常吃。.en: I heard walnuts are good for brain health, so I plan to eat them often.

这个蛋糕上撒满了核桃，有股香喷喷的味道。.en: This cake is covered in walnuts and has a fragrant smell.

会议拖得太长，大家都开始觉得闷得慌。.en: The meeting dragged on too long, and everyone started to feel bored.

狭窄的电梯里人很多，孩子觉得闷。.en: There were many people in the narrow elevator, and the child felt stuffy.

去济州岛的时候，决定住民宿而不是酒店。.en: When going to Jeju Island, I decided to stay at a guesthouse instead of a hotel.

这家民宿的房东阿姨做的早餐真的很好吃。.en: The breakfast made by the landlady of this guesthouse was really delicious.

那个小朋友已经能读全部韩文了，真让人惊讶。.en: That little kid can already read all of Hangul, which is really surprising.

小时候个子矮，总是得站在第一排。.en: When I was young and short, I always had to stand in the front row.

高中时修学旅行去庆州参观佛国寺的记忆至今仍历历在目。.en: The memory of visiting Bulguksa Temple in Gyeongju on a high school field trip is still vivid.

因为新冠疫情，今年的修学旅行被取消了，学生们感到非常遗憾。.en: Because of the COVID-19 pandemic, this year's school trip was canceled, and the students were very disappointed.

选择巴厘岛作为蜜月旅行地的原因是两人都喜欢异国风情的大自然。.en: The reason they chose Bali as their honeymoon destination was that both of them love exotic nature.

据说最近比起蜜月旅行，更多新婚夫妇倾向于把钱花在购置房产上。.en: It is said that these days, more newlyweds prefer to spend money on buying a house rather than on a honeymoon.

那部小说的主人公是在乡下长大的纯真姑娘，描绘了她逐渐适应城市生活的过程。.en: The protagonist of that novel is an innocent girl who grew up in the countryside, and it depicts her process of gradually adapting to city life.

“处女山脉”这个说法指的是从未有人攀登过的山脉。.en: The term 'virgin mountain' refers to a mountain that has never been climbed by anyone.

在小每物岛观赏的日出被誉为韩半岛最美的日出之一。.en: The sunrise viewed at Somaemuldo Island is considered one of the most beautiful sunrises on the Korean Peninsula.

随着前往日出名胜的游客增加，周边民宿和简易旅馆的价格也上涨了。.en: As the number of tourists visiting famous sunrise spots increases, the prices of nearby guesthouses and budget lodgings also rise.

那部电影的最后场面给观众留下了深深的余韵。.en: The final scene of that movie left a deep lingering impression on the audience.

孩子们一起欢笑吵闹的场面让看的人心里暖暖的。.en: The scene of children laughing and playing together warms the hearts of those watching.

去海外旅行前，务必确认护照有效期，这一点很重要。.en: Before traveling overseas, it's important to check the validity of your passport.

那家企业为了进军海外市场，正在加强与当地合作伙伴的协作。.en: That company is strengthening collaboration with local partners to enter the overseas market.

第一次旅行至今还留在记忆里。.en: The first trip still remains in my memory.

那位老师的话会长久地留在记忆中。.en: That teacher's words will remain in my memory for a long time.

在济州岛，租车是最方便的交通工具，但旺季需要提前预约。.en: On Jeju Island, renting a car is the most convenient means of transportation, but you need to book in advance during peak season.

在交通不便的地区制定旅行计划时，需要充分考虑移动时间。.en: When making travel plans for areas with inconvenient transportation, you need to fully consider travel time.

这家公司的产品质量优良，但价格稍贵。.en: This company's products are of excellent quality, but the price is a bit expensive.

如果不严格进行质量管理，可能会失去消费者的信任。.en: If quality management is not strictly carried out, you may lose consumers' trust.

这本旅行指南详细介绍了当地美食和住宿信息，非常适合旅行新手。.en: This travel guide introduces local food and accommodation information in detail, making it perfect for travel beginners.

最近比起纸质旅行指南，参考YouTube旅行视频的人越来越多了。.en: Recently, more and more people are referring to YouTube travel videos rather than paper travel guides.

这个节日有街头表演、烟花等多种看点，很受游客欢迎。.en: This festival has various attractions like street performances and fireworks, making it very popular with tourists.

博物馆不仅展品值得一看，建筑本身也是一道亮丽的景观。.en: Not only are the museum's exhibits worth seeing, but the building itself is also a beautiful sight.

这栋建筑具有极高的历史价值，被指定为联合国教科文组织世界文化遗产。.en: This building has extremely high historical value and has been designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

那个决定被认为成为了两国关系的历史性转折点。.en: That decision is considered to have become a historic turning point in the relationship between the two countries.

出差日程太紧了，完全没有观光的时间。.en: The business trip schedule is too tight, so there's no time for sightseeing at all.

如果日程比较宽松，在安静的乡村小镇停留一两天也不错。.en: If the schedule is relatively relaxed, it's also nice to stay in a quiet rural village for a day or two.

那部电视剧讲述了王妃克服政治逆境、为百姓奉献的故事。.en: That drama tells the story of the queen consort overcoming political adversity and dedicating herself to the people.

在历史中，王妃的角色不仅仅是王的配偶，有时也是治理国家的领导者。.en: In history, the role of the queen consort is not just the king's spouse, but sometimes also a leader governing the country.

童话中的王子通常以击败恶龙、拯救公主的典型英雄形象出现。.en: In fairy tales, the prince usually appears as a typical hero who defeats a dragon and rescues a princess.

听说他是财阀家的独子，像童话里的王子一样长大。.en: I heard he's the only son of a chaebol family and grew up like a prince in a fairy tale.

随着岁月流逝，他们的友情变得更加深厚。.en: As the years passed, their friendship grew deeper.

无论岁月如何流逝，当时的记忆依然鲜活。.en: No matter how many years pass, the memories from back then are still vivid.

这个地区住宿设施不足，旺季需要提前几个月预订。.en: Accommodation facilities in this area are insufficient, so you need to book months in advance during peak season.

政府为应对游客增加，发布了扩充住宿设施的计划。.en: The government announced a plan to expand accommodation facilities in response to the increase in tourists.

以后想联系的话，需要交换联系方式。.en: If you want to get in touch later, we need to exchange contact information.

我把联系方式弄丢了，联系不上那个朋友了。.en: I lost the contact information, so I can't get in touch with that friend anymore.

标准间比套房小，但价格便宜，是实惠的选择。.en: A standard room is smaller than a suite, but it's cheaper and a good value choice.

KTX标准间的座位也比想象中舒适，短途旅行完全够用。.en: The seats in a KTX standard room are also more comfortable than expected, and they're perfectly fine for a short trip.

在济州岛租车是必须的，所以一到机场就直接去了租车公司。.en: Renting a car is a must on Jeju Island, so I went straight to the rental company as soon as I arrived at the airport.

租车时最好仔细确认是否加入了保险。.en: When renting a car, it's best to carefully check whether insurance is included.

如果是团体旅行，租用面包车在人员运输上要高效得多。.en: If you're traveling in a group, renting a van is much more efficient for moving people around.

面包车座位多，适合和家人或朋友一起旅行。.en: A van has plenty of seats, so it's good for traveling with family or friends.

这个项目原计划下月底前完成，但比预期有所延迟。.en: This project was originally planned to be completed by the end of next month, but it's been delayed more than expected.

明天预计有雨，最好调整一下旅行计划。.en: It's expected to rain tomorrow, so it's best to adjust your travel plans.

这个套餐产品包含了机票和住宿费，非常划算。.en: This package includes airfare and accommodation, so it's a great deal.

餐费不包含在旅游费用内，需要个人另行支付。.en: Meal costs are not included in the travel fee, so you'll need to pay separately.

航空票价随季节波动很大，提前预订比较有利。.en: Airline ticket prices fluctuate a lot by season, so it's better to book in advance.

航空货运比海运快，但费用要高得多。.en: Air freight is faster than sea freight, but the cost is much higher.

在图书馆借书时，必须携带会员证。.en: When borrowing books from the library, you must bring your membership card.

这家咖啡馆还提供电子书租赁服务。.en: This café also offers an e-book rental service.

市中心停车位狭窄，小型车比大型车停车方便得多。.en: Parking spaces in the city center are narrow, so compact cars are much easier to park than large ones.

考虑油耗的话小型车更经济，但长途旅行可能会有些不便。.en: Considering fuel efficiency, compact cars are more economical, but they might be a bit inconvenient for long trips.

购买往返机票通常比单独买两张单程票便宜20%左右。.en: Buying a round-trip ticket is usually about 20% cheaper than buying two one-way tickets separately.

最好提前预订首尔到釜山的往返火车票。.en: It's best to book round-trip train tickets from Seoul to Busan in advance.

商务座卖光了，没办法只好订了经济舱。.en: Business class was sold out, so I had no choice but to book economy class.

虽然是经济舱，但座位间距很宽裕，长途飞行还挺舒服的。.en: Even though it was economy class, the seat pitch was quite spacious, so the long flight was pretty comfortable.

在韩国，中型车因为性价比和实用性最受欢迎。.en: In Korea, mid-size cars are the most popular because of their cost-effectiveness and practicality.

我正在了解租车，因为是家庭旅行，中型车应该就够了。.en: I'm looking into renting a car. Since it's a family trip, a mid-size car should be enough.

这次出差行程不确定，所以没买往返票，只买了单程票。.en: Since the itinerary for this business trip is uncertain, I didn't buy a round-trip ticket, only a one-way ticket.

单程机票有时比往返票还贵，最好比较一下。.en: One-way plane tickets are sometimes more expensive than round-trip tickets, so it's best to compare.

旺季机票价格会翻倍以上，最好提前预订。.en: During peak season, plane ticket prices can more than double, so it's best to book in advance.

因为行程突然变更，我在犹豫要不要退机票。.en: Because my plans suddenly changed, I'm hesitating about whether to cancel the plane ticket.

大型车停车时占地方多，在市中心有时不太方便。.en: Large cars take up a lot of space when parking, so they can be inconvenient in the city center sometimes.

行李多的话租大型车比较好，但缺点是油费更高。.en: If you have a lot of luggage, renting a large car is better, but the downside is higher fuel costs.

如果是团体旅行，包一辆巴士比用个人车辆更经济。.en: For a group trip, chartering a bus is more economical than using personal vehicles.

驾驶9座以上的巴士需要1类普通驾照。.en: Driving a bus with more than 9 seats requires a Class 1 regular driver's license.

电影越到后期越紧张，让人捏了一把汗。.en: The movie gets more tense toward the end, making you break out in a cold sweat.

这学期后期准备论文，应该会非常忙。.en: I'll be preparing my thesis in the latter part of this semester, so it should be very busy.

这个度假胜地以天然温泉闻名，游客常为了治疗皮肤病而到访。.en: This resort is famous for its natural hot springs, and tourists often visit to treat skin diseases.

由于温泉开发，周围地下水位下降，生态系统受到了干扰。.en: Due to hot spring development, the surrounding groundwater level dropped, and the ecosystem was disturbed.

登山路尽头的瀑布高达30多米，非常壮观。.en: The waterfall at the end of the hiking trail is over 30 meters high and very spectacular.

夏天去瀑布附近能感受到清凉的水雾，很受欢迎。.en: In summer, you can feel the cool mist near the waterfall, which is very popular.

躺在海边听着海浪声，感觉所有压力都消失了。.en: Lying by the seaside listening to the waves, I felt all my stress disappear.

这个海边游泳的话太深且浪大，请注意安全。.en: This seaside is too deep and the waves are big for swimming, so please be careful.

济州岛的汉拿山是过去火山活动形成的山。.en: Hallasan Mountain on Jeju Island is a mountain formed by past volcanic activity.

火山爆发时，不仅熔岩，火山灰也会造成巨大损害。.en: When a volcano erupts, not only lava but also volcanic ash causes great damage.

这本书能给人很大的人生感悟，我强烈推荐。.en: This book gives you a lot of life insights. I highly recommend it.

他把自己体验过的最好的餐厅推荐给了朋友。.en: He recommended the best restaurant he had ever been to to his friend.

为了健康，我决定减肥。.en: I decided to go on a diet for my health.

他通过运动和饮食疗法减掉了5公斤。.en: He lost 5 kilograms through exercise and diet therapy.

这个小区有传统市场，好吃的和可看的东西都很丰富。.en: This neighborhood has a traditional market, with plenty of good food and things to see.

庆典期间街头表演很多，值得看的东西接连不断。.en: During the festival, there are many street performances, and there's one worth seeing after another.

夏天穿薄薄的雪纺衫又凉快又好。.en: Wearing a thin chiffon blouse in summer is both cool and nice.

棉质的女士衬衫容易打理，所以我经常穿。.en: Cotton blouses are easy to care for, so I wear them often.

棉衬衫不熨烫的话会皱，看起来不整洁。.en: If you don't iron a cotton shirt, it gets wrinkled and looks untidy.

熨烫时如果不按面料设置合适的温度，衣服可能会损坏。.en: If you don't set the right temperature for the fabric when ironing, the clothes might get damaged.

正装在家很难洗，送去干洗比较安全。.en: Formal wear is hard to wash at home, so it's safer to send it to the dry cleaner.

频繁干洗可能会损伤面料，只在必要时送洗。.en: Frequent dry cleaning can damage the fabric, so only send it when necessary.

他生气要打架，但朋友们劝阻了他。.en: He was angry and about to fight, but his friends dissuaded him.

把被雨淋湿的衣服晾在阳光下好好晒干了。.en: I hung the rain-soaked clothes in the sun and dried them well.

掉进；沉迷；泄.en: fall into; be addicted to; leak

走路时脚意外掉进坑里，结果扭伤了脚踝。.en: While walking, my foot accidentally fell into a hole, and I sprained my ankle.

最近沉迷于一部电视剧，甚至忘了吃饭。.en: I've been so addicted to a TV series lately that I even forgot to eat.

袜子上破了个洞，但一直以忙为借口继续穿着。.en: There was a hole in my sock, but I kept wearing it, using being busy as an excuse.

口袋破了个洞，硬币可能丢了，钱包变轻了。.en: There was a hole in the pocket, so the coins might have fallen out, and the wallet felt lighter.

旅行期间决定把宠物托付给可靠的朋友。.en: I decided to entrust my pet to a reliable friend during the trip.

这份重要文件最好委托给能安全保管的地方。.en: It's best to entrust this important document to a place that can keep it safe.

红酒渍要赶快洗才能去掉。.en: You need to wash the red wine stain quickly to get it out.

衬衫上沾了污渍，我很慌张。.en: I was very flustered when the stain got on my shirt.

铅笔写的字用橡皮很容易擦掉，但圆珠笔的不容易擦掉。.en: Words written in pencil are easy to erase with an eraser, but ballpoint pen is not easy to erase.

随着时间流逝，当时的痛苦记忆也在一点点被抹去。.en: As time goes by, the painful memories of that time are gradually being erased.

这件针织品是羊毛材质的，保暖性好但打理起来麻烦。.en: This knitwear is made of wool, so it's warm but troublesome to care for.

洗针织品时最好翻过来用冷水手洗。.en: When washing knitwear, it's best to turn it inside out and hand wash in cold water.

贵的衣服用洗衣机洗可能会坏，所以原则上要手洗。.en: Expensive clothes might get damaged in the washing machine, so in principle they should be hand washed.

手洗时要用温水溶开中性洗涤剂，然后轻轻揉搓。.en: When hand washing, dissolve neutral detergent in warm water and then gently rub.

丝绸衬衫光泽很美，但怕汗，打理时需要留心。.en: Silk shirts have a beautiful sheen, but they are sensitive to sweat, so you need to be careful when caring for them.

丝绸面料建议干洗，水洗有变形的风险。.en: Silk fabric is recommended for dry cleaning; washing with water risks deformation.

我把孩子房间的壁纸换成了他喜欢的卡通角色，孩子非常开心。.en: I changed the wallpaper in my child's room to his favorite cartoon characters, and he was very happy.

要重新贴壁纸的话，得先处理发霉的部分。.en: If you want to reapply wallpaper, you have to deal with the moldy parts first.

有职业规划烦恼时，与专业咨询师商谈会有所帮助。.en: When you have career planning worries, consulting with a professional counselor can be helpful.

他因法律问题与律师商谈了好几个小时。.en: He consulted with a lawyer for several hours about a legal issue.
