这次专辑收录的歌曲中，抒情曲最受欢迎。.en: Among the songs on this album, the ballads are the most popular.

他用钢琴演奏了自己创作的曲子。.en: He played his own composition on the piano.

公司来了新员工，前辈们会一个一个教他们业务。.en: New employees joined the company, and the seniors teach them the work one by one.

大学新生在第一学期适应起来需要相当长的时间。.en: It takes quite a long time for college freshmen to adjust during the first semester.

一旦开始了，就要做到最后。.en: Once you start, you have to finish it.

在迎新会上，前辈们准备了有趣的表演。.en: At the welcome party, the seniors prepared fun performances.

参加了迎新会，我得到了关于学校生活的有用信息。.en: After attending the welcome party, I got useful information about school life.

每次年终聚餐都有特长表演时间，可以发挥平时隐藏的才华。.en: Every year-end dinner has a talent show time where you can show off your hidden skills.

他在特长表演中展示了魔术，赢得了同事们的掌声。.en: He performed magic in the talent show and earned applause from his colleagues.

母亲让我向父亲转达问候。.en: My mother told me to pass on her greetings to my father.

朋友来信中写着转达家人们问候的内容。.en: In the friend's letter, it said to pass on greetings from the family.

久别重逢的朋友先问了我的近况。.en: A friend I hadn't seen in a while first asked how I was doing.

她总是不会忘记在邮件中问候父母的近况。.en: She never forgets to ask about my parents' well-being in her emails.

因为挂念住在国外的朋友，我发了消息。.en: I sent a message because I missed my friend living abroad.

因为挂念许久未见的奶奶的近况，我们聊了好几个小时。.en: We talked for hours because I was worried about my grandmother whom I hadn't seen in a long time.

每到节日，我一定会给父母打问候电话。.en: I always make a greeting call to my parents on holidays.

他在忙碌中也从不怠慢给朋友打问候电话。.en: He never neglects to make a greeting call to his friends even when he's busy.

奶奶喜欢亲自给孙子写问候信。.en: Grandma likes to personally write a greeting letter to her grandson.

他每个月都会给在老家的父母写一封问候信。.en: He writes a greeting letter to his parents back home every month.

听说朋友生病了，我立刻发了问候短信。.en: I immediately sent a greeting text message when I heard my friend was sick.

新年第一天给熟人发问候短信是我们家的传统。.en: Sending a greeting text message to acquaintances on New Year's Day is a tradition in our family.

见到长辈时，先恭敬地请安是礼貌。.en: It is polite to respectfully pay respects when meeting elders.

节日里见到亲戚时，我总是会致以问候，关心他们的健康。.en: When I see relatives during the holidays, I always give greetings and ask about their health.

会议结束后，我们各自完成分配的任务吧。.en: After the meeting ends, let's each complete our assigned tasks.

旅行途中，大家分着吃了各自准备的零食。.en: During the trip, everyone shared the snacks they each prepared.

必须摆脱现有的填鸭式教育方式，引入学生自主探究的方式。.en: We must break away from the current rote-learning method and introduce a way where students explore on their own.

他解决问题的方式很独特，总是让周围的人感到惊讶。.en: His way of solving problems is very unique, always surprising those around him.

这次旅行的费用决定全部由公司负担。.en: It was decided that the company will bear all expenses for this trip.

他主动提出要负担朋友的学费。.en: He voluntarily offered to cover his friend's tuition.

今天和组员们有聚餐，可能会晚点回去。.en: I have a group dinner with my team members today, so I might go back a bit late.

在聚餐的场合上司突然问我的意见，我慌了神。.en: At the group dinner, my boss suddenly asked for my opinion, and I panicked.

他完全误解了我的话，心情变得不好了。.en: He completely misunderstood what I said, and his mood turned sour.

为了避免我们之间产生误会，必须把话说清楚。.en: To avoid any misunderstanding between us, we need to speak clearly.

聚餐后，很多人提议第二轮去练歌房。.en: After the group dinner, many people suggested going to a noraebang for the second round.

他提前预约好了第二轮的去处。.en: He made a reservation in advance for the second round venue.

她开始戴隐形眼镜来代替框架眼镜。.en: She started wearing contact lenses instead of glasses.

拍照时要注意别让镜头上沾上手印。.en: When taking photos, be careful not to get fingerprints on the lens.

这位设计师以个性鲜明的作品而闻名。.en: This designer is famous for works with a distinct personality.

尊重每个人的个性是良好团队合作的开始。.en: Respecting each person's personality is the start of good teamwork.

布置；打扮；编造；装修.en: decorate; dress up; make up; renovate

她按照自己的喜好把房间布置得精致可爱。.en: She decorated the room delicately and cutely according to her taste.

孩子为了生日派对亲自装饰了蛋糕。.en: The child decorated the cake himself for the birthday party.

再忙也要好好吃饭，这样才能维持健康。.en: No matter how busy you are, you should eat properly to maintain your health.

他有不守时的习惯，让周围的人都感到不便。.en: He has a habit of not being on time, which causes inconvenience to those around him.

上班路上在自动贩卖机接杯咖啡喝是我的早晨惯例。.en: Getting a cup of coffee from the vending machine on the way to work is my morning routine.

会议开始前想匆忙接杯咖啡，但硬币不够了。.en: I wanted to quickly grab a coffee before the meeting started, but I didn't have enough coins.

没办法.en: no way; there's nothing to be done

航班取消了，没办法只好再多待一天。.en: The flight was canceled, so there was nothing to do but stay another day.

他没办法取消了约会，决定在家休息。.en: He had no choice but to cancel his appointment and decided to rest at home.

有事；要办的事.en: errand; something to take care of

下午要去银行办点事，得出去一会儿。.en: I have to go to the bank this afternoon to take care of something, so I'll need to step out for a bit.

正在办事时突然来了个重要电话。.en: While I was taking care of something, an important call suddenly came in.

他觉得自己向后辈倾诉烦恼是一种负担。.en: He felt that confiding his worries to his junior was a burden.

为了减轻学费负担，我申请了奖学金。.en: To ease the burden of tuition, I applied for a scholarship.

分辨；辩解.en: to distinguish; to make an excuse

与其辩解迟到的理由，最好先道歉。.en: Rather than making excuses for being late, it's better to apologize first.

他有个习惯，总是为自己的错误辩解。.en: He has a habit of always making excuses for his mistakes.

虽然不能断定他的主张总是正确的，但在这次争论中他显然是对的。.en: Although I can't say his claims are always correct, he was clearly right in this argument.

从历史潮流来看，他们的选择是正确的，这一点随着时间推移得到了证明。.en: From the flow of history, their choice was correct, and this has been proven over time.

他每天都抱怨午餐菜单，但实际并不想换。.en: He complains about the lunch menu every day, but he doesn't actually want to change it.

经常听到同事抱怨工作量太大。.en: I often hear colleagues complaining that the workload is too heavy.

在韩国，长辈拿起餐具前先吃饭是违反餐桌礼仪的。.en: In Korea, it's against table manners to start eating before the elders pick up their utensils.

教外国朋友韩国的餐桌礼仪，他觉得很有趣。.en: When I taught my foreign friend about Korean table manners, he found it very interesting.

与其无条件听从父母的话，不如培养自己判断的能力。.en: Rather than unconditionally following your parents' words, it's better to develop your own judgment.

他一直保持着无条件反对对方意见的态度。.en: He has always maintained an attitude of unconditionally opposing the other person's opinion.

分不清那句话是真心还是玩笑。.en: I can't tell whether that remark was sincere or a joke.

我想传达真心道歉的心情。.en: I want to convey my sincere apology.

他的方言口音太重，我没能完全听懂。.en: His dialect accent was too strong, so I couldn't fully understand.

不管怎么解释，他都没能理解我的意图。.en: No matter how much I explained, he couldn't understand my intention.

对服务有不满请联系客服中心。.en: If you are dissatisfied with the service, please contact the customer service center.

他对公司福利有很多不满。.en: He has a lot of complaints about the company's benefits.

和第一次见面的人在一起时，总是感觉很尴尬。.en: I always feel awkward when I'm with someone I'm meeting for the first time.

突然陷入沉默，气氛变得有点尴尬了。.en: Suddenly there was silence, and the atmosphere became a bit awkward.

为了增加运动次数，我决定每天早上走30分钟。.en: To increase the number of times I exercise, I decided to walk for 30 minutes every morning.

这种药一天服用次数限制为三次。.en: This medicine is limited to three times a day.

他倾向于直接表达自己的意见，有时会招致误解。.en: He tends to express his opinions directly, which sometimes leads to misunderstandings.

上司直接向员工表达不满是不可取的。.en: It is not advisable for a boss to express dissatisfaction directly to employees.

担任；负责.en: take charge of; be responsible for

我把行李寄存在酒店了。.en: I left my luggage at the hotel.

坐在公园草坪上吃盒饭，度过了一个悠闲的下午。.en: I had a leisurely afternoon eating a packed lunch on the park lawn.

孩子们在草坪上奔跑的样子看起来非常和平。.en: The children running on the lawn looked very peaceful.

带盒饭；打包盒饭.en: pack a lunch; bring a packed lunch

为了健康，每天早上打包盒饭带到公司。.en: For my health, I pack a lunch and bring it to the office every morning.

去郊游的前一晚，妈妈给我打包了美味的盒饭。.en: The night before the picnic, my mom packed me a delicious lunch.

旅行时一定要带上头痛药或消化药之类的紧急用药。.en: When traveling, be sure to bring emergency medication like headache or digestive medicine.

包里放了紧急用药，但真需要时却找不到了。.en: I had emergency medication in my bag, but when I needed it, I couldn't find it.

找到了只有当地人才知道的隐藏美食店，去了一趟非常满意。.en: I found a hidden restaurant that only locals know about, and I was very satisfied after going there.

比起著名景点，在当地人推荐的地方获得了更好的体验。.en: I had a better experience at places recommended by locals than at famous tourist spots.

最近太忙了，没有时间见朋友。.en: I've been too busy lately to have time to see friends.

周末如果有时间，要不要一起去看电影？.en: If you have time this weekend, would you like to go see a movie together?

正好你需要的书在这里。.en: The book you need is right here.

正好时间合适，所以能一起去了。.en: The timing was just right, so we could go together.

虽然在国外生活了很久，但用母语思考仍然更舒服。.en: Even after living abroad for a long time, it's still more comfortable to think in my native language.

她的母语是英语，但韩语说得也很流利。.en: Her native language is English, but she also speaks Korean fluently.

听到学费上涨的消息，学生们上街举行了抗议示威。.en: Upon hearing the news of the tuition increase, students took to the streets to protest.

多亏了奖学金，学费负担减轻了很多。.en: Thanks to the scholarship, the burden of tuition fees has been greatly reduced.

因为面试在即，紧张得睡不好觉。.en: Because the interview is imminent, I'm so nervous I can't sleep well.

那家公司的面试更看重人品而非实务能力。.en: That company's interview values character more than practical skills.

提交研究生申请书之前，需要准备好推荐信。.en: Before submitting the graduate school application, you need to prepare letters of recommendation.

申请书的截止日期是下周五，得抓紧了。.en: The application deadline is next Friday, so we need to hurry.

最终合格者名单已在公司官网上公布。.en: The final list of successful candidates has been posted on the company's website.

据说会单独联系面试合格者。.en: They say they will contact the interview passers individually.

有职业方面的烦恼时，最好去学校的咨询室。.en: When you have career concerns, it's best to go to the school's counseling office.

他当场对上司的命令提出异议，结果遭到了严厉的斥责。.en: He immediately objected to his boss's order and ended up getting severely scolded.

这个问题不能再拖延了，必须马上制定解决方案。.en: This problem can't be delayed any longer; we must come up with a solution right away.

填写申请书时必须使用指定的用纸。.en: You must use the designated paper when filling out the application form.

打印机用纸用完了，赶紧去买了一趟。.en: The printer paper ran out, so I quickly went to buy some.

出问题.en: to have a problem / to go wrong

项目进行过程中出现了意想不到的问题，导致日程推迟了。.en: An unexpected problem occurred during the project, causing the schedule to be delayed.

突然网络出了问题，无法下载重要资料。.en: Suddenly the internet went down, and I couldn't download the important files.

前辈给了我真诚的忠告，但当时我没有认真听。.en: My senior gave me sincere advice, but I didn't listen carefully at the time.

对于朋友的恋爱问题，与其随便给忠告，不如只是倾听。.en: When it comes to a friend's love problems, rather than giving random advice, it's better to just listen.

在会议上不要害怕表达自己的意见，要积极参与。.en: Don't be afraid to express your opinion in meetings; participate actively.

他总是考虑对方的感受，小心地表达意见。.en: He always considers the other person's feelings and expresses his opinion carefully.

本来是开玩笑说的话，但那个朋友好像伤心了，我很抱歉。.en: I said it as a joke, but that friend seemed hurt, and I feel sorry.

要记住，如果总是表现出无视的态度，对方可能会感到伤心。.en: Keep in mind that if you always show a dismissive attitude, the other person might feel hurt.

一到教师节，就会想起小时候引导我的老师。.en: Whenever Teacher's Day comes, I think of the teacher who guided me when I was young.

真正的老师不仅是传授知识，更是教导人生智慧的人。.en: A true teacher is not just someone who imparts knowledge, but someone who teaches life wisdom.

这本书收录了韩国文学作品以及其他各种体裁的文章。.en: This book includes Korean literary works as well as various other genres of writing.

会议上讨论了预算问题，另外还追加了几项议题。.en: The budget issue was discussed in the meeting, and in addition, several other agenda items were added.

有职业规划方面的苦恼时，和学校的咨询老师聊聊会有很大帮助。.en: When you have worries about career planning, talking with a school counselor can be very helpful.

咨询老师倾听学生们的烦恼并给予适当建议，扮演着重要的角色。.en: Counselors play an important role by listening to students' concerns and giving them appropriate advice.

一下子；一次.en: all at once; in one go

如果想把工作一下子堆在一起做，效率反而会下降。.en: If you try to pile up work and do it all at once, your efficiency will actually decrease.

他为了把积压的作业一下子全部做完，熬了一整夜。.en: He stayed up all night to finish all the backlogged homework in one go.

熬夜；通宵.en: stay up all night; pull an all-nighter

考试期间，很多学生在图书馆熬夜学习。.en: During exam period, many students stay up all night studying in the library.

昨天熬夜工作，今天太累了，无法集中注意力。.en: I stayed up all night working yesterday, so today I'm too tired to concentrate.

突然接到了拜托，但没能爽快地拒绝，只好接了下来。.en: I was suddenly asked for a favor, but I couldn't refuse outright, so I just accepted it.

朋友拜托我保守秘密，这不是一件容易的事。.en: My friend asked me to keep a secret, and it's not an easy thing to do.

他是一个在百忙之中也会答应同事请求的宽容的人。.en: He is a generous person who agrees to his colleagues' requests even when he's very busy.

虽然是个很难的请求，但他爽快地答应了，真的很感谢。.en: Even though it was a difficult request, he readily agreed, and I was really grateful.

他不太懂如何礼貌地拒绝，怕对方心情不好。.en: He doesn't really know how to politely refuse, and he's afraid of making the other person feel bad.

遇到自己难以解决的问题时，向周围的人请求帮助是明智的。.en: When you encounter a problem that is difficult to solve on your own, it is wise to ask for help from those around you.

他因为自尊心，即使在困难的情况下也不轻易请求帮助。.en: Because of his pride, he doesn't easily ask for help even in difficult situations.

她从钱包里拿出一张一千韩元的纸币递给小孩。.en: She took out a 1,000 won bill from her wallet and handed it to the child.

小狗一看到主人，就高兴地伸出舌头摇着尾巴。.en: As soon as the puppy saw its owner, it happily stuck out its tongue and wagged its tail.

孩子现在刚开始能走两步了，非常可爱。.en: The child has just started to be able to take two steps, it's very cute.

他站在离我不到三步远的地方。.en: He stood less than three steps away from me.

他是一个总只考虑自己利益的利己的人，所以周围没什么朋友。.en: He is a selfish person who only considers his own interests, so he doesn't have many friends around.

自私的行为短期内可能有利，但长期来看会吃亏。.en: Selfish behavior may be beneficial in the short term, but in the long run, you will lose out.

在地方生活比在首尔生活费更少。.en: Living in the countryside costs less than living in Seoul.

地方的大学学生人数比较少。.en: Universities in the regions have fewer students.

在国际会议上，专业口译员会进行实时口译。.en: At international conferences, professional interpreters do real-time interpretation.

如果需要韩语口译，请随时联系我。.en: If you need Korean interpretation, please feel free to contact me anytime.

师母；对上司、长者妻子的敬称.en: wife of one's boss or elder; respectful term for a superior's wife

我们学院院长的师母亲自做了零食带来。.en: The wife of our academy's dean personally brought homemade snacks.

师母总是热情地迎接大家，所以公司气氛很和睦。.en: The boss's wife always greets everyone warmly, so the company atmosphere is very harmonious.

迎接；出迎.en: to greet; to go out to meet

我决定去机场迎接很久没来韩国的朋友。.en: I decided to go to the airport to greet a friend who hasn't been to Korea in a long time.

尽管下雨，他还是到车站来迎接了我。.en: Even though it was raining, he came to the station to greet me.

昨天没睡好所以今天无精打采。.en: I didn't sleep well yesterday, so I'm feeling listless today.

不吃早饭的话整个上午都没精神。.en: If I don't eat breakfast, I have no energy all morning.

韩国谚语中有句‘好的开始是成功的一半’，我觉得说得真对。.en: There's a Korean proverb that says 'A good start is half the battle,' and I think it's really true.

这句谚语简短地包含了人生教训，所以经常被引用。.en: This proverb contains a life lesson in a short phrase, so it's often quoted.

考试时作弊被老师发现了。.en: The teacher caught me cheating on the exam.

偷偷吃零食被妈妈发现了，挨了一顿骂。.en: Mom caught me sneaking snacks and scolded me.

看到那张照片，突然想起了小时候一起玩的朋友的脸。.en: Seeing that photo suddenly reminded me of the face of a friend I played with as a child.

太阳从地平线上升起的景象真是壮观。.en: The sight of the sun rising over the horizon was truly spectacular.

当时没有听那个人的话，至今仍然后悔。.en: I still regret not listening to that person at the time.

与其后悔，更重要的是现在努力改正错误。.en: Rather than regretting, it's more important to work hard to correct the mistakes now.

光是想象那个场面，我的心就怦怦直跳。.en: Just imagining that scene makes my heart pound.

想象和现实并不总是一致的。.en: Imagination and reality don't always match.

因为讨厌听妈妈的唠叨，故意进了房间。.en: Because I hated listening to my mom's nagging, I deliberately went into my room.

他总在小事上唠叨，让周围的人都觉得很烦。.en: He always nags about small things, which annoys everyone around him.

因为忘了约会时间，向朋友表达了歉意。.en: I apologized to my friend for forgetting the appointment time.

我忘了带钱包就出门了。.en: I left the house without bringing my wallet.

我们看着相册，回忆了童年时光。.en: We looked at the photo album and recalled our childhood.

每当听到那首歌，就会回忆起初恋。.en: Whenever I hear that song, I remember my first love.

挚友；密友；好朋友.en: close friend; bosom friend; best friend

他们是从小一起长大的挚友，知道彼此所有的秘密。.en: They are close friends who grew up together and know all of each other's secrets.

比赛失利后，挚友在身边安慰我，心情很快就好转了。.en: After losing the match, my close friend comforted me, and I felt better quickly.

这个城市在最近十年里取得了令人瞩目的发展。.en: This city has achieved remarkable development in the last ten years.

随着技术的发展，生活变得方便多了。.en: With the development of technology, life has become much more convenient.

他结束留学生活，计划下个月回国。.en: He finished his studies abroad and plans to return to his home country next month.

在海外分公司工作的父亲终于回国了。.en: My father, who was working at an overseas branch, finally returned home.

公司的财务状况不佳，结构调整不可避免。.en: The company's financial situation is not good, so restructuring is inevitable.

他因个人原因未能参加聚会。.en: He couldn't attend the party due to personal reasons.

不知不觉；不知什么时候.en: before one knows it; without realizing when

沉浸在谈话中，不知不觉夜已深了。.en: Lost in conversation, before I knew it, the night had grown deep.

因为长期游泳，肩膀变宽了。.en: Because I've been swimming for a long time, my shoulders have become broad.

他肩膀窄，穿衣服时肩部会松垮垮的。.en: He has narrow shoulders, so his clothes are loose around the shoulders.

弟弟/妹妹很内向，所以交新朋友需要很长时间。.en: My younger sibling is very introverted, so it takes a long time to make new friends.

我属于内向的性格，但在好朋友面前很活泼。.en: I have an introverted personality, but I'm lively in front of close friends.

弟弟/妹妹眉毛浓，不画眼妆也没关系。.en: My younger sibling has thick eyebrows, so it's fine even without eye makeup.

我眉毛淡，所以每天早上都画眉毛。.en: I have thin eyebrows, so I draw them every morning.

我有双眼皮，所以睫毛看起来更长。.en: I have double eyelids, so my eyelashes look longer.

那个朋友没有双眼皮，但眼睛非常漂亮。.en: That friend doesn't have double eyelids, but their eyes are very beautiful.

最近嘴唇厚的人很受欢迎。.en: Recently, people with thick lips are very popular.

奶奶嘴唇薄，涂口红很好看。.en: Grandma has thin lips, so lipstick looks good on her.

有人说额头宽的人看起来有智慧。.en: Some people say that people with wide foreheads look intelligent.

我额头窄，放下刘海脸看起来小。.en: I have a narrow forehead, so when I let my bangs down, my face looks small.

他表面上笑，但内心是悲伤的。.en: He smiles on the outside, but inside he is sad.

我总是对朋友坦率地说出内心想法。.en: I always frankly tell my friends what's on my mind.

在图书馆不能喧哗。.en: You can't be noisy in the library.

孩子们太吵闹了，我没法集中上课。.en: The kids were so loud that I couldn't concentrate on the lesson.

你的理想型是什么样的人？.en: What kind of person is your ideal type?

她说她的理想型是个子高又善良的男人。.en: She said her ideal type is a tall and kind man.

那个人比起外貌，性格更好。.en: That person has a better personality than appearance.

最近年轻人很注重外貌。.en: Young people these days care a lot about appearance.

今年想染成棕色。.en: I want to dye it brown this year.

染发的话头发可能会受损。.en: If you dye your hair, it might get damaged.

因为事情多，压力正在积累。.en: Stress is accumulating because there are many things to do.

压力积累时，最好通过运动来释放。.en: When stress accumulates, it's best to relieve it through exercise.

想在乡下买独栋住宅。.en: I want to buy a detached house in the countryside.

这栋住宅的花园非常漂亮。.en: The garden of this house is very beautiful.

朋友新搬进的别墅真的很漂亮。.en: The villa my friend just moved into is really beautiful.

别墅通常比公寓楼层低。.en: Villas are usually lower than apartments.

这栋别墅是去年新建的。.en: This villa was newly built last year.

因为是新建的公寓，所以有电梯。.en: Because it's a newly built apartment, there's an elevator.

这个酒店式公寓有健身房和洗衣房，设施齐全。.en: This serviced apartment has a gym and laundry room, fully equipped.

宿舍设施齐全，但房间有点小。.en: The dormitory has all facilities, but the room is a bit small.

因为在学校附近，周围很安静。.en: Because it's near the school, the surroundings are quiet.

我在找周围安静的房子。.en: I'm looking for a house with quiet surroundings.

这个房间窗户大，景观好。.en: This room has big windows and a good view.

因为楼层高景观好，但房租贵。.en: Because the floor is high, the view is good, but the rent is expensive.

我们的房东很亲切，人很好。.en: Our landlord is very kind and nice.

房东好的话可以长住。.en: If the landlord is good, you can stay long-term.

大学一年级的时候我住在寄宿房。.en: When I was a freshman in college, I lived in a boarding house.

这个寄宿房提供早晚饭，很方便。.en: This boarding house provides breakfast and dinner, which is very convenient.

因为准备考试，我住在考试院里。.en: Because I was preparing for exams, I lived in an exam study room.

考试院房间虽小但价格便宜。.en: The room in the exam study room is small but cheap.

明年我要去韩国留学。.en: Next year, I'm going to study abroad in Korea.

和妈妈一起去市场采购了。.en: I went grocery shopping with my mom at the market.

节日前采购的人很多。.en: There are a lot of people shopping before the holiday.

在韩国，向长辈低头问候。.en: In Korea, you bow to greet elders.

向第一次见面的人低头问候了。.en: I bowed and greeted someone I was meeting for the first time.

有禁止拍照的告示。.en: There is a sign saying no photography.

考试中禁止使用手机。.en: No cell phone use during the exam.

这间教室禁止使用手机。.en: No cell phone use in this classroom.

亲密的朋友之间说非敬语也没关系。.en: It's okay to use informal speech between close friends.

对长辈说非敬语是失礼的。.en: It's rude to use informal speech with elders.

对第一次见面的人说敬语是礼貌。.en: It's polite to use honorific speech with someone you meet for the first time.

在公司里对上司总是说敬语。.en: At work, I always use honorific speech with my superiors.

从长辈那里接东西时不能用单手接。.en: You can't receive something from an elder with one hand.

他用单手接了杯子递给朋友。.en: He took the cup with one hand and handed it to his friend.

在地铁上给老人让座了。.en: I gave up my seat to an elderly person on the subway.

在公交车上总是让座的人是好人。.en: A person who always gives up their seat on the bus is a good person.

姐姐上周生了孩子。.en: My older sister gave birth last week.

生下健康的宝宝是最重要的。.en: Having a healthy baby is the most important thing.

他这次晋升为科长了。.en: He got promoted to section chief this time.

我想努力工作得到晋升。.en: I want to work hard and get promoted.

我想成为律师。.en: I want to become a lawyer.

我和律师进行了咨询。.en: I had a consultation with a lawyer.

他对她一见钟情了。.en: He fell in love with her at first sight.

陷入爱河的话，一切看起来都很美好。.en: When you fall in love, everything looks beautiful.

每个周末都在动物保护所做志愿活动。.en: I do volunteer work at the animal shelter every weekend.

做志愿活动会让心里变温暖。.en: Doing volunteer work warms your heart.

明天去旅行真的很期待。.en: I'm really looking forward to going on the trip tomorrow.

想到要见新朋友就很期待。.en: I'm looking forward to meeting new friends.

泡面的水开了就放面饼。.en: Once the water for the ramen boils, put in the noodle block.

汤正在煮，马上就能吃了。.en: The soup is boiling, we can eat soon.

衣服脏了，得启动洗衣机。.en: The clothes are dirty, I need to start the washing machine.

在洗衣机运转的时候做其他家务。.en: Do other chores while the washing machine is running.

妈妈每天早上都会启动吸尘器打扫。.en: My mom starts the vacuum cleaner every morning to clean.

我为了打扫房间启动了吸尘器。.en: I started the vacuum cleaner to clean the room.

连休期间和家人一起度过了时光。.en: I spent time with my family during the long weekend.

下周有连休，所以要去旅行。.en: There's a long weekend next week, so I'm going to travel.

孩子们给长辈拜年并收到了压岁钱。.en: The children gave New Year's greetings to the elders and received lucky money.

春节早上去给爷爷奶奶拜年了。.en: On the morning of Lunar New Year, I went to pay respects to my grandparents.

春节的时候家人们聚在一起玩尤茨游戏。.en: During Lunar New Year, the family gathered and played Yut Nori.

和朋友玩尤茨游戏，愉快地度过了时光。.en: I played Yut Nori with friends and had a good time.

妈妈准备了很多美味的饭菜。.en: Mom prepared a lot of delicious food.

客人来了，正在准备饭菜。.en: Guests are coming, so we're preparing a meal.

旅行前买了旅游指南。.en: I bought a travel guide before the trip.

这本旅游指南里有很多美食店信息。.en: This travel guide has a lot of information about good restaurants.

中秋节和家人一起做松饼。.en: On Chuseok, I make songpyeon with my family.

松饼里放的馅料有好几种。.en: There are several types of fillings put inside songpyeon.

炎热的夏天喝冰凉的甜米露很好。.en: It's good to drink cold sikhye on a hot summer day.

甜米露又甜又凉，孩子们喜欢。.en: Sikhye is sweet and cold, so children like it.

今天是中秋节，满月非常明亮。.en: Today is Chuseok, and the full moon is very bright.

天空升起的满月真的很美。.en: The full moon rising in the sky is really beautiful.

生日那天在蛋糕前许愿了。.en: I made a wish in front of the cake on my birthday.

据说看着满月许愿就会实现。.en: They say if you make a wish while looking at the full moon, it will come true.

下雨了，还是在室内运动比较好。.en: It's raining, so it's better to exercise indoors.

图书馆是室内，所以要保持安静。.en: The library is indoors, so you need to keep quiet.

爷爷一辈子种田。.en: Grandpa farmed for his whole life.

今年的农活儿好像收成不错。.en: This year's farm work seems to have a good harvest.

今年雨水多，粮食长得很好。.en: There was a lot of rain this year, so the grain grew well.

大米是韩国人吃得最多的粮食。.en: Rice is the grain that Koreans eat the most.

在暗处撞到了墙。.en: I bumped into a wall in the dark.

在公交车里经常撞到人。.en: I often bump into people on the bus.

精神恍惚，手忙脚乱.en: dazed and confused, all in a fluster

最近事情太多了，手忙脚乱的。.en: There have been too many things lately, I'm all in a fluster.

孩子生病去了医院，忙得精神恍惚。.en: My child got sick and went to the hospital, I was so busy I was dazed and confused.

钱包丢了，出大事了。.en: I lost my wallet, it's a big trouble.

以为考试要迟到了吓了一跳，但并没有出大事。.en: I was startled thinking I was going to be late for the exam, but it wasn't a big deal.

花纹壁纸让房间变得温馨。.en: The patterned wallpaper made the room cozy.

因为一起生活，所以产生了感情。.en: Because we lived together, we developed feelings.

在这个小区住了很久，所以产生了很深的感情。.en: Having lived in this neighborhood for a long time, I developed deep feelings.

我后悔当时没有说出来。.en: I regret not saying it at the time.

因为决定得太快，所以很后悔。.en: Because I decided too quickly, I really regret it.

母亲每年冬天都会腌泡菜。.en: My mother makes kimchi every winter.

我和朋友一起学了腌泡菜的方法。.en: I learned how to make kimchi with a friend.

在韩国留学的时候，我住在寄宿家庭。.en: When I studied abroad in Korea, I stayed with a host family.

通过住在寄宿家庭，我学到了很多韩国文化。.en: By staying with a host family, I learned a lot about Korean culture.

亲切地对待客人很重要。.en: It's important to treat guests kindly.

他总是很有礼貌地对待父母。.en: He always treats his parents politely.

看了感人的电影，流下了眼泪。.en: I shed tears after watching a touching movie.

听到那个消息，流下了喜悦的泪水。.en: Upon hearing the news, I shed tears of joy.

因为每天练习，韩国语的实力提升了。.en: Because I practice every day, my Korean skills have improved.

通过这次比赛，实力提升了很多。.en: Through this competition, my skills have improved a lot.

冬天天气非常干燥。.en: The weather is very dry in winter.

对于干燥的皮肤，保湿霜很好。.en: Moisturizer is good for dry skin.

从上个星期开始，梅雨季开始了。.en: The rainy season started last week.

梅雨季一开始，就经常下雨。.en: Once the rainy season starts, it rains often.

听说明天要来台风，我很担心。.en: I heard a typhoon is coming tomorrow, so I'm worried.

台风一来，风和雨就会变得非常强。.en: Once the typhoon comes, the wind and rain will become very strong.

夏天湿度大，所以很不舒服。.en: The humidity is high in summer, so it's very uncomfortable.

今天湿度大，出了很多汗。.en: The humidity is high today, so I sweated a lot.

枫叶红了.en: The maple leaves have turned red.

一到秋天，山上枫叶就红了。.en: When autumn comes, the maple leaves on the mountain turn red.

枫叶红了的树真的非常美丽。.en: The trees with red maple leaves are truly beautiful.

时间过得太快了，我很惊讶。.en: Time passed too quickly, and I was surprised.

随着时间的流逝，一切都会好起来的。.en: As time goes by, everything will get better.

今天因为有事，所以约会迟到了。.en: I was late for the date today because I had something to do.

那个人因为有事情，所以没能来派对。.en: That person couldn't come to the party because they had something to do.

这学期我申请了18个学分，感觉会有点累。.en: I applied for 18 credits this semester, and I think it'll be a bit tiring.

为了毕业，以后还需要修满30个学分。.en: To graduate, I still need to earn 30 more credits.

要申请首尔大学经济学系，校内成绩很重要。.en: To apply to Seoul National University's Economics Department, your high school grades are important.

去年我申请了三所大学，但都落榜了。.en: Last year I applied to three universities, but I got rejected from all of them.

通过了韩国语能力考试，真的很高兴。.en: I passed the Korean Language Proficiency Test, and I'm really happy.

我对通过面试的朋友说了祝贺。.en: I congratulated my friend who passed the interview.

和父母一起参加了入学典礼，开始了大学生活。.en: I attended the entrance ceremony with my parents and started my college life.

为了没能参加入学典礼的学生，进行了视频转播。.en: A video broadcast was held for students who couldn't attend the entrance ceremony.

得到了教授的推荐，我决定申请奖学金。.en: I got a recommendation from my professor, so I decided to apply for a scholarship.

申请奖学金的期限到下周为止，得抓紧了。.en: The deadline to apply for the scholarship is next week, so I need to hurry.

在朋友的劝说下，我加入了音乐社团。.en: I joined the music club after my friend's persuasion.

要加入社团，需要提交一份简单的申请书。.en: To join a club, you need to submit a simple application form.

今年我决定参加体育大会的跑步项目。.en: This year I decided to participate in the running event at the sports festival.

参加体育大会的所有选手都尽了全力。.en: All the athletes participating in the sports festival gave their best.

考试考得太差，心情一团糟。.en: I did so poorly on the exam that my mood is a complete mess.

因为没有好好准备发表，发表内容一团糟。.en: Because I didn't prepare well for the presentation, the content was a complete mess.

在哲学课上，我有机会深入思考生命的意义。.en: In philosophy class, I had the chance to deeply think about the meaning of life.

虽然我的专业不是哲学，但我喜欢读相关书籍。.en: Even though my major isn't philosophy, I enjoy reading related books.

阿拉伯语是从右往左写的，一开始很难适应。.en: Arabic is written from right to left, so it was hard to get used to at first.

学校有阿拉伯语社团，我正在考虑要不要加入。.en: There's an Arabic club at school, and I'm thinking about whether to join.

学校庆典上举办了歌唱比赛。.en: A singing contest was held at the school festival.

他在歌唱比赛中得了第一名，获得了奖项。.en: He got first place in the singing contest and received an award.

公司为员工提供教育机会。.en: The company provides educational opportunities for employees.

他把比赛获得的奖金捐赠了。.en: He donated the prize money he won from the competition.

我很好奇奖金是多少。.en: I'm curious how much the prize money is.

这位歌手在年轻人中人气很旺。.en: This singer is very popular among young people.

那部电视剧播出时人气很旺。.en: That drama was very popular when it aired.

这学期我打算选韩国语课。.en: I plan to take a Korean language course this semester.

我每个周末都在做志愿服务活动。.en: I do volunteer service activities every weekend.

志愿服务是帮助他人的好机会。.en: Volunteer service is a good opportunity to help others.

明天有留学说明会。.en: There is a study abroad information session tomorrow.

参加说明会可以获得详细信息。.en: You can get detailed information by attending the information session.

食物垃圾要和一般垃圾分开扔。.en: Food waste must be separated from general waste when throwing it away.

一般垃圾请放入指定的垃圾袋扔掉。.en: Please put general waste in the designated trash bags and throw it away.

从地铁换乘公交车可以享受换乘优惠。.en: You can get a transfer discount when transferring from the subway to a bus.

多亏换乘优惠，能节省交通费。.en: Thanks to the transfer discount, I can save on transportation costs.

垃圾袋可以在小区超市买到。.en: You can buy trash bags at the neighborhood supermarket.

这个垃圾袋太小了，装不了大垃圾。.en: This trash bag is too small to hold large trash.

请跟着老师的发音练习。.en: Please practice following the teacher's pronunciation.

不可以照着朋友的行为做。.en: You shouldn't copy your friend's behavior.

可回收垃圾应该单独分类扔掉。.en: Recyclable waste should be sorted and thrown away separately.

这个箱子是可回收垃圾，请放进纸类回收箱。.en: This box is recyclable waste, please put it in the paper recycling bin.

上课时嚼口香糖可能会被老师批评。.en: Chewing gum in class might get you scolded by the teacher.

压力大的时候嚼口香糖，心情会放松一些。.en: When you're stressed, chewing gum can help you relax a bit.

我和你一样，也想看那部电影。.en: I'm the same as you, I also want to see that movie.

韩语和英语一样，都需要持续练习才能进步。.en: Korean and English are the same; both need continuous practice to improve.

我们系的助教老师告诉了提交作业的方法。.en: The teaching assistant in our department told us how to submit assignments.

助教协助教授指导学生们的实验。.en: The teaching assistant helps the professor guide students in their experiments.

听了专家的建议，我决定改变投资方式。.en: After listening to the expert's advice, I decided to change my investment method.

再好的建议，如果不实践也没用。.en: No matter how good the advice is, it's useless if you don't put it into practice.

我正在有意识地努力改掉抖腿的习惯。.en: I am consciously trying to break the habit of shaking my leg.

改掉孩子吸手指的习惯并不容易。.en: It's not easy to break a child's habit of sucking their fingers.

我正在养成每天早上读30分钟书的习惯。.en: I am forming the habit of reading a book for 30 minutes every morning.

从小养成运动的习惯很重要。.en: It's important to form the habit of exercising from a young age.

有好想法的话，一定要付诸实践很重要。.en: If you have a good idea, it's important to put it into practice.

不要只制定计划，从小事开始实践吧。.en: Don't just make plans; start practicing with small things.

我有紧张时就咬指甲的习惯。.en: I have a habit of biting my nails when I'm nervous.

咬指甲的话指甲会变脆弱，形状也不好看。.en: If you bite your nails, they become weak and look bad.

考试的时候有抖腿的习惯。.en: I have a habit of shaking my leg during exams.

抖腿可能会打扰到其他人。.en: Shaking your leg might bother other people.

父亲睡觉时打鼾很厉害。.en: My father snores loudly when he sleeps.

因为打呼噜有时候会对室友感到抱歉。.en: Sometimes I feel sorry for my roommate because of my snoring.

他解不出题，挠了挠头。.en: He couldn't solve the problem, so he scratched his head.

不知道该怎么回答，只是一直挠头。.en: He didn't know how to answer, so he just kept scratching his head.

长时间跷二郎腿坐着对健康不好。.en: Sitting with your legs crossed for a long time is bad for your health.

他舒服地跷着腿在看报纸。.en: He was sitting comfortably with his legs crossed, reading a newspaper.

想要安静，所以在医院选了单人间。.en: I wanted quiet, so I chose a single room at the hospital.

单人间比宿舍贵，但有个人空间所以很好。.en: A single room is more expensive than a dorm, but it's nice to have personal space.

下周学校要举办开学派对。.en: The school is having a welcome party next week.

在开学派对上交到了很多新朋友。.en: I made a lot of new friends at the welcome party.

通宵.en: all night / staying up all night

和朋友聊了整整一晚上。.en: I talked with my friend all night long.

通宵复习考试，太累了。.en: Staying up all night to study for the exam was too tiring.

苦恼要不要继续做这件事，真的很痛苦。.en: I'm really struggling with whether to keep doing this or not.

一个人待的时间太长，有时候会很难受。.en: Sometimes it feels really hard when I spend too much time alone.

心情好，在房间里放了欢快的音乐。.en: Feeling good, I played some cheerful music in my room.

学习的时候会放安静的音乐来学习。.en: When I study, I put on quiet music to study with.

无可奈何.en: can't help it / no choice / helpless

飞机晚点了，只能等着，没办法。.en: The flight was delayed, so I just had to wait — there was nothing I could do.

已经过去的事情没办法，以后好好做吧。.en: What's done is done, so let's do better from now on.

散步消了气之后，心情好了一些。.en: After cooling off by walking, I felt a bit better.

朋友道歉了，所以决定消气。.en: My friend apologized, so I decided to let go of my anger.

错过了公交车，没办法只好坐出租车。.en: I missed the bus, so I had no choice but to take a taxi.

已经约好了，没办法只好去。.en: I already made a promise, so I had no choice but to go.

这个秘密绝对不可以告诉任何人。.en: You must never tell this secret to anyone.

他是一个绝对不会说谎的人。.en: He is a person who would never lie.

在抱怨之前，请先想想解决办法。.en: Before complaining, please think of a solution first.

每天听同样的抱怨，我都听腻了。.en: I'm tired of hearing the same complaints every day.

他听了朋友的抱怨并安慰了他。.en: He listened to his friend's complaints and comforted him.

弟弟因为说谎而挨了父亲的骂。.en: The younger brother got scolded by his father for lying.

丈夫晚归的话妻子就会唠叨。.en: If the husband comes home late, the wife nags.

每天听同样的唠叨真的很累。.en: Listening to the same nagging every day is really tiring.

他听了妈妈的唠叨后默默地进了房间。.en: He listened to his mom's nagging and went into his room silently.

昨晚闪电打雷，我没能睡好觉。.en: Last night there was lightning and thunder, so I couldn't sleep well.

突然闪电，雷声开始轰鸣。.en: Suddenly there was lightning, and thunder began to roar.

夏天有时最高气温会接近40度。.en: In summer, the highest temperature sometimes gets close to 40 degrees.

预计明天最低气温是零下5度。.en: Tomorrow's lowest temperature is expected to be minus 5 degrees.

冬天最低气温有时会降到零下10度以下。.en: In winter, the lowest temperature sometimes drops below minus 10 degrees.

今天白天气温会上升到零上12度。.en: Today's daytime temperature will rise to 12 degrees above zero.

到了春天气温升到零上，变得暖和了。.en: When spring comes, the temperature rises above zero and it gets warm.

昨晚气温降到了零下8度。.en: Last night, the temperature dropped to minus 8 degrees.

零下的天气里路会结冰打滑，请小心。.en: In below-zero weather, the roads get icy and slippery, so please be careful.

玻璃窗被石头击中而破碎了。.en: The glass window was hit by a stone and shattered.

因为暴雨，老旧的围墙倒塌了。.en: Because of the heavy rain, the old wall collapsed.

阵雨过后，天空放晴了。.en: After the shower, the sky cleared up.

下暴雨时最好不要外出。.en: It's best not to go out when it's pouring rain.

从昨晚开始下大雪，上班路很艰难。.en: It's been snowing heavily since last night, so the commute was tough.

大雪过后，整个村子都变成了白色。.en: After the heavy snow, the whole village turned white.

洪水发生后，居民们转移到了安全的地方。.en: After the flood, the residents moved to a safe place.

今年几乎没下雨，全国范围内发生了干旱。.en: It hardly rained this year, and a drought occurred nationwide.

如果发生干旱，农作物就很难生长。.en: If a drought occurs, crops have a hard time growing.

早上雾气很大，看不清前方。.en: It was very foggy in the morning, and I couldn't see ahead clearly.

不管怎么说，还是亲自去确认一下比较好。.en: Anyway, it's better to go and check in person.

昨天因为超速被警察开了罚单。.en: I got a ticket from the police for speeding yesterday.

过马路时左右环顾四周是基本常识。.en: Looking left and right when crossing the street is basic common sense.

停车前一定要环顾四周，慢慢操作。.en: Before parking, be sure to look around and operate slowly.

他因为驾驶不熟练最终还是出了事故。.en: He ended up having an accident because he wasn't skilled at driving.

酒后驾车给别人造成事故的风险很大。.en: Drunk driving poses a high risk of causing accidents to others.

上周朋友遭遇了交通事故，住院了。.en: Last week, a friend got into a traffic accident and was hospitalized.

遭遇事故之后，开车时变得更小心了。.en: After getting into an accident, I became more careful when driving.

被困在电梯里时应该按紧急按钮。.en: When you get stuck in an elevator, you should press the emergency button.

昨天在公司被困在电梯里，等了30分钟。.en: Yesterday, I got stuck in the elevator at work and waited for 30 minutes.

爬山时要小心不要被蛇咬到。.en: When hiking, be careful not to get bitten by a snake.

他在露营时被蛇咬了，去了医院。.en: He got bitten by a snake while camping and went to the hospital.

在雪路上差点滑倒，但幸好没受伤。.en: I almost slipped on the snowy road, but luckily I wasn't hurt.

冬天在雪路上容易滑倒，请慢慢走。.en: In winter, it's easy to slip on snowy roads, so please walk slowly.

父亲因胃癌预定明天做手术。.en: My father is scheduled to have surgery tomorrow due to stomach cancer.

医生说要手术前必须禁食。.en: The doctor said you must fast before surgery.

为了健康检查，我在医院接受了血液检查。.en: I had a blood test at the hospital for a health checkup.

入职前必须接受身体检查。.en: You must have a physical examination before starting a job.

奶奶最近身体不舒服，去了医院。.en: Grandma hasn't been feeling well lately, so she went to the hospital.

老师身体不舒服，所以今天的课取消了。.en: The teacher wasn't feeling well, so today's class was canceled.

累的时候靠在墙上休息一会儿比较好。.en: When you're tired, it's better to lean against the wall and rest for a bit.

每当遇到困难时，我倾向于依靠朋友。.en: Whenever I face difficulties, I tend to rely on my friends.

因为丢了钱包，我向警察局报了失。.en: Because I lost my wallet, I reported it to the police station.

如果看到违章停放的车辆，请立即举报。.en: If you see an illegally parked car, please report it immediately.

负责医生告诉我明天的手术日程。.en: The attending physician told me about tomorrow's surgery schedule.

患者在与负责医生商谈后决定出院。.en: The patient decided to be discharged after consulting with the attending physician.

现在那件事很急，不要想别的。.en: That matter is urgent now, don't think about other things.

除了这个，我可以选别的吗？.en: Can I choose something other than this?

电梯里有紧急电话。.en: There is an emergency phone in the elevator.

迷路时请使用紧急电话请求帮助。.en: If you are lost, use the emergency phone to ask for help.

为了拍摄婚礼照片，我们雇佣了摄影师。.en: We hired a photographer to take wedding photos.

电影拍摄预计从明天开始。.en: The movie filming is scheduled to start tomorrow.

在韩国，为了纪念去世的祖先会举行祭祀。.en: In Korea, ancestral rites are held to honor deceased ancestors.

准备祭祀食物并不容易。.en: Preparing ancestral rite food is not easy.

每到奶奶忌日，全家人都会聚在一起举行祭祀。.en: Every year on Grandma's death anniversary, the whole family gathers to hold an ancestral rite.

最近很多家庭都简化了祭祀仪式。.en: Recently, many families have simplified the ancestral rite ceremony.

拜年；行大礼.en: New Year's bow; perform a deep bow

春节早上给父母拜年并送上新年问候。.en: On the morning of Lunar New Year, I bow to my parents and give them New Year's greetings.

孩子们给长辈拜年的样子真的很可爱。.en: The children bowing to the elders on New Year's Day is really cute.

春节时全家人一起玩民俗游戏。.en: During Lunar New Year, the whole family plays folk games together.

学校教学生们各种民俗游戏。.en: The school teaches students various folk games.

父母节我给父母胸前戴上了红色康乃馨。.en: On Parents' Day, I pinned a red carnation on my parents' chest.

这朵康乃馨真的很新鲜又漂亮。.en: This carnation is really fresh and pretty.

光复节挂太极旗是礼仪。.en: It is proper etiquette to hang the Taegeukgi on Gwangbokjeol.

我们家人光复节去了博物馆学习历史。.en: My family went to the museum on Liberation Day to learn history.

离别虽然总是伤感的，但也意味着新的开始。.en: Parting is always sad, but it also means a new beginning.

他们在机场分别后各自去了不同的国家。.en: They parted at the airport and each went to a different country.

我经常思念在故乡的父母。.en: I often miss my parents back in my hometown.

时隔很久见到朋友，聊了很多思念的话。.en: Meeting a friend after a long time, we talked a lot about how much we missed each other.

第一次约会之前心里非常激动。.en: Before the first date, my heart was really fluttering.

每次听到他的声音我都会心动。.en: Every time I hear his voice, my heart flutters.

在喜欢的人面前心跳加速是很正常的。.en: It's normal for your heart to race in front of someone you like.

等待考试结果时心脏一直怦怦跳。.en: My heart was pounding while waiting for the exam results.

听说他对她一见钟情，马上就表白了。.en: I heard he fell in love at first sight with her and confessed right away.

电影里的主人公们一见钟情，陷入了命运般的爱情。.en: The protagonists in the movie fell in love at first sight and entered a fateful romance.

那个人性格非常有魅力，很多人都喜欢他。.en: That person's personality is very charming, so many people like him.

这个城市历史和现代共存，非常有魅力。.en: This city has both history and modernity, making it very charming.

具有魅力.en: to have charm / to be attractive

她的笑容非常具有魅力，让周围的人感到幸福。.en: Her smile is very charming, making those around her feel happy.

这本书的结局难以预测，对读者来说很有魅力。.en: The ending of this book is hard to predict, which makes it very appealing to readers.

有幽默感.en: to have a sense of humor

他很有幽默感，和他在一起总是笑声不断。.en: He has a great sense of humor, so there's always laughter when you're with him.

在相亲中，对方有幽默感真的很重要。.en: In a blind date, it's really important that the other person has a sense of humor.

那位总是用和蔼的微笑迎接客人。.en: That person always greets customers with a kind smile.

虽然是第一次见面，但您友善地对待我，非常感谢。.en: Even though it was our first meeting, you treated me kindly—thank you very much.

去欧洲度蜜月是我的梦想。.en: Going to Europe for a honeymoon is my dream.

把蜜月旅行照片给朋友们看，大家都羡慕了。.en: When I showed my friends the honeymoon photos, everyone was envious.

他们因为性格差异最终决定离婚。.en: They ultimately decided to divorce due to personality differences.

离婚后也为了孩子努力维持良好的关系。.en: Even after divorce, they try to maintain a good relationship for the sake of their children.

他只要看到女朋友和其他男人说话就会嫉妒。.en: He gets jealous just seeing his girlfriend talk to other men.

也有人认为嫉妒是爱的证据。.en: Some people think jealousy is proof of love.

尊重彼此的意见是维持良好关系的秘诀。.en: Respecting each other's opinions is the secret to maintaining a good relationship.

我尊重父母的决定，但也说出了自己的想法。.en: I respected my parents' decision, but I also expressed my own thoughts.

写自我介绍书时最好强调具体的经历。.en: When writing a self-introduction, it's best to emphasize specific experiences.

这家公司规定自我介绍书的篇幅为A4一张纸。.en: This company requires the self-introduction to be one A4 page long.

昨天在那家公司参加了面试，气氛非常好。.en: I attended an interview at that company yesterday, and the atmosphere was very good.

参加面试时总是穿正装是礼貌。.en: It's polite to always wear formal attire when attending an interview.

这个职种的平均年薪是多少？.en: What is the average annual salary for this job type?

谈年薪时要好好展现自己的价值。.en: When negotiating your annual salary, you should properly demonstrate your value.

突然生病，不得已缺勤了。.en: I suddenly got sick and had to be absent.

缺勤的话工资会扣掉一天的钱。.en: If you're absent, they'll deduct a day's pay from your salary.

这个职位需要3年以上的相关经历。.en: This position requires more than three years of relevant experience.

资历越多的应聘者在面试中越有利。.en: Applicants with more experience have an advantage in the interview.

要在外企就业，外语能力很重要。.en: Foreign language ability is important to get a job at a foreign company.

他外语能力优秀，所以经常去海外出差。.en: He has excellent foreign language skills, so he often goes on overseas business trips.

为了健康，最好养成规律运动的习惯。.en: For your health, it's best to get into the habit of regular exercise.

他因为每天早晨规律运动，体力变好了。.en: He got stronger because he exercises regularly every morning.

每天早上有很多人在汉江公园慢跑。.en: Every morning, many people jog in Hangang Park.

因为下雨，今天没能慢跑，在家休息了。.en: Because it rained, I couldn't jog today and rested at home.

最近健身房注册费很贵，所以很苦恼。.en: Recently, gym registration fees are very expensive, so I'm really troubled.

去健身房的话，主要做跑步机和重量训练。.en: When I go to the gym, I mainly use the treadmill and do weight training.

他在健身房努力运动，肌肉非常好。.en: He works out hard at the gym, so his muscles are very well-developed.

要想长肌肉，吃富含蛋白质的食物很重要。.en: To build muscle, it's important to eat foods rich in protein.

医生建议为了健康要减重。.en: The doctor recommended losing weight for health reasons.

要想减重，运动和饮食疗法并行是有效的。.en: To lose weight, combining exercise and diet is effective.

夏天临近，很多人开始节食减肥。.en: As summer approaches, many people start dieting.

过度节食减肥可能对健康不好。.en: Excessive dieting can be bad for your health.

为了减肥，提前制定了一周的饮食计划。.en: To lose weight, I made a weekly diet plan in advance.

保持健康的饮食计划对体重管理很重要。.en: Maintaining a healthy diet plan is important for weight management.

每天三餐均衡饮食是健康的基础。.en: Eating three balanced meals a day is the foundation of good health.

为了均衡饮食，均匀地吃蔬菜和蛋白质。.en: To eat a balanced diet, eat vegetables and protein evenly.

为了健康，我下决心一定要戒烟。.en: For my health, I made up my mind to quit smoking.

戒烟过了6个月，咳嗽明显减少了。.en: Six months after quitting smoking, my coughing noticeably decreased.

昨天收到了朋友发来的周岁宴邀请函。.en: Yesterday I received a first birthday party invitation from a friend.

邀请函上详细写着派对的日期和地点。.en: The invitation letter has the date and location of the party written in detail.

大家一起站起来，庆祝新年并干了杯。.en: Everyone stood up together, celebrated the new year, and clinked glasses.

他提议为新郎新娘干杯。.en: He proposed a toast to the bride and groom.

我们班同学的共同点是都喜欢韩剧。.en: The common ground among my classmates is that we all like Korean dramas.

那个人和我性格不同，但在价值观上有很多共同点。.en: That person and I have different personalities, but we have a lot of common ground in values.

坚守岗位；一直在.en: Stay at one's post; always be there

直到会议结束都坚守岗位是基本礼仪。.en: Staying at your post until the meeting ends is basic etiquette.

在客人到来之前，必须一直待在座位上。.en: You must stay in your seat until the guests arrive.

电影结束前，偶尔会有人离席。.en: Occasionally, someone leaves their seat before the movie ends.

因为发生了急事，不得不在会议中途离开。.en: Because of an emergency, I had to leave in the middle of the meeting.

送礼物时，我觉得漂亮的包装很重要。.en: When giving a gift, I think nice packaging is important.

如果要求打包食物，请用纸盒装好。.en: If you ask to pack the food, please put it in a paper box.

在农村，生活节奏比城市慢，更悠闲。.en: In the countryside, the pace of life is slower and more relaxed than in the city.

最近在年轻人之间，搬到农村去住很流行。.en: Recently, moving to the countryside has become popular among young people.

上下班时间交通堵塞太严重了，很有压力。.en: Traffic jams during rush hour are so bad, it's stressful.

要避免交通堵塞的话，最好坐地铁。.en: To avoid traffic jams, it's best to take the subway.

大医院就在附近，医疗设施算是很好的。.en: The big hospital is nearby, so the medical facilities are pretty good.

乡下医疗设施不足，生病了就麻烦了。.en: Medical facilities are lacking in the countryside, so it's a problem if you get sick.

这个地区教育环境好，很多年轻父母住在这里。.en: This area has a good educational environment, so many young parents live here.

教育环境不好的话，孩子们学习会很困难。.en: If the educational environment is poor, it will be hard for children to study.

最近找工作真的很不容易。.en: Finding a job is really hard these days.

这个城市就业岗位多，很多年轻人来找工作。.en: This city has many job opportunities, so a lot of young people come here looking for work.

城市人口多很复杂，但可以做的事情也很多。.en: A city with a large population is complicated, but there are also many things you can do.

乡下人口少，安静而且空气好。.en: The countryside has a small population, so it's quiet and the air is good.

最近房价涨得太厉害，年轻人很难买房。.en: Housing prices have risen too much recently, so it's hard for young people to buy a house.

这个小区房价贵，但住起来很好。.en: Housing prices in this neighborhood are expensive, but it's nice to live in.

江南房价高，普通人很难住。.en: Housing prices in Gangnam are high, so it's hard for ordinary people to live there.

地方房价低，比较容易买房。.en: Housing prices in the countryside are low, so it's relatively easy to buy a house.

随着工厂增多，环境污染变得严重了。.en: As factories increase, environmental pollution has become serious.

为了减少环境污染，我们都需要努力。.en: To reduce environmental pollution, we all need to make an effort.

每到周末，很多人去公园享受大自然。.en: Every weekend, many people go to the park to enjoy nature.

我最喜欢一边爬山一边享受大自然。.en: I like enjoying nature while hiking the most.

年轻人在网上消费很多钱。.en: Young people spend a lot of money online.

养成只消费必需品的习惯比较好。.en: It's better to develop a habit of only spending on necessities.

好好管理收支是理财的基础。.en: Managing income and expenses well is the foundation of financial management.

记录收支就能知道钱花到哪里去了。.en: If you record your income and expenses, you can know where your money goes.

物价上涨的话，老百姓的生活会更困难。.en: If prices go up, ordinary people's lives will become more difficult.

今年物价也涨了很多，我得要多点零花钱了。.en: Prices have gone up a lot this year too, so I'll need more pocket money.

我努力学习，这学期获得了奖学金。.en: I studied hard and got a scholarship this semester.

想要获得奖学金，就要保持好成绩。.en: To get a scholarship, you need to keep good grades.

即使很忙，有业余爱好活动对缓解压力很好。.en: Even if you're busy, having a hobby activity is good for relieving stress.

我每个周末都去拍照作为业余爱好活动。.en: I go take photos every weekend as a hobby activity.

从小时候开始演奏乐器就是我的梦想。.en: Playing a musical instrument has been my dream since I was little.

和朋友一起演奏乐器的话，时间过得很快。.en: If you play a musical instrument with friends, time goes by quickly.

她从小学的时候开始拉小提琴。.en: She has been playing the violin since elementary school.

拉小提琴的样子看起来真的很优雅。.en: The way she plays the violin looks really elegant.

今年夏天计划和朋友们在河边露营。.en: I'm planning to go camping by the river with friends this summer.

露营的时候自己做饭吃是最大的乐趣。.en: The best part of camping is cooking and eating your own food.

放假期间做志愿活动，度过了有意义的时间。.en: I did volunteer activities during the vacation and had a meaningful time.

志愿活动不仅帮助别人，也让自己成长。.en: Volunteer activities not only help others but also help you grow.

我每个周末都在动物保护所做志愿活动。.en: I do volunteer activities at the animal shelter every weekend.

做志愿活动时能帮助别人，所以很开心。.en: When I do volunteer activities, I can help others, so I'm very happy.

昨晚下了很多雪，路上积了雪。.en: It snowed a lot last night, and the roads are covered with snow.

在积雪的院子里，孩子们正在堆雪人。.en: In the snow-covered yard, children are making a snowman.

那个传闻不是事实，请不要相信。.en: That rumor isn't true, so please don't believe it.

因为谣言，朋友之间的关系变差了。.en: Because of the rumor, the relationship between friends got worse.

因为没有确认约定时间，迟到了整整一个小时。.en: Because I didn't confirm the appointment time, I was a whole hour late.

他没有确认事实就轻易相信了。.en: He believed it easily without confirming the facts.

她过了很长时间才终于能原谅他。.en: It took her a long time to finally forgive him.

原谅自己的错误也很重要。.en: Forgiving your own mistakes is also important.

我对他们的信念绝不会动摇。.en: My belief in them will never waver.

老朋友之间有一种特别的信任。.en: There is a special trust between old friends.

因为一个小小的误会，和朋友的关系变差了。.en: Because of a small misunderstanding, my relationship with my friend worsened.

他们因为持续的争吵，关系渐渐变差了。.en: Their relationship gradually worsened due to constant arguments.

热门音乐剧的门票真的很难预购。.en: Tickets for popular musicals are really hard to get in advance.

可以通过网络方便地预购门票。.en: You can conveniently purchase advance tickets online.

这部电影的主角是一个勇敢的少女。.en: The main character of this movie is a brave young girl.

他在话剧中担任主角，展现了精彩的演技。.en: He played the main role in the play and showed amazing acting skills.

看完电影后我在博客上写了评论。.en: After watching the movie, I wrote a review on my blog.

我想写这本书的评论，能给我一些建议吗？.en: I want to write a review of this book. Can you give me some advice?

这座城市的文化艺术非常发达。.en: The culture and arts in this city are very developed.

经常参加文化艺术活动是很好的。.en: It's good to often participate in cultural and artistic activities.

那个学生理解力强，复杂的概念也能很快掌握。.en: That student has a quick understanding and can grasp complex concepts fast.

团队成员理解快，项目进度比预想快得多。.en: The team members understand quickly, so the project is progressing much faster than expected.

那座建筑艺术价值很高，吸引了众多游客。.en: That building has high artistic value and attracts many tourists.

为了培养艺术感，经常参观展览会比较好。.en: To cultivate an artistic sense, it's better to often visit exhibitions.

这个包设计漂亮而且收纳空间多，很实用。.en: This bag has a pretty design and lots of storage space, so it's very practical.

您给了实用的建议，我的生活方便多了。.en: You gave me practical advice, and my life has become much more convenient.

总有一天我一定要环游世界，体验多样的文化。.en: Someday I will definitely travel around the world and experience diverse cultures.

他相信总有一天自己的小说会成为畅销书。.en: He believes that someday his novel will become a bestseller.

适应新的公司文化花了相当长的时间。.en: It took quite a long time to adapt to the new company culture.

即使在极端环境下，人类也会以惊人的速度适应。.en: Even in extreme environments, humans adapt at an amazing speed.

那位实习员工业务能力突出，收到了转正邀请。.en: That intern stood out with their work skills and received an offer to become a regular employee.

实习员工时期学到的基本功至今仍大有帮助。.en: The basics I learned during my time as an intern are still very helpful.

他通过了1000比1的竞争率，被选为最终合格者。.en: He passed a competition rate of 1000 to 1 and was selected as the final successful candidate.

这次征集活动中我的设计被选为一等奖，让我大吃一惊。.en: I was surprised that my design was selected for first prize in this contest.

他击败了数百名竞争者，通过了主角试演。.en: He beat out hundreds of competitors and passed the audition for the lead role.

试演当天因为紧张，完全没能发挥出平时的实力。.en: On the day of the audition, I was so nervous that I couldn't show my usual skills at all.

他经历了无数次挫折，但最终还是实现了梦想。.en: He experienced countless setbacks, but in the end, he achieved his dream.

为了实现梦想，比起单纯的努力，更需要策略性的方法。.en: To achieve your dream, you need a strategic approach rather than just hard work.

解释这两种理论的差异点应该会出现在考试中。.en: Explaining the differences between these two theories should appear on the exam.

理解文化差异是国际商务的第一步。.en: Understanding cultural differences is the first step in international business.

虽然寄错了信，但幸好能从邮局取回来。.en: Although the letter was sent to the wrong address, luckily I was able to get it back from the post office.

这款节能产品从长远来看是非常经济的选择。.en: This energy-saving product is a very economical choice in the long run.

尽管经济困难，他仍没有放弃学业，坚持到了最后。.en: Despite economic difficulties, he did not give up his studies and persevered to the end.

两个地区的经济水平存在显著差异，政策方法也应有所不同。.en: There is a significant difference in the economic levels of the two regions, so policy approaches should also differ.

如果言语和行为之间存在差异，就难以获得信任。.en: If there is a difference between words and actions, it's hard to gain trust.

她的画作以强烈的色彩和独特的构图吸引着观众的视线。.en: Her paintings attract viewers' attention with strong colors and unique compositions.

该地区独有的独特建筑风格对游客来说是一大魅力。.en: The unique architectural style of the region is a major attraction for tourists.

她有收集复古茶杯的爱好，每个周末都去古董市场。.en: She has a hobby of collecting vintage teacups and goes to the antique market every weekend.

茶杯边缘有一道小裂纹，倒热茶时要小心。.en: There's a small crack on the rim of the teacup, so be careful when pouring hot tea.

在机场找行李箱时，有两个和我的一模一样的款式，让我混淆了。.en: When looking for my suitcase at the airport, there were two that looked exactly like mine, which confused me.

他一打开行李箱就开始嚎啕大哭。我很好奇里面到底装了什么。.en: As soon as he opened the suitcase, he started sobbing loudly. I was curious about what was inside.

去寺庙时总能闻到的焚香味让我心情平静，非常喜欢。.en: The scent of incense that I always smell when visiting temples calms my mind, and I really like it.

这种香味太浓了，闻久了反而可能会引起头痛。.en: This scent is too strong; smelling it for too long might actually cause a headache.

那个人傲慢的语气是让听者感到不舒服的主要原因。.en: That person's arrogant tone of voice is the main reason listeners feel uncomfortable.

因为语气问题被上司误会过，所以最近说话变得小心了。.en: I was misunderstood by my boss because of my tone of voice, so I've been more careful when speaking lately.

仅凭一个感叹词就能准确传达说话人的心情和态度。.en: Just one interjection can accurately convey the speaker's feelings and attitude.

为了不重复同样的错误，彻底的复盘过程是必须的。.en: In order not to repeat the same mistakes, a thorough review process is necessary.

他每天重复同样的话，让周围的人都感到疲惫。.en: He repeats the same words every day, making everyone around him tired.

现代人如果过度依赖数字设备，记忆力可能会逐渐退化。.en: If modern people rely too much on digital devices, their memory may gradually decline.

现代人最大的烦恼之一就是如何平衡工作与生活。.en: One of the biggest worries of modern people is how to balance work and life.

这个研究小组由10名各领域的专家组成。.en: This research team is composed of 10 experts from various fields.

爱彼迎的收益由住宿预订和体验活动构成。.en: Airbnb's revenue is made up of accommodation bookings and experience activities.

这个宇宙中可能存在着我们尚未发现的生命体。.en: There may be life forms in this universe that we have not yet discovered.

完美的制度是不存在的，总有改进的余地。.en: A perfect system does not exist; there is always room for improvement.

在韩国，传统上成人礼时有喝浊酒的风俗。.en: In Korea, traditionally there is a custom of drinking makgeolli at coming-of-age ceremonies.

成人礼不只是一个活动，更是唤醒作为社会成员责任的场合。.en: A coming-of-age ceremony is not just an event, but an occasion to awaken one's responsibility as a member of society.

这部剧从首播起就人气爆棚，创下了收视率第一的记录。.en: This drama has been hugely popular since its first episode, setting a record for the highest viewership ratings.

那位歌手在年轻人中尤其有人气，演唱会门票总是售罄。.en: That singer is especially popular among young people, and concert tickets always sell out.

那位导演的新作试映会只邀请了评论家们。.en: The preview screening of that director's new film only invited critics.

试映会后安排了与观众的对话时间。.en: After the preview screening, there was a Q&A session with the audience.

他的计划理论上完美，但事实上难以执行。.en: His plan is perfect in theory, but in fact, it's hard to execute.

那位演员事实上比在屏幕上看起来更有魅力。.en: That actor is actually more charming in person than he appears on screen.

她很会撒娇，总让周围的人笑。.en: She is very good at acting cute and always makes people around her laugh.

小狗很会撒娇，每次散步都吸引人们的目光。.en: The puppy is very good at acting cute and draws people's attention every time it goes for a walk.

他退学后自愿入伍。.en: He dropped out of school and voluntarily enlisted.

许多艺人为尽国民义务而入伍。.en: Many celebrities enlist to fulfill their national duty.

这部电影凭借独创的剧本获得了高度评价。.en: This movie received high praise for its original script.

作家为写剧本花了一年时间收集资料。.en: The writer spent a year collecting materials to write the script.

他一边上班一边在夜间大学继续学习。.en: He continues studying at night university while working.

夜间大学为白天工作的人提供了高等教育的机会。.en: Night university provides higher education opportunities for people who work during the day.

费心，费力.en: to put in effort, to go to great lengths

他为了说服母亲费尽了心思，但最终还是没能如愿。.en: He went to great lengths to persuade his mother, but in the end, he couldn't get his way.

孩子为了买玩具使劲地撒娇耍赖，但我态度很坚决。.en: The child whined and threw a tantrum to buy a toy, but I was firm.

她看到朋友的成功感到了嫉妒心。.en: She felt jealousy at her friend's success.

因为嫉妒心而无法做出理性判断的情况很多。.en: There are many cases where jealousy prevents rational judgment.

他做出那种行为的动机是什么，至今还是个疑问。.en: What his motive was for that behavior is still a question.

如果没有纯粹的 artistic 动机，只为了钱而创作作品是不行的。.en: If there's no pure artistic motive, creating works just for money is not acceptable.

那部电影评价很好，但我并不觉得那么有趣。.en: That movie got good reviews, but I didn't find it that interesting.

那件事比想象中没那么难。.en: That matter wasn't as difficult as I thought.

最近播出的爱情剧太感人，我每天都流泪。.en: The romance drama that aired recently is so touching that I cry every day.

他比起爱情剧更喜欢惊悚题材。.en: He prefers thriller genres over romance dramas.

这位歌手的代表曲目至今仍有很多人喜欢听。.en: Many people still enjoy listening to this singer's signature songs.

他们的代表作品发行已过10年，但依然很受欢迎。.en: Their representative work was released over 10 years ago, but it's still very popular.

这个娱乐节目的魅力在于参与者自然的样子。.en: The charm of this entertainment show lies in the participants' natural behavior.

最近最受欢迎的娱乐节目是哪个？.en: Which entertainment show is the most popular these days?

这档节目是展现出演者们真实日常的综艺。.en: This show is a variety program that shows the real daily lives of the cast members.

所有出演者没有剧本即兴表演，令观众惊讶不已。.en: All the cast members improvised without a script, surprising the viewers.

他胆子很小，晚上连独自坐电梯都不敢。.en: He is very timid, he can't even ride the elevator alone at night.

因为胆小的性格，面对新的挑战总是犹豫不决。.en: Because of his timid personality, he always hesitates when facing new challenges.

贪心的投资者反而经常遭受巨大损失。.en: Greedy investors often suffer huge losses instead.

他很贪心，无法满足于已经拥有的东西。.en: He is very greedy and can't be satisfied with what he already has.

他因为谎言败露而受到了冷酷的惩罚。.en: He received harsh punishment after his lie was exposed.

那位演员不是在背台词，而是像真的身处那个情境一样自然地表演。.en: That actor isn't just reciting lines, but performing naturally as if he's really in that situation.

本以为和久违的朋友对话会尴尬，反而像什么事都没发生过一样自然地进行了下去。.en: I thought talking to a friend I hadn't seen in a while would be awkward, but instead it went naturally as if nothing had happened.

他学生时代一次都没迟到过，是个典型的模范生。.en: He never once was late during his school days; he was a typical model student.

因为模范生的标签，他总担心连一个小小的失误都不会被容忍，一直很不安。.en: Because of the model student label, he was always anxious, worried that even a small mistake wouldn't be tolerated.

看他都三十多岁了还向父母要零花钱花，好像还是不懂事。.en: Seeing that he's over thirty and still asking his parents for pocket money, he still seems immature.

不懂事的时候觉得父母的唠叨那么刺耳，现在才知道那都是爱。.en: When I was immature, my parents' nagging sounded so harsh, but now I know it was all love.

为了哄哭了一整夜的婴儿，妈妈一夜都没合眼。.en: The mother didn't sleep a wink all night trying to soothe the baby who cried all night.

孩子一直哭，他拍了拍背哄了哄，但也没用。.en: The child kept crying, so he patted its back to soothe it, but it didn't work.

为了听那位著名作家的演讲，全国各地无数人聚集而来。.en: Countless people from all over the country gathered to hear that famous writer's lecture.

他的演讲超越了单纯的知识传递，拥有打动听众内心的力量。.en: His lecture went beyond simply conveying knowledge and had the power to move the audience's hearts.

电影后半部分突然出现新角色，剧情发生了反转。.en: In the latter half of the movie, a new character suddenly appeared, and the plot took a twist.

智能手机出现以后，人们的生活方式完全改变了。.en: After smartphones appeared, people's lifestyles completely changed.

在学校被排挤的经历长期折磨着他的精神。.en: The experience of being ostracized at school tormented his mind for a long time.

上司过度刁难下属员工是明确的职场霸凌行为。.en: A boss excessively tormenting subordinate employees is clearly workplace bullying.

即使在冬天也不失翠绿的松树是气节和操守的象征。.en: The pine tree, which stays green even in winter, is a symbol of integrity and fidelity.

一走进松树林，松树的香气便扑鼻而来，令人心情舒畅。.en: As soon as you enter the pine forest, the scent of pine trees greets you, making you feel refreshed.

随便插手别人的事情，反而可能会招来祸患。.en: Meddling in other people's affairs carelessly might actually bring trouble.

不是专家却随便对开药方发表意见是很危险的。.en: It's dangerous to casually give opinions on prescriptions without being an expert.

火灾发生时，他从二楼的窗户跳下，勉强捡回了一条命。.en: When the fire broke out, he jumped from the second-floor window and barely saved his life.

他毫不犹豫地跳进水里，救起了即将溺死的孩子。.en: He jumped into the water without hesitation and saved the child who was about to drown.

经过漫长的手术，患者平安无事地恢复了，家属们流下了眼泪。.en: After a long surgery, the patient recovered safely, and the family shed tears.

虽然台风肆虐了村庄，但幸好所有居民都平安撤离了。.en: Although the typhoon ravaged the village, fortunately all residents evacuated safely.

檀君神话是解释韩民族起源的最古老的建国神话。.en: The Dangun myth is the oldest founding myth explaining the origin of the Korean people.

他的成功故事如今已成为一个神话，给许多人带来灵感。.en: His success story has now become a myth, inspiring many people.

轻视，小看，俯视.en: to look down on / to despise

他因为学历低而表现出轻视同事的态度。.en: He shows a condescending attitude toward his colleagues because of his low education level.

站在山顶俯视山谷，一切都像蚂蚁一样渺小。.en: Looking down at the valley from the mountaintop, everything looks as small as ants.

曾在城市生活的他归农了，开始在小菜园里亲自种庄稼。.en: He, who used to live in the city, returned to farming and started growing crops himself in a small vegetable garden.

过去种庄稼是最重要的生计，但现在不是这样了。.en: In the past, growing crops was the most important livelihood, but that's not the case anymore.

停电了，整个家里一片漆黑，但我们点上蜡烛聊起了天。.en: The power went out and the whole house was pitch black, but we lit candles and chatted.

他的未来一片漆黑，一度陷入了深深的忧郁之中。.en: His future looked completely bleak, and he fell into a deep depression for a while.

即使是再亲近的关系，如果行为无礼，也可能会让对方心情不好。.en: Even in the closest relationships, if you act rudely, it can make the other person feel bad.

我知道他是想称赞我，但他的语气听起来像在讽刺，让我心情很不好。.en: I know he meant to compliment me, but his tone sounded sarcastic, and it made me feel really bad.

随着年龄增长，短期记忆力会下降，刚听到的故事也会马上忘掉。.en: As you get older, your short-term memory declines, and you forget stories you just heard right away.

那位演员以记忆力好而闻名，剧本只要读一遍就能背下来。.en: That actor is famous for having a good memory; he can memorize a script after reading it just once.

他自从撒了一次谎之后，就被周围人彻底打上了说谎者的烙印。.en: After he told one lie, he was completely branded a liar by the people around him.

不承认自己的错误而继续说谎的人，人们就称其为说谎者。.en: People who don't admit their mistakes and keep lying are called liars.

我意识到，试图去挽回已经泼出去的水是没有用处的。.en: I realized that trying to retrieve water that has already been spilled is useless.

再怎么后悔，对于改变过去的事情也是没有用处的，以后我们做得更好吧。.en: No matter how much you regret it, it's useless for changing the past, so let's do better from now on.

在面试中，整洁的穿着是左右应聘者第一印象的重要因素。.en: In an interview, neat attire is an important factor that influences the first impression of the applicant.

她自由奔放的性格，从她独特且充满个性的穿着中也很好地体现出来。.en: Her free-spirited personality is well reflected in her unique and individualistic attire.

名牌大学的入学考试竞争率逐年飙升，学生们承受着极大的压力。.en: The competition rate for entrance exams at prestigious universities is soaring year by year, putting students under immense pressure.

他在入学考试前因焦虑而失眠，仍埋头苦读。.en: He couldn't sleep due to anxiety before the entrance exam, but still buried himself in studying.

他消极的思维方式成了打击整个团队士气的主要原因。.en: His negative way of thinking was the main reason for bringing down the entire team's morale.

受到批评时总是做出消极反应的人很难成长。.en: People who always react negatively when criticized find it hard to grow.

他提出的条件正符合我们公司的情况，所以立即签订了合同。.en: The conditions he proposed exactly matched our company's situation, so we signed the contract immediately.

电影的结局正好按照预想的发展，让人有些失望。.en: The ending of the movie developed exactly as expected, which was a bit disappointing.

假新闻在网上瞬间扩散，加剧了社会混乱。.en: Fake news spread online in an instant, intensifying social chaos.

为了防止传染病迅速蔓延，政府立即实施了防疫措施。.en: To prevent the rapid spread of infectious diseases, the government immediately implemented quarantine measures.

睡眠不足会降低大脑的认知功能，导致注意力和记忆力下降。.en: Lack of sleep reduces the brain's cognitive function, leading to decreased attention and memory.

最新研究表明，运动能促进大脑的可塑性，从而提高学习能力。.en: Recent studies show that exercise promotes brain plasticity, thereby improving learning ability.

长期的压力不仅对身体健康，对精神健康也产生负面影响。.en: Long-term stress has a negative impact not only on physical health but also on mental health.

此次经济危机将对全球劳动力市场产生巨大影响。.en: This economic crisis will have a huge impact on the global labor market.

冬季因供暖导致的大气污染尤其严重。.en: Air pollution caused by heating in winter is especially severe.

为了减少大气污染，正在扩大电动车的普及。.en: To reduce air pollution, the spread of electric vehicles is being expanded.

工厂排出的废水流入河流，引发了水质污染。.en: Wastewater discharged from factories flowed into rivers, causing water pollution.

为了防止水质污染，需要彻底的废水处理系统。.en: To prevent water pollution, a thorough wastewater treatment system is needed.

回收利用空玻璃瓶可以节省制造新玻璃所需的能源。.en: Recycling empty glass bottles can save the energy needed to make new glass.

回收利用玻璃瓶时，必须将内容物清洗干净后再丢弃。.en: When recycling glass bottles, you must rinse out the contents cleanly before discarding them.

刷牙时开着水龙头是浪费宝贵水资源的行为。.en: Leaving the tap on while brushing your teeth is a waste of precious water resources.

仅减少淋浴时间就能避免浪费水。.en: Just reducing your shower time can help avoid wasting water.

因工厂废水，附近的河流被严重污染。.en: Due to factory wastewater, the nearby river has become heavily polluted.

海洋因塑料垃圾被污染，海洋生物正受到威胁。.en: The ocean is being polluted by plastic waste, and marine life is under threat.

因台风逼近，所有国际航班被取消。.en: Due to an approaching typhoon, all international flights have been canceled.

因演讲者的健康问题，讲座突然被取消。.en: Due to the speaker's health issues, the lecture was suddenly canceled.

双方长期的矛盾终于通过对话得到了解决。.en: The long-standing conflict between the two sides was finally resolved through dialogue.

这个问题仅靠技术手段是不会轻易得到解决的。.en: This problem won't be easily solved by technical means alone.

他在摔倒前勉强抓住了栏杆。.en: He barely managed to grab the railing before falling.

警察抓住了正在逃跑的嫌疑人的衣角。.en: The police grabbed the fleeing suspect by the hem of their clothes.

被覆盖，被掩盖.en: to be covered, to be concealed

下了很大的雪，整个村庄被白色覆盖了。.en: It snowed heavily, and the entire village was covered in white.

他的过去仍然被神秘的面纱掩盖着，无从知晓。.en: His past is still shrouded in mystery, and we have no way of knowing.

因台风导致电线断裂，停电了数小时。.en: Due to the typhoon, power lines snapped and there was a power outage for several hours.

突然停电，导致我没能保存重要的作业资料。.en: A sudden power outage caused me to lose my important homework files.

两国之间发生战争后，出现了大量难民。.en: After war broke out between the two countries, a large number of refugees appeared.

如果这一地区发生战争，将会酿成人道主义灾难。.en: If war breaks out in this region, it will lead to a humanitarian disaster.

剩饭不仅是浪费，更是对资源的亵渎。.en: Leftover food is not only wasteful, but also a desecration of resources.

我认为花那么多钱买奢侈品是时间和金钱的浪费。.en: I think spending that much money on luxury goods is a waste of time and money.

空地上堆积的垃圾堆散发出恶臭。.en: The garbage heap piled up on the vacant lot gave off a foul smell.

未被回收的垃圾堆是环境污染的元凶。.en: Unrecycled trash piles are the main cause of environmental pollution.

垃圾分类后，需要送到回收中心。.en: After sorting the trash, it needs to be taken to the recycling center.

回收中心会分别处理塑料、玻璃和纸张等。.en: The recycling center processes plastic, glass, and paper separately.

他在院子一角堆了很多空瓶子。.en: He piled up a lot of empty bottles in a corner of the yard.

桌上堆满了文件，连工作的地方都没有了。.en: The desk is piled high with documents, leaving no room to work.

她开始怀疑丈夫晚归，但实际上他是在准备惊喜生日派对。.en: She began to suspect her husband of coming home late, but actually he was preparing a surprise birthday party.

科学家们怀疑那项实验结果的可靠性，并要求进行额外验证。.en: The scientists doubted the reliability of the experiment results and requested additional verification.

春天一到，江水开始解冻融化。.en: As soon as spring arrives, the river water begins to thaw and melt.

工厂废水流入江水，水质污染严重。.en: Factory wastewater flows into the river, causing severe water pollution.

整夜风雨交加，好几棵树被吹倒了。.en: The wind and rain raged all night, and several trees were blown down.

他不顾风雨，毅然出门上路了。.en: He went out on the road despite the wind and rain.

环保团体正在开展减少使用塑料的运动。.en: An environmental group is carrying out a campaign to reduce the use of plastic.

此次竞选活动主要聚焦于经济政策。.en: This election campaign mainly focuses on economic policy.

超市为了减少塑料袋的使用，引入了纸袋。.en: The supermarket introduced paper bags to reduce the use of plastic bags.

塑料袋需要数百年才能分解，因此对环境有害。.en: Plastic bags take hundreds of years to decompose, so they are harmful to the environment.

上下班高峰期，地铁比私家车快得多。.en: During rush hour, the subway is much faster than a private car.

他有私家车，但为了环境特意乘坐公共交通。.en: He has a private car, but he takes public transportation on purpose for the environment.

工厂排出的废水正在严重污染河流。.en: The wastewater discharged from the factory is seriously polluting the river.

一次性塑料是污染海洋生态系统的主要原因之一。.en: Disposable plastic is one of the main causes of pollution in the marine ecosystem.

长期的压力不仅对身体健康，对精神健康也非常有害。.en: Long-term stress is very harmful not only to physical health but also to mental health.

一些杀虫剂对蜜蜂种群造成了致命的危害。.en: Some pesticides cause fatal harm to bee populations.

这款化妆品完全不含有对羟基苯甲酸酯等有害成分。.en: This cosmetic product contains no harmful ingredients like parabens at all.

科学家们分析了大气污染物的成分，以追踪其产生原因。.en: Scientists analyzed the components of air pollutants to trace their causes.

随着地下水被污染，村民们难以获得安全的饮用水。.en: As groundwater became polluted, the villagers had difficulty getting safe drinking water.

这款净水器能去除重金属和杂质，提供干净的饮用水。.en: This water purifier removes heavy metals and impurities, providing clean drinking water.

多个环保组织联合发起了解决海洋垃圾问题的活动。.en: Several environmental organizations jointly launched a campaign to solve the marine litter problem.

环保组织强烈反对政府扩大核电站的计划。.en: Environmental organizations strongly opposed the government's plan to expand nuclear power plants.

农业肥料被雨水冲刷后流入河流，导致富营养化。.en: Agricultural fertilizers washed away by rain flow into rivers, causing eutrophication.

工厂废水通过溪流最终流入大海，破坏了海洋生态系统。.en: Factory wastewater flows through streams and eventually into the sea, damaging the marine ecosystem.

在国家公园内安装缆车的计划因担心破坏自然引发了巨大争议。.en: The plan to install a cable car in the national park sparked huge controversy over concerns about damaging nature.

乘坐缆车登上山顶，壮丽的雪山风景尽收眼底。.en: Taking the cable car to the top of the mountain, you can take in the magnificent snowy mountain scenery.

随着海边大型度假村的建设，原住民的生活家园消失了。.en: With the construction of a large seaside resort, the indigenous people's homes disappeared.

这个度假村使用环保能源，并引入了废物回收系统。.en: This resort uses eco-friendly energy and has introduced a waste recycling system.

北极海冰迅速融化，正在影响整个地球的气候系统。.en: The rapid melting of Arctic sea ice is affecting the Earth's climate system.

科学家警告说，北极的温度上升速度是其他地区的两倍以上。.en: Scientists warn that temperatures in the Arctic are rising more than twice as fast as in other regions.

热带雨林是地球上栖息着最多样化生物物种的生态系统。.en: The tropical rainforest is the ecosystem that hosts the most diverse species of organisms on Earth.

环境污染对土壤中的微生物等微小生物也造成了致命影响。.en: Environmental pollution has also had a fatal impact on tiny organisms like microbes in the soil.

由于气候变化，海豹的主要食物——鱼类的数量正在急剧减少。.en: Due to climate change, the number of fish, which is the main food of seals, is rapidly decreasing.

随着海冰减少，海豹难以找到安全的地方进行繁殖。.en: As sea ice decreases, seals find it difficult to find safe places to breed.

北极熊在海冰上捕猎，因此冰川融化会威胁其生存。.en: Polar bears hunt on sea ice, so melting glaciers threaten their survival.

专家认为，到本世纪末，北极熊的数量将减少三分之一以上。.en: Experts believe that by the end of this century, the polar bear population will decrease by more than a third.

南极冰川融化的速度比预测的要快得多。.en: The Antarctic glaciers are melting much faster than predicted.

南极上空的臭氧空洞正在逐渐恢复，但完全闭合还需要数十年。.en: The ozone hole over Antarctica is gradually recovering, but it will take decades to fully close.

他陷入沉思，望着窗外一言不发。.en: He was lost in thought, staring out the window without saying a word.

春天一到，学校花园里开满了五颜六色的花，吸引了学生们的脚步。.en: As soon as spring arrived, the school garden was filled with colorful flowers, drawing in the students.

婚礼场地满是新娘最喜欢的玫瑰花，所有人都赞叹不已。.en: The wedding venue was full of the bride's favorite roses, and everyone was amazed.

夕阳西下时，大海被晚霞染红，呈现出一幅画般的景色。.en: As the sun sets, the sea is dyed red by the sunset, creating a picturesque scene.

秋风吹过，落叶随风飘散，把公园小路整个染成了黄色。.en: The autumn wind blew, and the fallen leaves scattered with the wind, dyeing the entire park path yellow.

她的长发随风飘动，美得像电影中的一个场景。.en: Her long hair fluttered in the wind, looking as beautiful as a scene from a movie.

早上慢跑后心情舒畅，可以充满活力地开始新的一天。.en: After a morning jog, I feel refreshed and can start the day full of energy.

把窗户大大打开，呼吸新鲜空气，整个房间通风后心情也变得舒畅了。.en: Opening the window wide, breathing in fresh air, and airing out the whole room made me feel refreshed too.

冥想之后头脑变得清晰，专注力提高，工作效率大幅提升。.en: After meditating, my mind becomes clear, my concentration improves, and my work efficiency increases significantly.

遇到复杂问题时，稍微散散步头脑就会变得清晰，解决方案也常常会浮现出来。.en: When faced with a complex problem, taking a short walk clears my mind, and solutions often come to me.

无限，无垠，一望无际.en: endless, boundless, stretching as far as the eye can see

沙漠无尽地延伸，容易迷路，因此必须与向导同行。.en: The desert stretches endlessly, making it easy to get lost, so you must go with a guide.

他在接连不断的提问攻势下惊慌失措，没能好好回答。.en: He was flustered by the endless barrage of questions and couldn't answer properly.

他经历了无数次失败，但从未放弃，最终取得了成功。.en: He experienced countless failures, but never gave up and eventually succeeded.

夜空中闪烁着数不清的星星，让人感受到宇宙的神秘。.en: Countless stars twinkle in the night sky, making you feel the mystery of the universe.

不言不语，一声不响；平安无事，顺利.en: without a word, silently; smoothly, without incident

他一声不响地紧紧握住我的手，那份温暖代替了所有的安慰。.en: He silently held my hand tightly, and that warmth replaced all words of comfort.

事情顺利地进行，比预想快得多地完成了项目。.en: The work went smoothly, and we finished the project much faster than expected.

展览会第一天就涌入了无数观众，人山人海。.en: On the first day of the exhibition, countless visitors poured in, creating a huge crowd.

为了观众的安全，博物馆内禁止使用闪光灯拍照。.en: For the safety of visitors, using flash photography is prohibited inside the museum.

他所说的话成为了让我领悟真正友谊意义的契机。.en: What he said became the opportunity for me to realize the meaning of true friendship.

我们认为，为了实现真正的和平，首先要相互理解。.en: We believe that in order to achieve true peace, we must first understand each other.

在城市的快节奏生活中，找到悠闲感是很重要的。.en: In the fast-paced life of the city, it's important to find a sense of leisure.

她总是带着一种充满悠闲感的微笑。.en: She always has a smile full of a relaxed feeling.

景福宫是朝鲜时代的代表性宫殿，具有很多历史意义。.en: Gyeongbokgung Palace is a representative palace from the Joseon Dynasty and has a lot of historical significance.

夜晚在开放的宫殿里漫步，感觉就像在时间旅行一样。.en: Walking through the open palace at night feels like time travel.

釜山的代表性景点札嘎其市场是游客们最热门的路线之一。.en: Jagalchi Market, a representative attraction in Busan, is one of the most popular routes for tourists.

这儿的招牌美食——老奶奶血肠汤，一到午餐时间就排起长队。.en: The signature dish here, Grandma's Sundae Soup, has a long line forming by lunchtime.

政府为了鼓励艺术家的创作活动，正在推行多种支援政策。.en: The government is implementing various support policies to encourage artists' creative activities.

赶在日落时分在弥勒山山脚的咖啡馆坐下，便能欣赏被染红的大海。.en: If you sit down at a café at the foot of Mireuksan Mountain around sunset, you can enjoy the sea dyed red.

客轮抵达港口时，日落已经过去许久了。.en: By the time the ferry arrived at the port, the sunset had already passed.

受台风影响，所有客轮的运行已全面管制。.en: Due to the typhoon, all ferry operations have been completely restricted.

这家民宿就在海边，非常适合一边享用拌鱿鱼和马格利酒，一边欣赏日落。.en: This guesthouse is right by the sea, perfect for enjoying seasoned squid and makgeolli while watching the sunset.

研究团队以1000名成年人为对象，对海外旅行偏好进行了调查。.en: The research team conducted a survey on overseas travel preferences targeting 1,000 adults.

面试官向应聘者询问了为何选择这个职业。.en: The interviewer asked the applicant why they chose this profession.

鹦鹉模仿人说话的能力很强，深受人们喜爱。.en: Parrots are very good at mimicking human speech, which makes them very popular.
