公司的惯例是先让新员工向组长问候。.en: The company custom is to first have new employees greet the team leader.

会长一直留在座位上，一一接受员工们的问候。.en: The chairman stayed in his seat and received greetings from each employee one by one.

在婚礼现场，新郎新娘接受宾客的问候并表达了感谢。.en: At the wedding, the bride and groom received the guests' greetings and expressed their thanks.

即使不那样，我也很想你。.en: Even without that, I miss you a lot.

即使不那样，我也正打算看那部电影。.en: Even without that, I was planning to watch that movie.

针太尖了，只轻轻扎了一下手指就出血了。.en: The needle was so sharp that just lightly pricking my finger made it bleed.

他通过内部举报告发了上司的公司腐败行为。.en: He reported his boss's company corruption through an internal whistleblowing.

这双皮鞋的鞋跟磨损得很厉害，得去修鞋店换鞋跟了。.en: The heels of these leather shoes are worn down badly, so I need to go to the shoe repair shop to replace them.

换鞋跟可以延长鞋子的寿命，走路也更舒服。.en: Replacing the heels can extend the life of the shoes and make walking more comfortable.

铅笔芯太尖了，感觉纸很容易被戳破。.en: The pencil lead is too sharp, it feels like the paper could easily be poked through.

遇到难题时，他总是能想出妙招。.en: When faced with a difficult problem, he always comes up with a clever solution.

手机液晶屏碎了，完全无法触摸。.en: The phone's LCD screen is broken, completely unresponsive to touch.

液晶屏出现裂纹的话，更换费用可能会很高，所以要小心使用。.en: If the LCD screen gets a crack, the replacement cost can be quite high, so use it carefully.

交给售后服务中心.en: Leave it to the after-sales service center

笔记本电脑突然关机，我最终决定交给售后服务中心。.en: My laptop suddenly shut down, so I finally decided to take it to the after-service center.

虽然保修期已过，但维修费太贵，我正犹豫要不要交给售后服务中心。.en: Even though the warranty has expired, the repair fee is too expensive, so I'm hesitating about whether to take it to the after-service center.

去售后服务中心领取.en: Go to the after-service center to pick it up

收到维修完成短信后，我马上去售后服务中心取回来了。.en: After receiving the repair completion text message, I immediately went to the after-service center to pick it up.

去售后服务中心领取时，必须携带身份证和受理凭证。.en: When going to the after-service center to pick it up, you must bring your ID card and the receipt.

空调坏了，我向管理事务所报了修。.en: The air conditioner broke down, so I reported it to the management office.

可以通过网站简便地报修产品。.en: You can easily report a product malfunction through the website.

不管怎样，健康最重要，所以最好定期运动。.en: No matter what, health is the most important, so it's best to exercise regularly.

无论如何，这家餐厅的招牌菜就是泡菜汤。.en: Anyway, this restaurant's signature dish is kimchi stew.

因为压力患上了失眠症，睡不着觉的日子变多了。.en: I developed insomnia due to stress, and the number of days I can't sleep has increased.

为了缓解失眠症，最好减少咖啡因摄入，睡前不要看手机。.en: To relieve insomnia, it's best to reduce caffeine intake and not look at your phone before bed.

他果断地拒绝了诱惑，继续坚持减肥。.en: He resolutely refused the temptation and continued to stick to his diet.

孩子们甩开手，执意要自己走。.en: The children let go of their hands and insisted on walking by themselves.

最近随着对有机食品的关注度提高，价格也在逐渐下降。.en: Recently, as interest in organic food has increased, the price has been gradually decreasing.

虽然知道有机食品对健康好，但因为价格负担大，不能经常买。.en: Even though I know organic food is good for health, I can't buy it often because of the high price.

忙碌的早晨虽然快餐很方便，但也要考虑营养均衡。.en: Although fast food is convenient on busy mornings, you also need to consider nutritional balance.

经常吃快餐容易消化不良，疲劳也容易累积。.en: Eating fast food often can easily cause indigestion, and fatigue can also build up.

韩国人的传统食谱以谷类为主，搭配小菜和汤。.en: The traditional Korean diet is based on grains, accompanied by side dishes and soup.

谷类是碳水化合物的主要来源，因此用餐时适量摄取很重要。.en: Grains are the main source of carbohydrates, so it's important to consume them in moderation during meals.

做泡菜的季节临近时，每个超市都堆满了白菜和萝卜，人声鼎沸。.en: When kimchi-making season approaches, every supermarket is piled high with cabbages and radishes, bustling with people.

最近在泡菜季节，不亲自做泡菜而是订购来吃的家庭越来越多了。.en: Recently, during kimchi season, more and more families are ordering kimchi instead of making it themselves.

要填写这份文件需要盖好几次章，真的很麻烦。.en: To fill out this document, you need to stamp it several times, which is really troublesome.

最近可以不用繁琐的程序，通过互联网简单申请。.en: These days, you can apply simply through the internet without going through a complicated process.

饺子虽然自己做的更好吃，但从和面到准备馅料都很费事。.en: Although homemade dumplings taste better, it's quite troublesome from kneading the dough to preparing the filling.

这道菜食材处理很麻烦，对新手来说算是比较费事的。.en: This dish requires a lot of work to prepare the ingredients, so it's quite bothersome for beginners.

今年家人们决定聚在一起做过冬泡菜。.en: This year, the family decided to get together and make kimchi for the winter.

母亲每年做过冬泡菜时，都会腌很多，足够分给邻居吃。.en: Every year when my mother makes winter kimchi, she ferments a large amount, enough to share with the neighbors.

坚持运动一个月后，体重减少了整整3公斤。.en: After exercising consistently for a month, my weight decreased by a full 3 kilograms.

压力大的时候食欲会下降，体重有时也会减轻。.en: When you're stressed, your appetite decreases, and sometimes your weight also goes down.

去健身房三个月后，胳膊和肩膀开始长出肌肉。.en: After going to the gym for three months, I started to build muscle in my arms and shoulders.

只有充分摄取蛋白质，运动效果才会显现，肌肉才会长出来。.en: Only when you consume enough protein will the effects of exercise show, and muscles will grow.

在热水中半身浴的话，感觉一整天积累的疲劳都消除了。.en: If you take a half-body bath in hot water, it feels like the fatigue accumulated throughout the day is relieved.

只有获得充足的睡眠，疲劳才能彻底消除，状态才能恢复。.en: Only by getting enough sleep can fatigue be completely relieved and your condition recover.

做运动的话压力就缓解了。.en: If you exercise, stress is relieved.

听音乐感觉压力缓解了。.en: Listening to music feels like stress is relieved.

孩子完全不吃蔬菜，偏食很严重，正在和营养师咨询。.en: The child doesn't eat vegetables at all, is very picky, and is consulting with a nutritionist.

偏食可能导致营养不均衡，因此养成均衡摄取各种食物的习惯很重要。.en: Picky eating can lead to nutritional imbalance, so it's important to develop a habit of eating a balanced variety of foods.

奶奶推荐了感冒时煮生姜茶喝的民间偏方。.en: Grandma recommended a folk remedy of boiling ginger tea when you have a cold.

并非所有民间疗法都有效，需要慎重判断。.en: Not all folk remedies are effective, so you need to judge carefully.

吃得不多，饭量小.en: Eats little, has a small appetite

他本来饭量就小，只吃一点点饭就说饱了。.en: He naturally has a small appetite, so he eats just a little bit of rice and says he's full.

虽然知道为了健康少吃点好，但实践起来很难。.en: Although I know it's good to eat less for health, it's hard to put into practice.

这个村庄长寿老人特别多，以'长寿村'而闻名。.en: This village has an unusually high number of elderly people who live long, so it's famous as a 'longevity village'.

他作为在小区里经营小店的商人，深受居民的信赖。.en: As a merchant running a small shop in the neighborhood, he is deeply trusted by the residents.

多亏了电话银行，不用亲自去银行也能转账和查询。.en: Thanks to phone banking, you can transfer money and check your balance without having to go to the bank in person.

智能手机普及后，电话银行的使用率急剧增加。.en: After smartphones became widespread, the usage rate of phone banking increased dramatically.

不用说，无需赘言.en: needless to say, it goes without saying

那位演员的演技自不必说，唱歌实力也出众。.en: Needless to say, that actor's acting is great, and his singing ability is also outstanding.

这款产品的设计出色自不必说，耐久性也非常好。.en: This product's design is excellent, needless to say, and its durability is also very good.

昨天看的演出，舞台效果和音乐完美融合，真的太梦幻了。.en: The performance I saw yesterday had a perfect blend of stage effects and music; it was truly dreamy.

在海边看到的日落景色太神奇了，好一阵子都舍不得离开。.en: The sunset I saw by the sea was so magical that I couldn't bear to leave for a long time.

四物游戏（小锣、大锣、圆鼓、长鼓四种乐器）.en: Samulnori (a traditional Korean percussion quartet with small gong, large gong, hourglass drum, and barrel drum)

四物游戏是由小锣、大锣、圆鼓、长鼓四种乐器组成的传统演奏。.en: Samulnori is a traditional performance made up of four instruments: the small gong, large gong, hourglass drum, and barrel drum.

外国游客对四物游戏充满动感的节奏和能量感受到了巨大的魅力。.en: Foreign tourists are greatly captivated by the dynamic rhythm and energy of Samulnori.

一下子（紧张等顿时消除的样子）；噌的.en: all at once (as when tension suddenly disappears); with a whoosh

多亏了他的玩笑，会议室的紧张感一下子消除了。.en: Thanks to his joke, the tension in the meeting room disappeared all at once.

一开门冷风就嗖地吹进来，身体缩成了一团。.en: As soon as I opened the door, the cold wind blew in sharply, and my body curled up.

庆典现场充满了音乐和笑声，所有人都兴高采烈地享受着。.en: The celebration venue was filled with music and laughter, and everyone was enjoying themselves cheerfully.

在和朋友们一起露营的地方，欢快的歌声一直持续到深夜。.en: At the campsite with friends, cheerful singing continued late into the night.

那位研究者凭借创新理论在国际学术界得到了认可。.en: That researcher received recognition in the international academic community for his innovative theory.

后辈在第一个项目中表现出色，得到了组长的认可。.en: The junior performed well in the first project and received recognition from the team leader.

那位新职员解决问题的能力很突出，在团队内得到了认可。.en: That new employee's problem-solving ability is outstanding, and he has received recognition within the team.

外语能力突出的人在跨国企业可以获得更多机会。.en: People with outstanding foreign language skills can get more opportunities in multinational companies.

那个人的语调很柔和，听起来很舒服。.en: That person's tone is very soft, so it sounds comfortable.

掌握韩语语调对外国学习者来说是最困难的部分之一。.en: Mastering Korean intonation is one of the most difficult parts for foreign learners.

他表面上看起来冷冰冰的，但了解后会发现他比谁都内心温暖。.en: He seems cold on the surface, but once you get to know him, you'll find he's warmer than anyone else.

因为父亲那种生硬的表达爱的方式，小时候我常常感到委屈。.en: Because of my father's blunt way of expressing love, I often felt wronged as a child.

听到孩子考试合格的消息，父母欣慰地笑了。.en: Hearing that their child passed the exam, the parents smiled with relief.

久违的朋友关心我的健康的样子让我感到很欣慰。.en: It was comforting to see a friend I hadn't seen in a while caring about my health.

美谈.en: a tale of virtue; a good story

他帮助邻居的故事在社区里被传为美谈。.en: His story of helping his neighbor became a tale of virtue in the community.

两家企业超越竞争进行合作的事例成为了行业的美谈。.en: The case of two companies cooperating beyond competition became a good story in the industry.

那位新闻工作者总是为公正报道而努力。.en: That journalist always strives for fair reporting.

作为新闻工作者，传达真相是最重要的责任。.en: As a journalist, conveying the truth is the most important responsibility.

奶奶的花甲宴上，全家人聚在一起为她庆祝。.en: At Grandma's 60th birthday banquet, the whole family gathered to celebrate her.

最近比起花甲宴，家人一起安静吃饭的情况变多了。.en: These days, instead of big 60th birthday parties, more families quietly eat together.

下雨天就会想起绿豆煎饼。.en: On rainy days, I think of mung bean pancakes.

市场卖的绿豆煎饼真的很好吃。.en: The mung bean pancakes sold at the market are really delicious.

以尊重的态度对待下级是领导应有的姿态。.en: Treating subordinates with respect is the proper attitude for a leader.

他是一位也会认真听取下属意见的好上司。.en: He is a good boss who also listens carefully to his subordinates' opinions.

在韩国，对长辈使用半语被认为是不礼貌的。.en: In Korea, using casual speech with elders is considered rude.

在公司里，先向上级问好是基本礼仪。.en: At work, greeting your superiors first is basic etiquette.

他因为觉得考砸了，脸上明显堆满了失望的神色。.en: Because he thought he did poorly on the exam, his face was clearly full of disappointment.

孩子们收到了满满的圣诞礼物，一整天都兴奋地跑来跑去。.en: The children received a full load of Christmas presents and ran around excitedly all day.

雨停了，人们开始慢慢地走到外面。.en: The rain stopped, and people began to slowly walk outside.

他偷偷地慢慢站起来，溜出了会议室。.en: He stealthily stood up slowly and slipped out of the meeting room.

公司决定秋天去郊游。.en: The company decided to go on an outing in the fall.

郊游时大家一起吃烧烤，度过了愉快的时光。.en: We had a great time eating barbecue together during the outing.

在韩国，聚餐时经常有传炸弹酒的情况。.en: In Korea, bomb shots are often passed around during group dinners.

炸弹酒喝太多的话第二天宿醉会很严重，请小心。.en: If you drink too many bomb shots, the hangover the next day will be severe, so be careful.

发了邮件但还没有回信。.en: I sent an email but haven't received a reply yet.

等待回信期间感到不安。.en: I felt anxious while waiting for a reply.

生章鱼因为活着吃，所以筋道的口感堪称一绝。.en: Since raw octopus is eaten alive, its chewy texture is truly exceptional.

我向来到韩国的外国朋友推荐了生章鱼，他勇敢地挑战了。.en: I recommended raw octopus to my foreign friend who came to Korea, and he bravely tried it.

那两个人因为同性而未能得到婚姻认可。.en: Those two couldn't get their marriage recognized because they are the same gender.

学校里有同性之间才配对的传统。.en: There is a tradition at school of pairing up only with the same gender.

大学生们和同专业的朋友们聚在一起组成学习小组。.en: College students get together with friends from the same major to form study groups.

孩子们和同龄人一起玩时最开心。.en: Children are happiest when playing with peers their own age.

在韩语中，根据与对方的关系，语言礼仪会有所不同。.en: In Korean, language etiquette varies depending on your relationship with the other person.

外国人如果理解韩国的语言礼仪，就能更顺畅地沟通。.en: If foreigners understand Korean language etiquette, they can communicate more smoothly.

电话礼仪的基本是对方接听后先介绍自己。.en: The basic rule of phone etiquette is to introduce yourself after the other person answers.

在公司如果不遵守电话礼仪，可能会给客户留下不好的印象。.en: If you don't follow phone etiquette at work, you might leave a bad impression on clients.

虽然是第一次见面的人，但语气柔和，让人感到亲近感。.en: Even though it's someone I'm meeting for the first time, their gentle tone gives me a sense of closeness.

那位老师总是面带微笑，给学生带来亲近感。.en: That teacher always smiles, which gives students a sense of closeness.

很多人担心路边卖的食物会不会不卫生。.en: Many people worry that food sold on the street might be unhygienic.

厨房如果不卫生，食物中毒的风险就会增高。.en: If the kitchen is unhygienic, the risk of food poisoning increases.

第一次来韩国时因为饮食文化不同而受到了文化冲击。.en: When I first came to Korea, I experienced culture shock because of the different food culture.

要克服文化冲击，需要积极适应当地文化的态度。.en: To overcome culture shock, you need an attitude of actively adapting to the local culture.

在韩国，去别人家拜访时脱鞋是基本的拜访礼仪。.en: In Korea, taking off your shoes when visiting someone's home is basic visiting etiquette.

如果不了解拜访礼仪可能会失礼，所以最好提前了解。.en: If you don't know the visiting etiquette, you might be rude, so it's best to learn about it in advance.

他无心的一句话引起了误会，最终和朋友吵了起来。.en: His careless remark caused a misunderstanding, and in the end, he ended up arguing with his friend.

会议上突然离席的行为引起了同事们的误会。.en: Abruptly leaving the meeting caused misunderstandings among his colleagues.

A: \"听说英秀考试没通过。\" B: \"怎么会呢？他一直都很努力学习的。\.en: A: "I heard Youngsoo failed the exam." B: "How could that be? He's always studied hard."

A: \"那位辞职了。\" B: \"怎么会呢？昨天还在努力工作呢。\".en: A: "That person quit." B: "How could that be? He was working hard just yesterday."

乞求宽恕；求饶.en: Beg for forgiveness; plead for mercy

他因失误泄露了朋友的秘密而真心乞求宽恕。.en: He sincerely begged for forgiveness after accidentally revealing his friend's secret.

孩子的妈妈因为孩子打了其他孩子而向对方家长乞求宽恕。.en: The child's mother begged for forgiveness from the other parent because her child hit theirs.

因个人原因未能参加会议，敬请谅解。.en: I was unable to attend the meeting due to personal reasons, and I ask for your understanding.

预计将进行噪音较大的施工，敬请各位居民谅解。.en: Noisy construction is expected, and we ask for your understanding, residents.

在东亚文化圈中，尊敬长辈被视为重要的美德。.en: In the East Asian cultural sphere, respecting elders is considered an important virtue.

这本书比较分析了不同文化圈的婚姻习俗。.en: This book compares and analyzes marriage customs across different cultural spheres.

他挽着胳膊，一言不发地望着窗外。.en: He linked his arms and stared out the window without a word.

恋人们互相挽着胳膊在公园里散步。.en: Couples walk in the park with their arms linked.

昨天雨下得非常大，路全被淹了。.en: It rained very heavily yesterday, and all the roads were flooded.

那部电影非常感人，观众都哭了。.en: That movie was very touching, and the audience cried.

选择适合自己天赋的职业很重要。.en: It's important to choose a career that suits your aptitude.

通过适性测试，找找适合自己的工作吧。.en: Find a job that suits you through an aptitude test.

本次征集比赛的审查将公正严格地进行。.en: The screening for this competition will be conducted fairly and strictly.

审查委员们重点评估了作品的独创性和完成度。.en: The review committee focused on evaluating the originality and completeness of the works.

每月必须在规定日期前缴纳电费，否则会产生滞纳金。.en: You must pay the electricity bill by the specified date each month, otherwise a late fee will be charged.

通过国税厅网站可以方便地缴纳所得税。.en: You can conveniently pay income tax through the National Tax Service website.

在韩国，人们常常通过礼节来表达对长辈的恭敬之心。.en: In Korea, people often express their respect for elders through etiquette.

他是一个真心恭敬老师的学生。.en: He is a student who truly respects his teacher.

怪不得他今天话很少，原来听说他感冒了。.en: No wonder he was so quiet today; I heard he caught a cold.

难怪路上很冷清，原来今天是公休日。.en: No wonder the streets were so quiet; it turns out today is a public holiday.

他申请的公司被拒绝了，但他没有放弃，再次挑战。.en: He was rejected by the company he applied to, but he didn't give up and tried again.

告白被拒绝之后，她再也不轻易敞开心扉了。.en: After her confession was rejected, she no longer easily opened her heart.

申请研究生院必须要有指导教授的推荐信。.en: To apply for graduate school, you must have a letter of recommendation from your advisor.

他申请公司时向前任上司请求了推荐书。.en: When he applied to the company, he asked his former boss for a letter of recommendation.

退；撤退；让开；辞去.en: to retreat; to withdraw; to step aside; to resign

他因健康原因决定辞去会长一职。.en: He decided to resign from his position as chairman due to health reasons.

警察一出现，示威队伍就开始撤退。.en: As soon as the police appeared, the protest队伍 began to retreat.

没有上司的允许，他无法做出重要决定。.en: Without his boss's permission, he couldn't make an important decision.

得到父母的允许后，他才能出发去旅行。.en: Only after getting his parents' permission could he set off on the trip.

在这里，干净的水比什么都宝贵。.en: Here, clean water is more precious than anything else.

他为迎接尊贵的客人准备了特别的菜肴。.en: He prepared special dishes to welcome the honored guest.

他的道歉只是嘴上说说，感受不到真心，显得没有诚意。.en: His apology was just lip service; you couldn't feel any sincerity, so it seemed insincere.

准备礼物时完全不考虑对方，很容易被说没有诚意。.en: If you prepare a gift without considering the recipient at all, it's easy to be called insincere.

逃学；偷懒；磨洋工.en: to skip school; to slack off; to loaf on the job

他昨天逃学和朋友们去玩，被老师发现了。.en: He skipped school yesterday to hang out with friends and got caught by the teacher.

在公司里偷懒的员工最终业绩会下降。.en: Employees who slack off at work will eventually see their performance decline.

他深刻反省了自己的错误，并决心不再犯。.en: He deeply reflected on his mistake and resolved not to repeat it.

教育孩子错误时，最好给他们时间自己反省。.en: When teaching children about mistakes, it's best to give them time to reflect on their own.

今天天气特别冷，不想出门。.en: It's especially cold today, I don't want to go out.

她特别喜欢黄色，衣服和包都只买黄色的。.en: She especially likes yellow; she only buys yellow clothes and bags.

他回想童年，想起了奶奶做的泡菜汤的味道。.en: He recalled his childhood and remembered the taste of his grandmother's kimchi soup.

看到那张照片，回想起了大学时期的快乐记忆。.en: Seeing that photo brought back happy memories from college.

说到这儿，下周的会议日程也最好今天一起整理一下。.en: Speaking of which, we'd better organize next week's meeting schedule together today too.

说到这儿，我们要不要把旅行计划再具体地聊一聊？.en: Speaking of which, shall we discuss the travel plan in more detail?

这栋建筑是单层结构，所以没有楼梯。.en: This building is a single-story structure, so there are no stairs.

地质学家们在这一地区发现了新的断层。.en: Geologists discovered a new fault in this area.

假设所有变量都恒定，这个实验就会成功。.en: Assuming all variables are constant, this experiment will succeed.

他假设自己是代表，然后进行了会议。.en: He assumed the role of representative and held the meeting.

得益于持续练习，韩语水平得到了很大提高。.en: Thanks to consistent practice, my Korean skills have improved a lot.

预计这项政策将提高国民的生活水平。.en: This policy is expected to improve the standard of living for citizens.

这个网络是超高速的，所以电影几秒钟就能下载完。.en: This network is ultra-high speed, so movies download in seconds.

得益于超高速列车，从首尔到釜山只需一小时。.en: Thanks to the ultra-high speed train, it only takes an hour from Seoul to Busan.

他说在没有证据的情况下推测凶手是很危险的。.en: He said it's dangerous to speculate about the culprit without evidence.

我推测她迟到的原因是交通堵塞。.en: I speculate that the reason she was late is traffic.

他努力学习，结果获得了奖学金。.en: He studied hard, and as a result, he got a scholarship.

结果，那个决定给公司带来了巨大损失。.en: As a result, that decision caused a huge loss for the company.

警方相关人士表示正在调查事件的准确经过。.en: A police official said they are investigating the exact circumstances of the incident.

除活动相关人士外，禁止出入。.en: Entry is prohibited except for those involved in the event.

他在奥运会上创造了100米短跑新纪录。.en: He set a new record in the 100-meter sprint at the Olympics.

本季度销售额刷新了历史最高新纪录。.en: This quarter's sales broke the all-time highest new record.

这家公司正在对新技术开发进行巨额投资。.en: This company is making huge investments in developing new technology.

得益于新技术，医疗领域发生了革新性的变化。.en: Thanks to new technology, revolutionary changes have occurred in the medical field.

新型智能手机的电池寿命得到了大幅改善。.en: The battery life of the new smartphone model has been greatly improved.

这款车配备了新型发动机，燃油效率更高。.en: This car is equipped with a new type of engine, offering better fuel efficiency.

真正的智慧始于认识到自己的无知。.en: True wisdom begins with recognizing one's own ignorance.

他通过长期经验领悟到了生活的智慧。.en: He learned the wisdom of life through long experience.

有出息，出人头地.en: to be successful, to make something of oneself

他在艰难环境中也努力奋斗，最终出人头地了。.en: He worked hard even in difficult circumstances and eventually made something of himself.

父母非常希望子女能有出息。.en: Parents really hope their children will be successful.

心烦.en: to be annoyed, to be bothered

反复出现的同一个问题让人非常心烦。.en: The same problem keeps coming up, which is really annoying.

因为他令人心烦的态度，对话很难继续下去。.en: Because of his annoying attitude, it was hard to continue the conversation.

等待考试结果期间，他非常焦躁。.en: While waiting for the exam results, he was very restless.

因为怕迟到，他焦躁不安地不停看表。.en: Afraid of being late, he kept looking at his watch, feeling restless.

他为了守护名誉赌上了一切。.en: He risked everything to protect his reputation.

名誉损害可能会受到法律处罚。.en: Damage to one's reputation can be subject to legal punishment.

她不仅拥有出众的美貌，还具备才智。.en: She not only has outstanding beauty but also intelligence.

即使时光流逝，她的美貌也依然如故。.en: Even as time passed, her beauty remained the same.

他每个周末都在养老院做志愿活动。.en: He volunteers at the nursing home every weekend.

经常去探望养老院的老人们，让他们不感到孤单，这很重要。.en: It's important to visit the elderly in the nursing home often so they don't feel lonely.

他搬到了城市近郊的一个安静村庄。.en: He moved to a quiet village on the outskirts of the city.

城市近郊有很多可以呼吸新鲜空气的公园。.en: There are many parks in the suburbs where you can breathe fresh air.

看到孩子获奖的样子，作为父母感到非常心满意足。.en: Seeing their child win an award, the parents felt very content.

朋友们吃着我亲手做的蛋糕，觉得很美味，我感到很充实。.en: My friends said the cake I made was delicious, and I felt very fulfilled.

这种方式耗时太长，效率很低。.en: This method takes too long and is very inefficient.

为了提高效率低下的工作流程，召开了会议。.en: A meeting was held to improve the inefficient workflow.

要洗的盘子堆积如山，让人叹了口气。.en: The dishes to wash were piled up, making me sigh.

假期作业堆积如山，完全没有时间和朋友玩。.en: Holiday homework was piled up, and I had no time to play with friends at all.

随着截止日期临近，他一直过着被时间所迫的生活。.en: As the deadline approached, he lived pressed for time.

迫于时间压力，连早饭都没好好吃就去上班了。.en: Pressed for time, I went to work without even having a proper breakfast.

明洞即使在周末也总是很繁华，人潮拥挤。.en: Myeongdong is always bustling even on weekends, crowded with people.

这个小区以前很幽静，但自从有了地铁后变得非常繁华。.en: This neighborhood used to be quiet, but it became very bustling after the subway was built.

图书馆后面那家小咖啡馆非常幽静，适合学习。.en: The small café behind the library is very quiet, perfect for studying.

乡下的奶奶家和城市不同，闲适且空气清新，非常适合休息。.en: Grandma's house in the countryside is different from the city—it's quiet and the air is fresh, perfect for resting.

那位神职人员一生都在为贫困的邻居服务。.en: That clergy member spent their whole life serving the poor neighbors.

教堂里安排神职人员在固定时间聆听信徒的烦恼并提供咨询。.en: The church arranges for clergy to listen to believers' worries and provide counseling at set times.

爷爷被诊断为痴呆症后，全家人都陷入了震惊。.en: After Grandpa was diagnosed with dementia, the whole family was in shock.

据说为了预防痴呆症，坚持阅读和参与社交活动很有帮助。.en: It is said that reading regularly and participating in social activities are helpful for preventing dementia.

他以天生的领导力，在困难的情况下也能让团队成员团结一致。.en: With his innate leadership, he can unite team members even in difficult situations.

她天生具有音乐才能，在小小年纪就以钢琴演奏脱颖而出。.en: She has innate musical talent and stood out with her piano performance at a young age.

他从小在富裕的家庭长大，从未为钱发过愁。.en: He grew up in a wealthy family and never had to worry about money.

这个地区自然资源丰富，在经济上享有巨大优势。.en: This region is rich in natural resources and enjoys a huge economic advantage.

贫困家庭的孩子往往缺乏教育机会。.en: Children from poor families often lack educational opportunities.

他出生在贫困的环境中，但通过不懈努力获得了成功。.en: He was born into poverty but achieved success through relentless effort.

春天的天气太善变了，都不知道该穿什么衣服。.en: Spring weather is so fickle, I don't know what to wear.

那个人很善变，经常改约定甚至放鸽子。.en: That person is very fickle, often changing plans or even standing people up.

她性格非常外向，喜欢与人交往。.en: She is very extroverted and enjoys interacting with people.

外向的人通常能很好地适应职场中需要团队合作的工作。.en: Extroverted people usually adapt well to jobs that require teamwork in the workplace.

他性格豁达，因此很容易交到新朋友。.en: He has an open personality, so it's easy for him to make new friends.

我们的组长很大方豁达，和员工之间的沟通非常顺畅。.en: Our team leader is very generous and open-minded, so communication with employees is very smooth.

内向的人也能用适合自己的方式很好地适应社会生活。.en: Introverted people can also adapt well to social life in a way that suits them.

他性格内向，比起大聚会更喜欢和少数人进行深入的对话。.en: He is introverted, so he prefers deep conversations with a few people over large gatherings.

他有冒冒失失的毛病，经常弄丢重要文件。.en: He has a habit of being rash and often loses important documents.

因为慌慌张张的，差点在楼梯上摔倒，吓了我一跳。.en: Because I was flustered, I almost fell on the stairs, which scared me.

感冒拖了很久，最后发展成肺炎，不得不住院。.en: The cold dragged on for a long time and eventually developed into pneumonia, so I had to be hospitalized.

老年人最好接种流感疫苗来预防肺炎。.en: It's best for the elderly to get a flu shot to prevent pneumonia.

肝炎如果早期发现治疗相对容易，但放任不管可能会变得危险。.en: If hepatitis is detected early, treatment is relatively easy, but if left untreated, it can become dangerous.

他患有慢性肝炎，定期去医院接受治疗和管理。.en: He has chronic hepatitis and regularly goes to the hospital for treatment and management.

我侧耳倾听老师的话，生怕漏掉一个字。.en: I listened attentively to the teacher's words, afraid of missing a single word.

领导人需要时刻保持倾听国民声音的态度。.en: Leaders need to always maintain an attitude of listening to the voices of the people.

糖尿病患者为了调节血糖，需要彻底管理饮食。.en: Diabetes patients need to strictly manage their diet to regulate blood sugar.

我爷爷有糖尿病，每天吃药。.en: My grandfather has diabetes and takes medicine every day.

最近很多企业为了缓解员工压力，开始引入公司内部冥想项目。.en: Recently, many companies have started introducing in-house meditation programs to relieve employee stress.

他说每天早晨冥想20分钟再开始一天，是提高生活质量的秘诀。.en: He says that starting the day with 20 minutes of meditation every morning is the secret to improving his quality of life.

经常吃夜宵容易导致消化不良，最好注意一下。.en: Eating late-night snacks often can easily cause indigestion, so it's best to be careful.

他因为消化不良肚子胀，吃了药后躺了一会儿。.en: He had a bloated stomach from indigestion, took some medicine, and lay down for a while.

压力过大可能会加重胃炎，所以保持心情放松很重要。.en: Excessive stress can worsen gastritis, so it's important to keep your mind relaxed.

胃炎患者最好避免刺激性食物，并规律饮食。.en: Gastritis patients should avoid irritating foods and eat regular meals.

糖尿病患者为了控制血糖，可能需要注射胰岛素。.en: Diabetes patients may need to inject insulin to control their blood sugar.

胰岛素是胰腺分泌的一种激素，起到降低血糖的作用。.en: Insulin is a hormone secreted by the pancreas that lowers blood sugar.

夏天很多人因为吃了变质的食物而患上肠炎。.en: In summer, many people get enteritis from eating spoiled food.

患肠炎时可能会出现脱水症状，所以需要经常喝水。.en: When you have enteritis, you may experience dehydration, so you need to drink water often.

吸烟对肺部健康非常有害，因此最好戒烟。.en: Smoking is very harmful to lung health, so it's best to quit.

运动可以改善肺功能，让呼吸变得更顺畅。.en: Exercise can improve lung function and make breathing easier.

吃太多高脂肪食物会导致胆固醇在血管中堆积，对健康有害。.en: Eating too much high-fat food can cause cholesterol to build up in blood vessels, which is bad for your health.

规律运动能使血管强健，促进血液循环顺畅。.en: Regular exercise strengthens blood vessels and promotes smooth blood circulation.

血压高的话，心脏病的风险可能会增大。.en: If your blood pressure is high, the risk of heart disease may increase.

养成了早上一起来就量血压的习惯。.en: I got into the habit of measuring my blood pressure as soon as I wake up in the morning.

被告在法庭上承认了罪行。.en: The defendant confessed to the crime in court.

收快递时一定要在收据上签名。.en: When receiving a package, you must sign the receipt.

如果丢失收据，退款可能会很困难。.en: If you lose the receipt, getting a refund may be difficult.

这个产品有瑕疵，我要求换货。.en: This product has a defect; I request an exchange.

建筑竣工后发现多处瑕疵。.en: After the building was completed, many defects were found.

他对任何质疑都坚决否认到底。.en: He firmly denies any and all allegations.

尽管证据确凿，他仍然否认自己的嫌疑。.en: Despite clear evidence, he still denies his involvement.

签房子合同时要先支付定金。.en: When signing a house contract, you must first pay the deposit.

放弃定金就可以解除合同。.en: You can cancel the contract by forfeiting the deposit.

租房人每个月都按时交房租，没有拖欠。.en: The tenant pays the rent on time every month without falling behind.

房东和租房人之间产生了矛盾。.en: A conflict arose between the landlord and the tenant.

这件事我已经尽了最大的一份力。.en: I've already done my utmost share in this matter.

他总是做超出自己份额的事情。.en: He always does more than his share.

客厅装壁挂式电视会显得空间更大。.en: A wall-mounted TV in the living room makes the space look bigger.

这个壁挂时钟设计非常高档。.en: This wall clock has a very high-end design.

他以诽谤罪将邻居告上了法庭。.en: He sued his neighbor for defamation.

受害者决定向警方控告他。.en: The victim decided to report him to the police.

我完全无法理解你到底是怎么想的，才会做出那种危险的行为。.en: I can't understand at all what you were thinking to do such a dangerous thing.

比约定时间晚了一个小时，到底发生什么事了？.en: You're an hour late from the agreed time — what happened after all?

今天试着用与众不同的菜单准备了晚餐。.en: Today I tried preparing dinner with a different menu.

他总是以与众不同的视角看待问题。.en: He always looks at problems from a different perspective.

最近很多人为了自我完善而读书。.en: These days, many people read books for self-improvement.

自我完善在职场上也很有帮助。.en: Self-improvement is also very helpful in the workplace.

很多人指责他不负责任的行为。.en: Many people criticized his irresponsible behavior.

指责政府政策的声音越来越高。.en: Voices criticizing government policy are getting louder.

为了缩小与父母之间的代沟，需要多沟通。.en: To narrow the generation gap with parents, we need to communicate more.

代沟不仅仅是年龄差异，更是源于价值观的不同。.en: The generation gap is not just about age difference, but stems from different values.

这篇论文专业术语太多，很难理解。.en: This paper has too much specialized terminology, making it hard to understand.

法律术语应该用普通人容易理解的方式解释。.en: Legal terminology should be explained in a way that ordinary people can easily understand.

他催促朋友还借的钱。.en: He urged his friend to pay back the borrowed money.

上司催促快点提交报告。.en: The boss urged him to submit the report quickly.

别再说了，到此为止吧。.en: Don't say anymore, let's stop here.

既然是他决定的事，我也就罢了。.en: Since it's his decision, I'll just let it go.

作为历史课的一部分，我们去参观了古宫。.en: As part of history class, we went on a field trip to the old palace.

建筑系学生为了实地调查出国了。.en: Architecture students went abroad for a field trip.

这个项目预算紧张，困难很多。.en: This project has a tight budget and many difficulties.

他的心中充满了激动。.en: His heart was full of excitement.

夜空变得漆黑，星星开始闪烁。.en: The night sky turned pitch black, and the stars began to twinkle.

他气得脸色铁青。.en: He was so angry that his face turned blue.

这个柿子还没熟透，味道发涩。.en: This persimmon isn't ripe yet, it tastes astringent.

第一次喝味道发涩的茶。.en: First time drinking tea that tastes astringent.

鱼放久了有腥味。.en: Fish left out for a long time develops a fishy smell.

这肉有腥味，不想吃。.en: This meat has a fishy smell, I don't want to eat it.

个人信息被滥用的事例越来越多。.en: Cases of personal information being abused are increasing.

这种药物使用不当有被滥用的风险。.en: If this medication is used improperly, there is a risk of it being abused.

日后会有一天证明这个选择是正确的。.en: Someday in the future, it will be proven that this choice was right.

当时并未察觉，但日后那段经历帮了大忙。.en: I didn't realize it at the time, but later that experience helped a lot.

进入近代社会后，工业革命全面展开。.en: After entering modern society, the Industrial Revolution unfolded fully.

这部作品被公认为近代文学的杰出代表作。.en: This work is recognized as an outstanding representative of modern literature.

随着经济复苏，消费者心理也日益好转。.en: As the economy recovers, consumer sentiment is also improving day by day.

她的实力随着反复练习而日渐提升。.en: Her skills are improving day by day through repeated practice.

他以出色的观察力连细微的变化也不放过。.en: With his excellent observation skills, he doesn't miss even the slightest change.

为了培养孩子们的观察力，自然体验学习很重要。.en: Natural experiential learning is important for developing children's observation skills.

那个地区依然保留着强烈的保守价值观。.en: That region still maintains strong conservative values.

他性格保守，不太愿意尝试新事物。.en: He has a conservative personality and is reluctant to try new things.

由于时间限制，无法执行所有计划。.en: Due to time constraints, not all plans could be carried out.

如果没有法律限制，本可以做出更大胆的投资。.en: Without legal restrictions, bolder investments could have been made.

在中世纪的欧洲，教会在社会各方面拥有强大的影响力。.en: In medieval Europe, the church had strong influence in all aspects of society.

这座城堡是中世纪时期建造的代表性防御要塞。.en: This castle is a representative defensive fortress built during the Middle Ages.

如今年轻一代的婚姻观与过去大不相同。.en: These days, the younger generation's view on marriage is very different from the past.

他持有开放的婚姻观，并不反对早婚。.en: He has an open view on marriage and is not opposed to early marriage.

已婚者往往能享受税收减免优惠。.en: Married people often enjoy tax deduction benefits.

她虽然已婚，但依然对自己的事业充满热情。.en: Although she is married, she is still passionate about her career.

面向未婚男女的定制型理财商品备受欢迎。.en: Customized financial products for unmarried men and women are very popular.

他虽然未婚，但完全不感到结婚的压力。.en: Although he is unmarried, he feels no pressure to get married at all.

与配偶之间的信任是幸福婚姻生活的基础。.en: Trust between spouses is the foundation of a happy married life.

他在选择配偶时比起性格更看重价值观。.en: When choosing a spouse, he values shared values more than personality.

周末我比起安静的咖啡馆更偏爱热闹的市场。.en: On weekends, I prefer lively markets over quiet cafes.

韩国消费者重视新鲜度，偏爱国产农产品。.en: Korean consumers value freshness and prefer domestic agricultural products.

离婚后仍积极看待再婚的人越来越多。.en: More and more people are positively considering remarriage after divorce.

他决定再婚时与子女们进行了充分的沟通。.en: When he decided to remarry, he communicated thoroughly with his children.

过去大部分婚姻都是通过做媒促成的。.en: In the past, most marriages were arranged through matchmaking.

通过说媒相识的两人最终成功结婚了。.en: The two who met through matchmaking ended up getting married successfully.

双方父母初次见面后，正式提亲的事宜开始推进。.en: After both sets of parents met for the first time, the formal marriage proposal began to move forward.

虽然正在谈论婚事，但日期尚未确定。.en: Although they are discussing marriage, the date has not been set yet.

如今更倾向于以现金或实用家电作为嫁妆。.en: Nowadays, people prefer cash or practical appliances as dowry.

因为准备彩礼，两人经历了不少意见冲突。.en: They had quite a few disagreements while preparing the bride price.

那所学校对外国留学生是非常开放的氛围。.en: That school has a very open-minded atmosphere toward international students.

她性格开放，很容易和陌生人熟络起来。.en: She is open-minded and easily gets close to strangers.

那位设计师的衣服非常有个性，在年轻人群中很受欢迎。.en: That designer's clothes are very unique and popular among young people.

拥有个性化思维的人聚集在一起，便诞生了创新。.en: When people with unique ways of thinking come together, innovation is born.

文化不同，思考方式自然也会不同。.en: If the culture is different, the way of thinking will naturally be different too.

多亏了积极的思考方式，他善于克服困难。.en: Thanks to his positive way of thinking, he is good at overcoming difficulties.

这个政党以进步的经济政策为纲领，赢得了支持。.en: This political party won support with its progressive economic policies as its platform.

他在社会问题上持有非常进步的立场。.en: He holds a very progressive stance on social issues.

我把重要文件落在家里没放进包里带来了。.en: I left the important documents at home and didn't put them in my bag to bring.

他在演讲中漏掉了核心内容，导致听众感到困惑。.en: He skipped the core content in his speech, causing the audience to feel confused.

相互信任是良好关系的基础。.en: Mutual trust is the foundation of a good relationship.

他很守约，是大家都信赖的人。.en: He keeps his promises well, so he is a person everyone trusts.

年初年末.en: the beginning and end of the year

年初年末之际，许多人为了与家人共度时光而回到家乡。.en: Around the beginning and end of the year, many people return to their hometowns to spend time with their families.

因为年初年末特辑节目，电视编制表与平时大不相同。.en: Because of the special programs at the beginning and end of the year, the TV schedule is very different from usual.

这家电视台因过度侧重演艺娱乐节目而受到批评。.en: This TV station has been criticized for focusing too much on entertainment shows.

随着演艺娱乐产业的发展，许多年轻人梦想成为艺人。.en: With the development of the entertainment industry, many young people dream of becoming entertainers.

查看周末编制表后发现，有多部有趣的电影即将播出。.en: After checking the weekend schedule, I found that several interesting movies are about to air.

编制表突然变更，观众们表达了不满。.en: The schedule suddenly changed, and viewers expressed their dissatisfaction.

今天报纸的社论对最近的经济危机提供了深入的分析。.en: Today's newspaper editorial provides an in-depth analysis of the recent economic crisis.

他读完社论后，对政府的政策有了更批判性的看法。.en: After reading the editorial, he developed a more critical view of the government's policy.

经过几年艰苦准备终于通过考试后，我深切体会到‘苦尽甘来’这句话。.en: After finally passing the exam after years of hard preparation, I deeply felt the truth of 'after hardship comes happiness'.

每当生意困难时，母亲总是鼓励我说‘苦尽甘来’。.en: Whenever business was tough, my mother would encourage me by saying 'after hardship comes happiness'.

他通过前辈的介绍得到了好工作，沾了很大的光。.en: He got a good job through a senior's introduction and really basked in reflected glory.

托朋友的福能以低价买到东西，真是沾光了。.en: Thanks to a friend, I was able to buy something at a low price — I really basked in reflected glory.

昨晚做的奇怪的梦让我很在意，于是在网上查了解梦。.en: The strange dream I had last night bothered me, so I looked up dream interpretation online.

奶奶总是相信对梦的解梦，并常常据此行动。.en: Grandma always believes in dream interpretations and often acts on them.

在那个部落，吃特定动物被视为禁忌。.en: In that tribe, eating certain animals is considered taboo.

在会议中提起那个话题几乎等同于禁忌。.en: Bringing up that topic in a meeting is almost taboo.

如果跟不上快速变化的技术趋势，就只能在竞争中落后。.en: If you can't keep up with rapidly changing technology trends, you'll only fall behind in the competition.

他从小时候起就经常帮助在学习上落后的朋友。.en: Since he was young, he often helped friends who were falling behind in their studies.

在中世纪欧洲，许多女性被诬陷为魔女而遭火刑。.en: In medieval Europe, many women were falsely accused of being witches and burned at the stake.

童话中的魔女通常被描绘成拥有邪恶力量的存在。.en: Witches in fairy tales are usually depicted as beings with evil powers.

他在事业上取得了巨大成功，积累了巨额财富。.en: He achieved great success in his career and amassed a huge fortune.

越来越多的人意识到，比起积累财物，健康更重要。.en: More and more people realize that health is more important than accumulating wealth.

奶奶每到新年都会去找村里的算命先生占卜一年的运势。.en: Every New Year, Grandma goes to the village fortune teller to have her fortune told for the year.

她在结婚前去算命馆占卜了与新郎的合婚。.en: Before getting married, she went to a fortune-telling place to have the compatibility with her groom divined.

为了看奥运会开幕式的转播，家人们聚集在客厅里。.en: The family gathered in the living room to watch the broadcast of the Olympics opening ceremony.

这场足球比赛将向全球进行实时转播。.en: This soccer match will be broadcast live around the world.

出战，参赛.en: to go out and compete / to participate in a match

那位选手尽管受伤，仍决定出战重要比赛。.en: That athlete decided to compete in the important match despite being injured.

作为国家队出战的选手们获得了金牌。.en: The athletes who competed as the national team won gold medals.

面临考试的学生们祈愿合格，行了叩拜礼。.en: Students facing exams prayed for success and performed a bowing ritual.

他们在新年第一天看日出时，祈愿家人的健康和幸福。.en: On New Year's Day, they watched the sunrise and prayed for their family's health and happiness.

她为了顺利分娩，从产前就开始坚持运动。.en: She exercised regularly before giving birth to ensure a smooth delivery.

最近韩国的生育率创历史新低，成为社会问题。.en: Recently, South Korea's birth rate hit a record low, becoming a social issue.

那场交通事故导致三人死亡，多人受伤。.en: That traffic accident caused three deaths and multiple injuries.

医生为了准确查明患者的死亡原因进行了尸检。.en: The doctor performed an autopsy to accurately determine the cause of the patient's death.

那件事跟我完全不相干，请不要问我。.en: That matter has nothing to do with me, so please don't ask me about it.

你见谁虽然跟我无关，但我是因为担心才说的。.en: Who you meet is none of my business, but I'm saying this because I'm worried.

为了纪念升职，我决定请同事们吃一顿。.en: To celebrate my promotion, I decided to treat my colleagues to a meal.

成功完成项目的团队成员们聚在一起，由组长请了客。.en: The team members who successfully completed the project gathered together, and the team leader treated everyone.

在韩国，像巫俗这样的民间信仰有着悠久的历史。.en: In Korea, folk beliefs like shamanism have a long history.

民间信仰与官方宗教不同，在各个地区以独特的形式发展而来。.en: Unlike official religions, folk beliefs developed in unique forms in each region.

他的主张是非科学的，因此很难相信。.en: His claim is unscientific, so it's hard to believe.

试图用非科学的方法解决问题反而可能使情况恶化。.en: Trying to solve a problem with unscientific methods might actually make the situation worse.

在那部电影中，恶魔利用人类的欲望使世界陷入混乱。.en: In that movie, the demon uses human desires to throw the world into chaos.

他带着恶魔般的微笑，精准地击中了对方的弱点。.en: With a demonic smile, he precisely hit the opponent's weak point.

运气好的时候，连小事也容易解决。.en: When luck is good, even small things are easy to solve.

他没有抱怨运气不好，而是选择了自己努力。.en: He didn't complain about bad luck, but chose to work hard himself.

生辰八字.en: Four Pillars of Destiny (birth year, month, day, hour)

妈妈去算命馆看我的生辰八字了。.en: Mom went to a fortune teller to check my Four Pillars of Destiny.

根据生辰八字，他们今年结婚的话不太好。.en: According to the Four Pillars of Destiny, it's not good for them to get married this year.

因为信用卡额度高就过度消费，结果债台高筑。.en: Because he overconsumed due to a high credit limit, he ended up deep in debt.

最近，年轻人对奢侈品的过度消费正成为社会问题。.en: Recently, young people's overconsumption of luxury goods is becoming a social problem.

一点钱，极少的钱.en: a small amount of money, very little money

他说自己曾靠仅仅一千韩元撑过一天。.en: He said he once got through a day on just one thousand won.

为了买仅值一万韩元的东西排队一小时，真不敢相信。.en: Waiting in line for an hour to buy something worth just ten thousand won, I can't believe it.

他谦虚地说，自己所做的一切只不过是做了理所当然的事。.en: He humbly said that everything he did was just doing what was only natural.

你想要的不是我帮你，而是你自己做决定罢了。.en: What you want is not for me to help you, but for you to make the decision yourself.

这个月娱乐费用支出太多，得减少其他开销了。.en: We spent too much on entertainment this month, so we need to cut back on other expenses.

公司有向员工提供娱乐费用支持的福利制度。.en: The company has a welfare system that supports employees with entertainment expenses.

这家咖啡连锁店在全国运营着超过500家加盟店。.en: This coffee chain operates over 500 franchise stores nationwide.

加盟店店主们对总部的单方面政策变更表示了不满。.en: The franchise store owners expressed dissatisfaction with the headquarters' unilateral policy changes.

他有可以免除兵役的特殊理由。.en: He has a special reason to be exempted from military service.

这次考试免除了提交语言成绩的要求。.en: This exam waived the requirement to submit language scores.

用这张卡办理无息分期付款，可以没有太大负担地购买商品。.en: Using this card for interest-free installment payments allows you to buy items without too much burden.

无息贷款的条件比想象中苛刻，所以我放弃了申请。.en: The conditions for the interest-free loan were stricter than I thought, so I gave up on applying.

这张信用卡没有年费，但优惠也较少。.en: This credit card has no annual fee, but the benefits are also fewer.

因为觉得交年费可惜，所以取消会员资格的人正在增加。.en: More people are canceling their memberships because they think paying the annual fee is a waste.

一次性付清可以享受额外折扣。.en: You can get an extra discount if you pay in a lump sum.

我通常更喜欢分期付款而不是一次性付清。.en: I usually prefer installment payments over paying in a lump sum.

积累积分的话，以后可以享受折扣。.en: If you accumulate points, you can get discounts later.

每月积累一定金额的习惯长期来看会有很大帮助。.en: The habit of accumulating a certain amount each month will be very helpful in the long run.

因为卡限额不足，没能支付大额款项。.en: I couldn't pay the large amount because the card limit was insufficient.

这个账户的取款限额设定为每天五百万韩元。.en: The withdrawal limit for this account is set at five million won per day.

这套家具可以分12期付款购买。.en: This furniture set can be purchased in 12 installments.

分期利息有负担，所以改成了一次性付清。.en: The interest on installments was burdensome, so I switched to a lump sum payment.

公益广告在提高社会问题认知方面发挥着重要作用。.en: Public service advertisements play an important role in raising awareness of social issues.

最近的公益广告中强调环境保护重要性的内容变多了。.en: Recently, there have been more public service ads emphasizing the importance of environmental protection.

那位著名演员被选为新化妆品的广告模特。.en: That famous actor was selected as the advertising model for the new cosmetics.

广告模特的形象对产品销售的影响非常大。.en: The image of the advertising model has a huge impact on product sales.

广告客户更倾向于选择能确保更多观众的时间段。.en: Advertisers tend to prefer time slots that can guarantee more viewers.

这个节目应广告客户的要求，内容进行了一部分修改。.en: This program's content was partially modified at the request of the advertiser.

市场好像出了乱子，人们四处奔跑。.en: It seems there was trouble at the market, and people were running around.

孩子们在房间里闹得乱七八糟，根本没法学习。.en: The children made such a mess in the room that it was impossible to study.

在线广告因为精准投放，效果相对较高。.en: Online advertising is relatively effective because of precise targeting.

最近在线广告费用正在逐渐上涨。.en: Recently, online advertising costs have been gradually rising.

一般人是很难通过那场难的考试的。.en: It is very difficult for an ordinary person to pass that tough exam.

除非天气很差，否则我一般不会取消约定。.en: Unless the weather is really bad, I usually don't cancel plans.

咖啡因会刺激神经系统，可能导致失眠。.en: Caffeine can stimulate the nervous system and may cause insomnia.

他挑衅性的发言刺激了听众的愤怒。.en: His provocative remarks stirred up the audience's anger.

孩子一整天缠着妈妈要买玩具。.en: The child pestered his mom all day to buy him a toy.

他为了升职纠缠上司，最终得到了许可。.en: He pestered his boss for a promotion and eventually got permission.

越是危机情况，越需要冷静的判断力。.en: The more critical the situation, the more you need calm judgment.

他因为经验不足，判断力经常变得模糊。.en: Due to his lack of experience, his judgment often becomes unclear.

中秋节之际，全家人回到家乡扫墓了。.en: During Chuseok, the whole family went back to our hometown to visit the graves.

要去祖父的墓地扫墓，得走很远的路爬上去。.en: To visit my grandfather's grave, we have to climb a long way up.

我在想用拜年收到的压岁钱买什么。.en: I'm thinking about what to buy with the New Year's money I received.

最近也有人给孩子们送礼物代替压岁钱。.en: These days, some people give gifts to children instead of New Year's money.

婚礼上邀请了所有亲人和朋友。.en: All relatives and friends were invited to the wedding.

他听说远房亲戚住院了。.en: He heard that a distant relative was hospitalized.

他在会议期间一直没说话。.en: He didn't say a word throughout the meeting.

旅行期间天气一直很好，所以心情很好。.en: The weather was nice throughout the trip, so I felt great.

热带地区一年四季都持续炎热潮湿的天气。.en: In tropical regions, hot and humid weather continues all year round.

他为去热带地区旅行准备了薄衣服和驱蚊药。.en: He prepared light clothes and mosquito repellent for his trip to the tropical region.

庆州有很多被列入联合国教科文组织世界文化遗产的遗迹。.en: Gyeongju has many relics listed as UNESCO World Cultural Heritage sites.

保护世界文化遗产是全人类的共同责任。.en: Protecting World Cultural Heritage is a shared responsibility of all humanity.

该地区被指定为特别观光地，出入受到管制。.en: The area was designated as a special tourist site, and access is restricted.

那栋建筑被指定为文化遗产后，开始了修缮工程。.en: After that building was designated as a cultural heritage site, renovation work began.

（运动会或庆祝游行时的）假扮队伍.en: costume parade (at sports events or celebrations)

庆典期间，华丽的假扮队伍穿梭于市区。.en: During the festival, a splendid costume parade moved through the city.

孩子们看到装扮成动物的假扮队伍非常开心。.en: The children were very happy to see the costume parade dressed as animals.

奶奶为了祈求村庄平安举行了神祭。.en: Grandmother held a shamanic ritual to pray for the village's safety.

那场跳大神以巫女的舞蹈和歌声持续了三个小时。.en: That exorcism ceremony lasted three hours with the shaman's dance and song.

奥运会开幕式后，运动员们进行了街道游行。.en: After the Olympic opening ceremony, the athletes held a street parade.

国庆节时可以在街上看到军乐队的街道游行。.en: On National Day, you can see a military band street parade on the streets.

举办了纪念那位画家诞辰100周年的纪念展。.en: A commemorative exhibition was held for the 100th anniversary of the painter's birth.

纪念展上展出了从作家早期作品到最新作品。.en: The commemorative exhibition displayed works from the author's early to latest pieces.

在美国，秋收感恩节时家人聚在一起吃火鸡料理。.en: In the US, families gather for Thanksgiving and eat turkey dishes.

秋收感恩节是感谢丰收的节日。.en: Thanksgiving is a holiday to give thanks for the harvest.

他因长时间劳动最终过劳死去世了。.en: He eventually died from overwork due to long hours of labor.

要预防过劳死，适当的休息和压力管理很重要。.en: To prevent death from overwork, proper rest and stress management are important.

他有意识地努力将负面想法转变为正面想法。.en: He consciously makes an effort to turn negative thoughts into positive ones.

他是周末也不休息、典型的工作狂。.en: He is a typical workaholic who doesn't even rest on weekends.

像工作狂一样只工作的话，可能会损害健康。.en: If you work like a workaholic, you might damage your health.

在现代社会，个人主义倾向越来越强。.en: In modern society, the tendency toward individualism is getting stronger.

他个人主义很强，难以适应需要团队合作的工作。.en: He is very individualistic and finds it hard to adapt to jobs that require teamwork.

如果利己主义蔓延，整个社会的和谐就有被破坏的危险。.en: If egoism spreads, the harmony of the whole society is at risk of being destroyed.

他的行为源于纯粹的利己主义。.en: His actions stem from pure egoism.

健康补品不是药品，所以不应过度依赖。.en: Health supplements are not medicine, so you shouldn't rely on them too much.

他因常年疲劳所困，早上起床很困难。.en: He is troubled by chronic fatigue, so it's hard for him to get up in the morning.

要克服常年疲劳，规律的生活习惯是必须的。.en: To overcome chronic fatigue, regular lifestyle habits are essential.

高血压和糖尿病被列为代表性的成人病。.en: High blood pressure and diabetes are listed as representative adult diseases.

年轻人群中成人病的发病率也在上升，需要注意。.en: The incidence of adult diseases is also rising among young people, so caution is needed.

最近感觉体力明显下降，所以开始按时服用综合营养剂了。.en: Recently I felt my physical strength was noticeably declining, so I started taking a multivitamin supplement regularly.

医生推荐我服用综合营养剂，以补充仅靠均衡饮食仍不足的营养素。.en: My doctor recommended I take a multivitamin supplement to make up for the nutrients that a balanced diet alone can't provide.

他和老朋友的联系完全断绝已经超过十年了。.en: His contact with old friends has been completely cut off for over ten years.

因为一场大型交通事故，道路多处中断，修复工作正在进行中。.en: Due to a major traffic accident, the road was cut off in several places, and repair work is underway.

这款产品设计出众，但另一方面价格太贵，让人犹豫是否购买。.en: This product has great design, but on the other hand, it's too expensive, making me hesitate to buy it.

他在公司里属于非常安静的类型，相反在家里却会和家人互相开玩笑，过得很活跃。.en: He is very quiet at the company, but on the other hand, at home he jokes around with his family and is very lively.

随着智能手机的广泛普及，人们的日常生活完全改变了。.en: With the widespread use of smartphones, people's daily lives have completely changed.

这款疫苗预计将迅速普及到全国所有的保健所。.en: This vaccine is expected to quickly become available at all public health centers nationwide.

最近青少年自杀问题变得严重，学校也在加强预防教育。.en: Recently, the issue of teenage suicide has become serious, and schools are strengthening prevention education.

他因严重的抑郁症试图自杀，但幸好被家人发现，保住了性命。.en: He attempted suicide due to severe depression, but fortunately his family found him and he survived.

正如各位所知，本次项目因预算不足而暂时中断了。.en: As you all know, this project has been temporarily suspended due to budget shortages.

正如你所知，我本来就不是早起型的人，所以上午9点的会议总是很吃力。.en: As you know, I'm not a morning person, so 9 AM meetings are always tough for me.

我们公司除了首尔总部，在釜山和大丘也分别设有分公司。.en: Our company has branch offices in Busan and Daegu in addition to the headquarters in Seoul.

他上个月被任命为越南分公司社长，开始去河内上班。.en: He was appointed as the president of the Vietnam branch last month and started commuting to Hanoi.

今天下午的会议上，就新的营销策略进行了深入的商议。.en: At this afternoon's meeting, we had an in-depth discussion about the new marketing strategy.

公司决定派遣专家小组到海外进行当地市场调查。.en: The company decided to dispatch an expert team overseas to conduct local market research.

他走过的路，和成功故事一样，是接连不断的艰难挑战。.en: The path he walked, like his success story, was a series of difficult challenges.

直接选举具有更能准确反映选民意愿的优点。.en: Direct elections have the advantage of more accurately reflecting voters' opinions.

他坚信实际能力比学历背景更重要。.en: He firmly believes that practical ability is more important than educational background.

政府计划大幅扩大面向青年层的公共住宅供应。.en: The government plans to significantly expand the supply of public housing for young people.

随着公共住宅入住资格放宽，更多人能够受益。.en: As eligibility for public housing is relaxed, more people can benefit.

非正式员工在工资和福利方面往往比正式员工受到更多歧视。.en: Non-regular employees often face more discrimination than regular employees in terms of wages and benefits.

政府正在推进改善非正式员工待遇的法案。.en: The government is pushing forward a bill to improve the treatment of non-regular employees.

在选举游说期间，候选人一天内要访问多个城市。.en: During election campaigning, candidates visit multiple cities in a single day.

他的选举游说未能获得选民共鸣，最终以失败告终。.en: His election campaign failed to resonate with voters and ultimately ended in failure.

这部作品是作者激烈思考与努力的产物。.en: This work is the product of the author's intense thinking and effort.

科学技术的发展可以说是现代文明的产物。.en: The development of science and technology can be said to be a product of modern civilization.

他的音乐天赋究竟是先天的，还是后天训练的结果，存在争议。.en: There is debate over whether his musical talent is innate or the result of training.

患有先天心脏疾病的孩子如果接受适当治疗，也能健康成长。.en: Children with congenital heart disease can also grow up healthy if they receive proper treatment.

这个博物馆生动地再现了古代人的生活方式。.en: This museum vividly recreates the lifestyle of ancient people.

那位演员因完美再现了历史人物的形象而获得好评。.en: That actor received praise for perfectly recreating the image of a historical figure.

这款软件在处理大规模数据时展现出最佳性能。.en: This software shows the best performance when processing large-scale data.

专家分析称现在是买入股票的最佳时机。.en: Experts say now is the best time to buy stocks.

选手竞技水平突然下降的原因被查明是受伤所致。.en: The reason for the sudden drop in the player's competitive level was found to be an injury.

为了提高队伍的竞技水平，教练引入了新的战略。.en: To improve the team's competitive level, the coach introduced a new strategy.

体力锻炼能提高基础代谢率，对减肥很有效。.en: Physical exercise can increase your basal metabolic rate, which is effective for weight loss.

随着年龄增长，坚持进行体力锻炼变得尤为重要。.en: As you get older, it becomes especially important to keep up with physical exercise.

这个理论以多年的实验数据为基础。.en: This theory is based on years of experimental data.

信任是良好人际关系最重要的基础。.en: Trust is the most important foundation of good relationships.

有氧运动对增强心肺功能有卓越的效果。.en: Aerobic exercise has excellent effects on strengthening heart and lung function.

每天进行30分钟以上的有氧运动可以改善血液循环。.en: Doing more than 30 minutes of aerobic exercise every day can improve blood circulation.

有人说在马拉松中最重要的不是体力而是精神力量。.en: Some people say that in a marathon, mental strength is more important than physical strength.

他以强大的精神力量克服了艰难的逆境。.en: He overcame difficult adversity with his strong mental strength.

对于马拉松选手来说，耐力比速度更重要。.en: For marathon runners, endurance is more important than speed.

这项运动对初学者来说，如果耐力不足，很容易中途放弃。.en: For beginners in this sport, if you lack endurance, it's easy to give up halfway.

他在艰苦的训练之后，成功缩短了100米纪录。.en: After hard training, he succeeded in shortening his 100-meter record.

这次比赛中有很多选手以缩短纪录为目标。.en: In this competition, many athletes aim to shorten their records.

考试前做深呼吸有助于缓解紧张。.en: Taking deep breaths before an exam helps relieve tension.

瑜伽是缓解身心紧张的有效运动。.en: Yoga is an effective exercise for relieving mental and physical tension.

企业必须制定应对急剧变化的市场状况的策略。.en: Companies must develop strategies to cope with rapidly changing market conditions.

在此次危机情况下，我们的应对策略决定了成败。.en: In this crisis, our coping strategy will determine success or failure.

职业选手为了提高比赛成绩，会并行进行心理训练。.en: Professional athletes do mental training alongside physical training to improve their performance.

心理训练对于克服不安情绪和提高专注力很有效。.en: Mental training is effective for overcoming anxiety and improving concentration.

婚礼比预想中举办得隆重得多，让所有人都很惊讶。.en: The wedding was much more magnificent than expected, surprising everyone.

那个国家以盛大的庆典来纪念独立日。.en: That country celebrates its Independence Day with a grand festival.

孩子们正在引颈期盼圣诞节的到来。.en: The children are eagerly awaiting Christmas.

我翘首期盼着和她的第一次海外旅行。.en: I'm eagerly looking forward to my first overseas trip with her.

演奏结束后，全体观众起立鼓掌。.en: After the performance ended, the entire audience gave a standing ovation.

他感人的演讲赢得了观众席上的起立鼓掌。.en: His moving speech earned a standing ovation from the audience.

那位演员今年在电影节上成为三冠王，度过了最辉煌的一年。.en: That actor became a triple crown winner at the film festival this year, having the most brilliant year.

这位选手在全国体育大会上成为四冠王，并创下了新纪录。.en: This athlete became a quadruple crown winner at the National Sports Festival and set a new record.

他把不论输赢都堂堂正正地比赛视为首要原则。.en: He considers competing fair and square, regardless of winning or losing, as his top principle.

堂堂正正的竞争是体育精神的核心。.en: Fair and square competition is the core of sportsmanship.

两兄弟的性格截然相反，人们经常拿他们作比较。.en: The two brothers have completely opposite personalities, and people often compare them.

过去阴暗的气氛和现在充满活力的气氛形成了鲜明的对比。.en: The gloomy atmosphere of the past and the vibrant atmosphere of the present form a stark contrast.

他无论多累都从不表露出不舒服的神色。.en: No matter how tired he is, he never shows any sign of discomfort.

她虽然听到了好消息，但几乎没有表露出来。.en: Although she heard the good news, she barely showed it.

通过此次法律修订，劳动者的权利得到了进一步强化。.en: Through this legal revision, workers' rights have been further strengthened.

政府正在为修订教育制度而收集专家意见。.en: The government is collecting expert opinions to revise the education system.

奶奶用充满关爱的眼神看着孙子，担心他的健康。.en: The grandmother looked at her grandson with caring eyes, worried about his health.

他关切的提问让我心里暖暖的。.en: His concerned question made me feel warm inside.

韩国也逐渐变为多元文化社会，各种文化得以共存。.en: Korea is gradually becoming a multicultural society where various cultures coexist.

在多元文化社会中，理解来自不同背景的人是必不可少的。.en: In a multicultural society, understanding people from different backgrounds is essential.

俄罗斯是一个以拥有多种文化的多民族国家而闻名。.en: Russia is known as a multiethnic country with diverse cultures.

在多民族社会中，尊重彼此传统和习俗的态度很重要。.en: In a multiethnic society, an attitude of respecting each other's traditions and customs is important.

他们的关系表面上看起来很好，但实际上矛盾很多。.en: Their relationship looks good on the surface, but in reality, there are many conflicts.

如果只根据表面的理由来判断，很容易错过真相。.en: If you judge only by superficial reasons, it's easy to miss the truth.

他向老朋友倾诉了自己关于前途的苦恼。.en: He confided his worries about the future to an old friend.

需要一个能让你敞开心扉倾诉苦闷的人。.en: You need someone you can open up to and vent your frustrations.

新职员在适应工作的过程中会经历各种苦衷。.en: New employees experience various difficulties while adapting to their work.

公司为了听取员工们的苦衷，定期举办座谈会。.en: The company holds regular meetings to listen to employees' difficulties.

他向咨询师倾吐了长久以来积压的苦衷之后，感觉轻松多了。.en: After pouring out the troubles he had been holding in for a long time to the counselor, he felt much lighter.

通过互相倾吐苦衷的时间，团队氛围变好了。.en: Through time spent pouring out each other's troubles, the team atmosphere improved.

两个部门通过会议达成协议，决定消除长期的矛盾。.en: The two departments reached an agreement through a meeting and decided to resolve their long-standing conflict.

没有真诚的对话，就很难消除矛盾。.en: Without sincere dialogue, it's hard to resolve a conflict.

由于意见相左，团队成员之间产生了摩擦。.en: Due to differences of opinion, friction arose among team members.

利益关系交织在一起时，组织内部很容易发生摩擦。.en: When interests are intertwined, friction easily occurs within an organization.

两国因长期的领土争端而不断经历摩擦。.en: The two countries continuously experience friction due to their long-standing territorial dispute.

在经历了与新加入的团队成员之间的摩擦后，他决定改变沟通方式。.en: After experiencing friction with new team members, he decided to change his communication style.

他无礼的发言在会议中引起了不必要的摩擦。.en: His rude remarks caused unnecessary friction during the meeting.

预算分配问题正在部门之间引起严重的摩擦。.en: Budget allocation issues are causing serious friction between departments.

在这个地区，居民和施工方之间的摩擦很严重。.en: In this area, friction between residents and the construction team is severe.

因性格差异，两人之间的摩擦变得严重，于是建议他们进行咨询。.en: Due to personality differences, the friction between the two became severe, so they were advised to seek counseling.

在决定职业方向之前，他向平时尊敬的教授征询了意见。.en: Before deciding on a career path, he sought advice from a professor he usually respects.

在需要做出艰难决定时，向周围的人征询意见是明智的做法。.en: When faced with a difficult decision, it's wise to seek advice from those around you.

前辈为了后辈的成长，总是毫不吝惜地给予真诚的建议。.en: The senior always gives sincere advice generously for the junior's growth.

那位导师每当弟子遇到困难时，都不吝赐予温暖的忠告。.en: That mentor never hesitates to give warm advice whenever his disciples face difficulties.

在长时间的争吵之后，他率先向朋友请求和解。.en: After a long argument, he was the first to request reconciliation with his friend.

她承认了错误，并真诚地向对方请求和解。.en: She admitted her mistake and sincerely requested reconciliation with the other party.

母亲努力使争吵的两个儿子和解。.en: The mother tried to reconcile her two arguing sons.

调解人让双方理解了彼此的立场，并成功使他们和解。.en: The mediator helped both sides understand each other's positions and successfully reconciled them.

这种病毒对免疫力弱的人可能是致命的。.en: This virus can be fatal to people with weak immune systems.

他的失误给公司的声誉带来了毁灭性的打击。.en: His mistake dealt a devastating blow to the company's reputation.

围绕环境保护的争论在国会中激烈地展开了。.en: The debate over environmental protection unfolded fiercely in the National Assembly.

他在剧烈运动后一定会做拉伸。.en: He always stretches after intense exercise.

他具备涵盖人文和科学等多方面的知识。.en: He has multifaceted knowledge covering humanities and sciences.

这个项目为了成功需要多方面的合作。.en: This project requires multifaceted cooperation to succeed.

被打通，被打穿.en: to be pierced through, to be broken through

经过长时间的施工，穿山的隧道终于被打通了。.en: After a long period of construction, the tunnel through the mountain was finally pierced through.

敌人的防线最终被突破，战局急转直下。.en: The enemy's defense line was finally broken through, and the war situation took a sharp turn for the worse.

他为了生计不得不从清晨工作到深夜。.en: He had to work from early morning until late at night to make a living.

失业后生计变得渺茫，他申请了政府援助。.en: After losing his job, his livelihood became uncertain, so he applied for government assistance.

警察在发生事故的路口控制着交通。.en: The police are controlling traffic at the intersection where the accident occurred.

他回家的每个路口都有花店，心情很好。.en: There was a flower shop at every intersection on his way home, which made him feel good.

祖先们曾想按照风水在风水宝地修建坟墓。.en: Our ancestors wanted to build tombs in auspicious locations according to feng shui.

这块地自古以来就被认为是风水宝地，很多人都来寻访。.en: This land has been considered an auspicious location since ancient times, and many people come to visit it.

高楼之间视野开阔，露出海景，景色十分壮观。.en: The view is open between the tall buildings, revealing the sea, and the scenery is spectacular.

经过长时间的苦恼，心情豁然开朗，想出了新的解决方法。.en: After a long period of worry, my mind suddenly cleared and I came up with a new solution.

这座石塔被指定为韩国的代表性国宝。.en: This stone pagoda has been designated as a representative national treasure of Korea.

国宝第一号崇礼门是韩国人的骄傲。.en: National Treasure No. 1, Sungnyemun, is a source of pride for Koreans.

联合国教科文组织将这个村庄列为世界文化遗产。.en: UNESCO has listed this village as a World Cultural Heritage site.

我们有义务保护珍贵的文化遗产并传给后代。.en: We have a duty to protect precious cultural heritage and pass it on to future generations.

这次地震导致数百年历史的木制文化遗产严重受损。.en: This earthquake caused severe damage to a centuries-old wooden cultural heritage site.

为了保护文化遗产，不仅需要政府的支持，市民的关注也很重要。.en: To protect cultural heritage, not only government support but also citizens' attention is important.

这座城郭是500年前为抵御敌人入侵而修建的。.en: This fortress was built 500 years ago to defend against enemy invasions.

登上城郭，整个城市尽收眼底。.en: When you climb up the fortress, you can see the entire city at a glance.

博物馆里展示着青铜器时代的各种遗物。.en: The museum displays various artifacts from the Bronze Age.

通过发掘出的遗物可以推测当时人们的生活面貌。.en: From the excavated relics, we can infer what people's lives were like back then.

这部作品被选定为今年最佳电影，受到了极大关注。.en: This work was selected as the best film of the year and received a lot of attention.

委员会通过公正的评审选定了获奖者。.en: The committee selected the winner through fair evaluation.

他对父母的孝心非常真挚，每周都会打电话并寄零花钱。.en: His filial piety toward his parents is very sincere; he calls every week and sends pocket money.

实践孝心的方式因人而异，但最重要的是真心。.en: The way to practice filial piety varies from person to person, but sincerity is the most important thing.

因地球温暖化导致海平面上升，岛国面临消失的危机。.en: Due to global warming, sea levels are rising, and island nations are facing a crisis of disappearing.

为了减缓地球温暖化，全世界正在努力减少碳排放。.en: To slow down global warming, the whole world is working to reduce carbon emissions.

亚马逊丛林被称为地球之肺，对生态系统起着重要作用。.en: The Amazon jungle is called the lungs of the Earth and plays an important role in the ecosystem.

探险队在密林中迷了路，但在原住民的帮助下得以安全脱身。.en: The expedition got lost in the dense forest, but managed to get out safely with the help of the indigenous people.

那部电影的制作费极其庞大，以至于没人能保证票房成功。.en: The production cost of that movie was so enormous that no one could guarantee its box office success.

台风过后的损失规模非常巨大，预计恢复需要几个月时间。.en: The scale of damage after the typhoon was so huge that recovery is expected to take several months.

夕阳西下时的海景十分壮观，所有人都忍不住赞叹。.en: The sea view at sunset was so spectacular that everyone couldn't help but admire it.

瀑布倾泻而下的水流所形成的壮观景象，深深吸引了观者的心。.en: The spectacular sight of the waterfall's cascading water deeply captivated the viewers.

老旧公寓园区进行修缮工程时，居民们不得不临时搬到别处居住。.en: During the renovation of the old apartment complex, residents had to temporarily move elsewhere.

地铁站进行维修施工期间，乘客们不得不使用绕行路线。.en: While the subway station was under repair, passengers had to use detour routes.

最近由于气候变化，自然灾害的频率和强度正在逐渐增加。.en: Recently, due to climate change, the frequency and intensity of natural disasters are gradually increasing.

发生自然灾害时，最重要的是迅速疏散和事前准备。.en: When a natural disaster occurs, the most important things are quick evacuation and advance preparation.

为了修复因地震倒塌的建筑物，投入了巨额预算。.en: A huge budget was invested to repair the buildings that collapsed in the earthquake.

为了恢复山火受灾地区，志愿者们种树并整顿了环境。.en: To restore the area damaged by the wildfire, volunteers planted trees and cleaned up the environment.

韩国传统房屋韩屋得益于暖炕，即使在冬天也能温暖地生活。.en: Thanks to the ondol, traditional Korean houses called hanok can stay warm even in winter.

暖炕从地面开始加热，因此整个房间都能均匀变暖，这是它的优点。.en: The advantage of ondol is that it heats from the floor, so the entire room warms up evenly.

冬天每天早上都要在灶膛里烧火，房间才会变暖。.en: In winter, you have to light a fire in the stove every morning for the room to get warm.

奶奶用传统方式烧火，加热了炕板。.en: Grandma lit a fire the traditional way and heated the ondol floor.

下雨时，从屋檐末端滴落的雨滴声非常悦耳。.en: When it rains, the sound of raindrops falling from the edge of the eaves is very pleasant.

一只燕子在屋檐下筑巢，养育了幼雏。.en: A swallow built a nest under the eaves and raised its chicks.

那个村子里保存着数百年的瓦房，吸引了很多游客前来。.en: That village has preserved hundreds-year-old tiled houses, attracting many tourists.

瓦房的屋顶由瓦片覆盖，即使下雨也不会漏水，这是它的优点。.en: The roof of a tiled house is covered with tiles, so it doesn't leak even when it rains — that's its advantage.

这个住宅园区设计得很亲近自然，配备了太阳能发电和雨水回收系统。.en: This residential complex is designed to be eco-friendly, equipped with solar power and rainwater harvesting systems.

使用环保的建筑材料有助于减少环境污染。.en: Using eco-friendly building materials helps reduce environmental pollution.

茅草屋是用稻草编成屋顶的传统房屋，冬暖夏凉。.en: A thatched house is a traditional house with a roof made of straw, keeping it cool in summer and warm in winter.

博物馆里复原了过去的茅草屋，游客可以体验当时的生活。.en: The museum has restored old thatched houses, so visitors can experience life back then.

由于工厂排出的废水，河水急剧变浊，导致鱼类大量死亡。.en: Due to wastewater discharged from factories, the river water became very turbid, causing a massive die-off of fish.

到了梅雨季节，混入泥水后自来水有时会变浑浊。.en: During the rainy season, tap water sometimes becomes turbid when mixed with muddy water.

这套公寓的中央供暖设施完善，冬天室内温度也能保持恒定。.en: This apartment has a well-equipped central heating system, so the indoor temperature stays constant even in winter.
