上课时打了个盹儿，被老师批评了。.en: I dozed off during class and got scolded by the teacher.

熬夜工作到很晚，在公交车上打了个盹儿。.en: I stayed up late working, so I dozed off on the bus.

明天早上的温度会降至零下。.en: Tomorrow morning's temperature will drop below zero.

冬天温度降至零下的日子很多。.en: In winter, there are many days when the temperature drops below zero.

上课时朋友对我耳语开了个玩笑。.en: My friend whispered a joke to me during class.

在图书馆里连耳语也要小心。.en: Even whispering must be done carefully in the library.

那个问题只是一时现象而已。.en: That problem is just a temporary phenomenon.

同时聚集很多人可能会拥挤。.en: Gathering many people at the same time might be crowded.

越是有权力的人，责任也越大。.en: The more power a person has, the greater their responsibility.

他因为滥用权力，最终被迫下台了。.en: He was eventually forced to step down because he abused his power.

我下决心今年一定要减肥成功。.en: I made up my mind to succeed in losing weight this year.

他下决心不再玩游戏，于是关掉了手机。.en: He decided to stop playing games and turned off his phone.

弟弟晚上说梦话，把我吵醒过。.en: My younger brother talks in his sleep at night and woke me up.

昨天听到朋友睡觉时说梦话。.en: Yesterday I heard my friend talking in his sleep.

因为担心太多，整晚辗转反侧。.en: I tossed and turned all night because I was too worried.

因为天气热睡不好，一直翻来覆去。.en: I couldn't sleep well because of the heat and kept tossing and turning.

其实我不知道你今天会来。.en: Actually, I didn't know you were coming today.

说实话，我听到那个故事也很吃惊。.en: To be honest, I was also surprised when I heard that story.

事情太忙，今天一刻都没得闲。.en: I've been so busy that I haven't had a moment's rest today.

爬楼梯太快，喘不过气来。.en: I climbed the stairs too fast and couldn't catch my breath.

回禀；请教，询问.en: to report back; to ask for advice, to inquire

我向老师问了路。.en: I asked the teacher for directions.

如果有疑问，请随时询问。.en: If you have any questions, please feel free to ask.

突然雨注变粗，下起了倾盆大雨。.en: Suddenly the rain came down harder, and it started pouring.

窗外能看到雨注猛烈落下的景象。.en: Outside the window, you could see the rain falling heavily.

日交差，昼夜温差.en: daily temperature difference, day-night temperature difference

最近昼夜温差大，早上冷中午热。.en: Recently, the temperature difference between day and night is large; it's cold in the morning and hot at noon.

昼夜温差大的日子最好多穿几层衣服。.en: On days with a big temperature difference between day and night, it's best to wear layers.

中午只吃了一点点，肚子有点饿。.en: I only ate a little at lunch, so I'm a bit hungry.

还没到晚饭时间呢，已经有点饿了。.en: It's not even dinner time yet, but I'm already a little hungry.

内心，心眼；肚里.en: inner heart; mind; in one's stomach

那个人一肚子坏水，不知道他在想什么。.en: That person is full of bad intentions; I don't know what he's thinking.

宝宝在肚子里踢的感觉真的很神奇。.en: The feeling of the baby kicking in the belly is really amazing.

他胸怀宽广，对谁都很大方。.en: He is broad-minded and generous to everyone.

多亏了胸怀宽广的朋友，我顺利度过了难关。.en: Thanks to my broad-minded friend, I got through the hard time smoothly.

周末早上的市场很悠闲，适合慢慢逛。.en: The weekend morning market is leisurely, perfect for a slow stroll.

平日下午咖啡馆很安静，非常适合学习。.en: The café is very quiet on weekday afternoons, perfect for studying.

冬天喝着热茶在温馨的家里休息是最好的。.en: In winter, resting at home with hot tea in a cozy atmosphere is the best.

这家咖啡馆灯光柔和，氛围温馨，所以我常来。.en: This café has soft lighting and a cozy atmosphere, so I come here often.

如果有日程变更，请提前告知。.en: If there is a schedule change, please let me know in advance.

那个城市靠近边境地区。.en: That city is near the border area.

这家咖啡馆的室内装饰非常独特。.en: The interior decoration of this cafe is very unique.

换了室内装饰后，家里的氛围完全变了。.en: After changing the interior decoration, the atmosphere at home completely changed.

洗衣机不脱水，衣服一直湿漉漉的。.en: The washing machine doesn't spin, so the clothes are always soaking wet.

如果不脱水，就得把衣服拿出来自己拧干。.en: If it doesn't spin, you have to take the clothes out and wring them by hand.

空调温度调不了，太冷了。.en: The air conditioner temperature can't be adjusted, it's too cold.

这个炉子不能调节温度，所以使用时要小心。.en: This stove can't adjust the temperature, so be careful when using it.

打开电视，突然屏幕不显示了。.en: When I turned on the TV, the screen suddenly stopped displaying.

电脑屏幕不显示，所以检查了一下显示器。.en: The computer screen wasn't displaying, so I checked the monitor.

打印机卡纸了，打印中断了。.en: The printer had a paper jam, so printing stopped.

复印机卡纸的话，请打开盖子取出纸张。.en: If the copier jams, open the cover and remove the paper.

把手机掉进厕所水里了，怎么办？.en: I dropped my phone in the toilet water, what should I do?

孩子把牛奶掉进水里，哭了。.en: The child dropped the milk into the water and cried.

旧书架上积了很多灰尘。.en: A lot of dust has accumulated on the old bookshelf.

电风扇的扇叶上沾了灰尘，所以清理了一下。.en: The fan blades were covered in dust, so I cleaned them.

开车之前要先发动引擎。.en: You need to start the engine before driving.

停车后一定要熄火才安全。.en: It's safe only if you turn off the engine after parking.

冰箱坏了，让维修师傅修理了一下。.en: The refrigerator broke, so I had the repairman fix it.

这件衣服的纽扣松了，得拾掇一下。.en: The button on this shirt is loose, so I need to fix it up.

显示器屏幕突然开始变得模糊。.en: The monitor screen suddenly started to become blurry.

擦了眼镜，屏幕还是模糊的。.en: I wiped my glasses, but the screen is still blurry.

维修工程师来修空调了。.en: The repair engineer came to fix the air conditioner.

维修工程师拆开发动机进行了检查。.en: The repair engineer disassembled the engine and inspected it.

这个周末有公司研讨会。.en: There is a company seminar this weekend.

在工作坊里进行了加强团队合作的活动。.en: We did team-building activities in the workshop.

开车时始终遵守限速很重要。.en: It's important to always obey the speed limit while driving.

这条路限速60公里，请务必遵守。.en: The speed limit on this road is 60 km/h, so please be sure to follow it.

闯红灯可能会对行人造成危险。.en: Running a red light can be dangerous for pedestrians.

他闯红灯经过十字路口时发生了事故。.en: He had an accident when he ran a red light at the intersection.

酒后驾车可能会被吊销驾照。.en: Drunk driving can lead to your license being revoked.

他昨晚因为酒后驾车被抓住了。.en: He was caught for drunk driving last night.

被卡在地铁门里.en: get stuck in the subway door

上下班高峰时，包经常被卡在地铁门里。.en: During rush hour, bags often get stuck in the subway doors.

衣服被卡在地铁门里时不要慌张，在下一站下车。.en: If your clothes get stuck in the subway door, don't panic; get off at the next station.

运动时扭了脚踝，去了医院。.en: I sprained my ankle while exercising and went to the hospital.

在楼梯上差点摔倒，手腕扭伤了。.en: I almost fell on the stairs and sprained my wrist.

脚踝骨折了，要打一个月的石膏。.en: I broke my ankle and have to wear a cast for a month.

用打了石膏的胳膊洗澡很不方便。.en: It's very inconvenient to shower with a cast on your arm.

伤口很深，医生缝了大约十针。.en: The wound was deep, so the doctor stitched about ten stitches.

裤子破了，奶奶用针线帮我缝好了。.en: My pants tore, and my grandmother sewed them up with a needle and thread.

朋友因交通事故住院了，我去医院探望了他。.en: My friend was hospitalized after a traffic accident, so I went to visit him at the hospital.

去看病人时，通常买水果或花带去。.en: When visiting a patient, people usually bring fruit or flowers.

手术后要好好调养身体才能快速恢复。.en: You need to take good care of your body after surgery to recover quickly.

因为感冒了，我在家调养了几天身体。.en: Because I caught a cold, I stayed home and rested for a few days.

我在新闻上看到那起交通事故导致三人死亡。.en: I saw on the news that the traffic accident killed three people.

爷爷在与病魔长期抗争后不幸去世了。.en: Grandfather sadly passed away after a long battle with illness.

那位歌手十年前以歌手身份出道了。.en: That singer debuted as a singer ten years ago.

经历了五年的练习生生活后，终于出道了。.en: After five years as a trainee, I finally made my debut.

因为下了很多雨，下水道堵了。.en: Because it rained a lot, the sewer got clogged.

下水道传出奇怪的味道，所以我清理了一下。.en: A strange smell came from the drain, so I cleaned it.

警察正在寻找事故现场的目击者。.en: The police are looking for witnesses to the accident scene.

目击者的陈述对解决案件有很大帮助。.en: The witness's statement was very helpful in solving the case.

中秋早上和家人一起去扫墓了。.en: On Chuseok morning, I went to visit the grave with my family.

去爷爷坟前扫墓是我们家的传统。.en: Visiting my grandfather's grave to clean it is a tradition in our family.

人们相信正月初一放风筝可以驱走厄运。.en: People believe that flying kites on the first day of the lunar new year can drive away bad luck.

孩子们在公园里开心地放风筝玩耍。.en: The children are happily flying kites and playing in the park.

他们恋爱三年后订了婚。.en: They got engaged after dating for three years.

订婚六个月后就举行了婚礼。.en: The wedding was held six months after the engagement.

他在氛围很好的餐厅求了婚。.en: He proposed in a restaurant with a great atmosphere.

求婚时下跪在韩国也很普遍吗？.en: Is kneeling when proposing also common in Korea?

好的上司应该善于听取下属的意见。.en: A good boss should be good at listening to their subordinates' opinions.

下属犯错时，严厉指出来对他们有帮助。.en: When a subordinate makes a mistake, pointing it out strictly helps them.

公司因经营困难，很多职员被解雇了。.en: Due to the company's financial difficulties, many employees were laid off.

突然被解雇了，不知道以后该怎么办，很茫然。.en: I was suddenly fired, and I don't know what to do now. I feel lost.

他为了跳槽到条件更好的公司而辞职了。.en: He resigned to move to a company with better conditions.

辞职前一定要确认退休金和年薪条件。.en: Before resigning, make sure to check the severance pay and salary conditions.

父亲今年年初从工作了30年的公司退休了。.en: My father retired early this year from the company where he worked for 30 years.

退休后想去旅行，享受兴趣爱好。.en: After retirement, I want to travel and enjoy my hobbies.

他在IT领域积累了5年经验后创业了。.en: He started a business after gaining 5 years of experience in IT.

最近在年轻人中间，创业很流行。.en: Recently, starting a business is popular among young people.

运动前后做拉伸对预防受伤有好处。.en: Doing stretches before and after exercise is good for preventing injuries.

长时间坐着时，请中间站起来做拉伸。.en: When sitting for a long time, please stand up and do stretches in between.

你知道我们身体所需的五种主要营养素吗？.en: Do you know the five main nutrients our body needs?

水果和蔬菜富含维生素等多种营养素。.en: Fruits and vegetables are rich in various nutrients like vitamins.

血糖太高可能会引发糖尿病，需要小心。.en: If blood sugar is too high, it can cause diabetes, so you need to be careful.

为了防止饭后血糖急剧上升，最好先吃蔬菜。.en: To prevent blood sugar from rising sharply after meals, it's best to eat vegetables first.

为了管理胆固醇数值，减少油腻食物很重要。.en: To manage cholesterol levels, it's important to reduce greasy foods.

健康检查中胆固醇比正常值高，吓了我一跳。.en: My cholesterol was higher than normal in the health checkup, which scared me.

经常吃水果和蔬菜有助于提高免疫力。.en: Eating fruits and vegetables often helps boost immunity.

充足的睡眠是提高免疫力最简单的方法之一。.en: Getting enough sleep is one of the simplest ways to boost immunity.

医生说肝功能数值不好，让我暂时戒酒。.en: The doctor said my liver function numbers were bad and told me to quit drinking for a while.

因为正在减肥，所以决定戒酒一个月。.en: Because I'm on a diet, I decided to quit drinking for a month.

突然身体不舒服，所以没能参加聚会。.en: I suddenly felt unwell, so I couldn't attend the gathering.

最晚请在前一天务必告知无法参加。.en: Please be sure to let us know that you can't attend by the day before at the latest.

向参加婚礼的客人回礼是礼貌。.en: It is polite to give a return gift to wedding guests.

收到礼物时，一定要回礼或表达感谢。.en: When you receive a gift, you must give a return gift or express thanks.

他为了更好的环境决定移民加拿大。.en: He decided to immigrate to Canada for a better environment.

要移民的话，得先拿到签证。.en: To immigrate, you need to get a visa first.

韩国一半左右的人口住在首都圈。.en: About half of Korea's population lives in the capital area.

首都圈房价太贵，越来越难住了。.en: Housing prices in the capital area are too expensive, making it harder to live there.

那对夫妇离开城市，开始了田园生活。.en: That couple left the city and started a rural life.

田园生活空气清新又安静，有很多好处。.en: Rural life has fresh air and is quiet, with many benefits.

这个社区共同体一起打理菜地。.en: This community tends the vegetable garden together.

在共同体生活中，互相帮助很重要。.en: In community life, helping each other is important.

为了买房，我从银行贷款了。.en: To buy a house, I took out a loan from the bank.

贷款的钱一定要按计划还清。.en: You must repay the loan money as planned.

债务多了会让人有压力。.en: Having a lot of debt can be stressful.

他因为生意失败背上了很大的债务。.en: He took on a huge debt because his business failed.

哪怕每月只还一点，还清债务也很重要。.en: Even if you only pay a little each month, it's important to pay off your debt.

终于还清了所有债务，心里真痛快。.en: Finally paid off all my debt, I feel so relieved.

那个朋友花钱大手大脚，把工资都花光了。.en: That friend spends money recklessly and blows through his salary.

花钱大手大脚的人很难存钱。.en: People who spend money recklessly have a hard time saving.

开始记家庭账本后，我更节省钱了。.en: After I started keeping a household ledger, I saved more money.

用智能手机App可以轻松管理家庭账本。.en: You can easily manage a household ledger with a smartphone app.

每天记账一开始很麻烦，但养成习惯后就方便了。.en: Keeping a daily budget is a hassle at first, but it becomes convenient once you get used to it.

记账可以减少不必要的支出。.en: Keeping a budget can reduce unnecessary expenses.

最近年轻人也早早开始做养老准备的趋势。.en: Recently, there is a trend of young people starting retirement preparation early.

为了养老准备，我每个月都在一点点储蓄。.en: I save a little each month for retirement preparation.

退休后只靠养老金生活并不容易。.en: It's not easy to live on just a pension after retirement.

这家公司向员工支付退休后的年金。.en: This company pays its employees an annuity after retirement.

一笔钱；整钱.en: A lump sum; a large sum of money

要买车的话，需要一笔整钱。.en: To buy a car, you need a lump sum of money.

他为了攒一笔整钱，努力储蓄了三年。.en: He saved diligently for three years to accumulate a lump sum of money.

积累一笔钱.en: Accumulate a lump sum of money

要结婚的话，积累一笔钱很重要。.en: To get married, it's important to accumulate a lump sum of money.

他每月储蓄工资的30%，积累了一笔钱。.en: He saves 30% of his salary each month and has accumulated a lump sum of money.

关于那位歌手传出了奇怪的谣言。.en: A strange rumor spread about that singer.

传出谣言时，确认事实很重要。.en: When rumors spread, it's important to confirm the facts.

不能散布未经确认的谣言。.en: You must not spread unconfirmed rumors.

他在公司里到处散布不好的谣言。.en: He spread bad rumors all around the company.

如果彼此缺乏沟通，很容易产生误解。.en: If there's a lack of communication between each other, misunderstandings easily arise.

因为产生了一点小误会，我和朋友吵架了。.en: Because of a small misunderstanding, I fought with my friend.

通过认真交谈，我们解开了误会。.en: We resolved the misunderstanding by talking seriously.

要解开误会，需要坦诚的对话。.en: To resolve a misunderstanding, you need an honest conversation.

不是我做的却被骂，真的太冤枉了。.en: I got scolded for something I didn't do, it's really unfair.

他带着冤枉的表情，一句话也没说。.en: He had an expression of grievance and didn't say a word.

她觉得很冤枉，不明白自己为什么被指责。.en: She felt very wronged and didn't understand why she was being blamed.

与其觉得冤枉，不如去找证据，不是吗？.en: Rather than feeling wronged, wouldn't it be better to find evidence?

他为了消除误会，召开记者会进行了说明。.en: He held a press conference to clear up the misunderstanding.

你能对你的行为做更详细的解释吗？.en: Can you give a more detailed explanation of your actions?

他悔悟了自己的错误，真心请求原谅。.en: He regretted his mistake and sincerely asked for forgiveness.

对于撒谎的事，我写了一封请求原谅的信。.en: I wrote a letter asking for forgiveness about lying.

那件事之后，对他的信任完全破裂了。.en: After that incident, my trust in him was completely broken.

谎言被揭穿后，夫妻之间的信任最终破裂了。.en: After the lie was exposed, the trust between the couple finally broke.

这次话剧里我担任了最难的角色。.en: I took on the most difficult role in this play.

那位演员把反派角色演绎得太好了，让人惊讶。.en: That actor played the villain role so well it was surprising.

演员们正在一边读剧本一边练习。.en: The actors are practicing while reading the script.

这个剧本太有趣了，我一次性全读完了。.en: This script is so interesting, I read it all in one sitting.

那位演员的演技非常出色，观众们深受感动。.en: That actor's performance was so outstanding that the audience was deeply moved.

演技出色的演员能很好地诠释任何角色。.en: An actor with excellent acting skills can portray any role well.

评论家们严厉批评了那部电影。.en: The critics harshly criticized that movie.

评论作品时需要客观的视角。.en: An objective perspective is needed when critiquing a work.

她手艺很好，能用废品制作艺术品。.en: She is very skilled and can make art from waste materials.

手艺好的人在手工艺领域容易脱颖而出。.en: People with good craftsmanship easily stand out in the handicraft field.

他的主张有坚实的逻辑依据，很有说服力。.en: His argument has a solid logical basis and is very persuasive.

要做有说服力的发表，必须考虑听众的视角。.en: To give a persuasive presentation, you must consider the audience's perspective.

她从小就有绘画天赋，最终成为了画家。.en: She had a talent for painting from a young age and eventually became a painter.

有语言天赋的人能快速吸收外语的发音和语法。.en: People with a talent for languages can quickly absorb the pronunciation and grammar of a foreign language.

找到适合自己天性的职业是长期成功的关键。.en: Finding a career that suits your nature is the key to long-term success.

这份工作不适合我的性格，所以压力很大。.en: This job doesn't suit my personality, so it's very stressful.

在高中时确定职业道路是一个不容易的决定。.en: Deciding on a career path in high school is not an easy decision.

他在积累了多种经验之后才确定了职业方向。.en: He determined his career direction after gaining a variety of experiences.

他性格善于交际，在聚会上总是担任气氛制造者。.en: He has a sociable personality and always acts as the life of the party.

善于交际的人能在社交活动上积累很多人脉。.en: Sociable people can build many connections at social events.

我们价值观相似，从第一次见面起就很投缘。.en: We have similar values and hit it off from the first meeting.

和志趣相投的人一起工作会对成果产生很大影响。.en: Working with like-minded people can have a big impact on the results.

他凭借天生的音感，即使没有乐谱也能准确地演奏旋律。.en: With his natural sense of pitch, he can play melodies accurately even without sheet music.

音感好的人能轻易分辨出和弦的细微差别。.en: People with a good sense of pitch can easily distinguish subtle differences in chords.

起初觉得不怎么样，但渐渐被他认真的性格所吸引。.en: At first I didn't think much of him, but gradually I was drawn to his serious personality.

被韩国传统音乐的深厚韵味所吸引的外国游客正在增加。.en: The number of foreign tourists drawn to the deep charm of traditional Korean music is increasing.

参加了多次面试但都被拒绝，我失去了自信。.en: I went to several interviews but was rejected each time, and I lost my confidence.

她表白了，但被对方礼貌地拒绝了。.en: She confessed her feelings, but was politely turned down by the other person.

这次展览是为了介绍年轻作家的作品而策划的。.en: This exhibition was planned to introduce the works of young artists.

他亲自策划并执行了准备了整整一年的项目。.en: He personally planned and carried out a project that had been in preparation for a whole year.

服务业从业者必须始终以亲切的态度接待顾客。.en: Workers in the service industry must always treat customers with a friendly attitude.

随着经济发展，服务业的比重正逐渐增大。.en: As the economy develops, the proportion of the service industry is gradually increasing.

长时间看智能手机，眼睛会变得昏沉，有时还会头痛。.en: If you look at your smartphone for a long time, your eyes get heavy and blurry, and sometimes you get a headache.

随着年龄增长，眼睛越来越昏花，看小字很费劲。.en: As I get older, my eyes get more and more blurry, and it's hard to read small print.

吹空调吹久了，脖子变得僵硬，连转头都困难。.en: After sitting in the air conditioning for too long, my neck became so stiff that I could barely turn my head.

因为睡姿不对，早上起来脖子僵硬，一整天都不舒服。.en: Because of a bad sleeping position, my neck was stiff in the morning and felt uncomfortable all day.

可能是感冒初期症状，喉咙刺痛，每次咽口水都感到尖锐的疼痛。.en: It might be the early symptoms of a cold — a sharp pain in the throat, and every time I swallow saliva, I feel a stinging pain.

吃了辣的食物后喉咙刺痛，只好频繁喝水。.en: After eating spicy food, my throat stung, so I had to drink water frequently.

吃了太多油腻的食物，胃里很不舒服，什么都吃不下去了。.en: After eating too much greasy food, my stomach felt very uncomfortable, and I couldn't eat anything more.

一有压力，胃里就不舒服并且常出现恶心的症状。.en: Whenever I'm stressed, my stomach feels uncomfortable and I often experience nausea.

在公司晋升公布之前，心情烦闷到呼吸困难的程度。.en: Before the company promotion announcement, I felt so down that I could barely breathe.

她因为长久积压的不满而心情烦闷，于是向朋友倾诉了。.en: She felt down because of long-suppressed dissatisfaction, so she confided in a friend.

眼睛好像受伤了，一直流泪并有刺痛和难受的感觉。.en: My eyes seem to be injured — they keep tearing up and feel stinging and aching.

一想到他的背叛，心里就刺痛难受，怒火中烧。.en: Whenever I think of his betrayal, my heart aches and stings, and I burn with anger.

长时间坐在书桌前，腰和腿都麻了，站起来都很困难。.en: After sitting at the desk for a long time, my waist and legs went numb, and it was hard to stand up.

枕着胳膊睡觉醒来，胳膊麻了好几分钟动弹不得。.en: After sleeping with my arm under my head, my arm was numb for several minutes and I couldn't move it.

最近几周因过劳身体出现异常信号，我决定休假。.en: In recent weeks, my body has been sending abnormal signals due to overwork, so I decided to take a break.

过劳积累会导致免疫力急剧下降，连感冒这样的小病都容易得。.en: Accumulated overwork can cause a sharp drop in immunity, making you prone to even minor illnesses like colds.

因为昨晚饮酒过量，直到今天早上头还阵阵作痛，胃里也恶心。.en: Because I drank too much last night, my head was throbbing and my stomach felt nauseous until this morning.

饮酒过量不仅对肝脏健康致命，还会模糊判断力，引发事故。.en: Excessive drinking is not only fatal to liver health but also impairs judgment and causes accidents.

超速行驶；超速.en: speeding; driving over the speed limit

在高速公路上因超速被查处，交了罚款和违章金，真的很后悔。.en: I got caught speeding on the highway and had to pay a fine and penalty fee. I really regretted it.

超速行驶在发生事故时致死率会急剧上升，所以绝对不可以。.en: Speeding sharply increases the fatality rate in accidents, so it's absolutely not allowed.

就摔了一下，哭得那么大声是娇气，看起来伤得不重啊。.en: Crying that loudly from just one fall is being fussy. It doesn't look like a serious injury.

他一打针就喊疼得要死，其实没那么疼，就是娇气。.en: He screams that it hurts like crazy when he gets a shot, but it's not that painful—he's just being fussy.

因为经常加班，睡眠时间不规律，健康明显变差了。.en: Because I often work overtime, my sleep schedule is irregular, and my health has clearly gotten worse.

生活模式不规则会破坏激素平衡，可能引发多种疾病。.en: An irregular lifestyle pattern can disrupt hormone balance and may cause various diseases.

动不动，动辄.en: easily, frequently, at the drop of a hat

他动不动就取消约定，在朋友之间正在失去信任。.en: He cancels plans at the drop of a hat, and he's losing trust among his friends.

最近孩子动不动就发脾气哭闹，为了弄清原因正在接受咨询。.en: Recently, the child throws tantrums and cries at the slightest thing, so we're getting counseling to find out the cause.

这家餐厅因为柔和的灯光和古典音乐，氛围非常高档。.en: This restaurant has a very upscale atmosphere thanks to the soft lighting and classical music.

她是那种能把普通棉质连衣裙也穿出高级感的时尚达人。.en: She's a fashionista who can make even a plain cotton dress look elegant.

春节时全家聚在一起享用年糕汤等各种特色菜是我们的传统。.en: It's our tradition for the whole family to gather during Lunar New Year and enjoy various specialty dishes like rice cake soup.

这家酒店餐厅用当季食材制作的今日特色菜尤其受欢迎。.en: The daily special at this hotel restaurant, made with seasonal ingredients, is especially popular.

他们为庆祝结婚纪念日，在一家昂贵的餐厅享用了全套晚餐。.en: They celebrated their wedding anniversary by enjoying a full-course dinner at an expensive restaurant.

这家水疗中心销售包含桑拿、汗蒸房和按摩的全套使用券。.en: This spa sells a full-course voucher that includes a sauna, a steam room, and a massage.

这家酒店的最高级套房可以欣赏汉江景色，深受VIP客户欢迎。.en: The top-level suite at this hotel offers a view of the Han River and is very popular with VIP guests.

那个品牌以只精选最高级牛皮制作手包而闻名。.en: That brand is famous for making handbags using only the highest quality cowhide.

这款化妆品正在开展按购买金额赠送赠品的促销活动。.en: This cosmetic product is running a promotion where gifts are given based on the purchase amount.

购买图书时免费赠送限量版书签，敬请关注。.en: When you buy a book, you get a free limited-edition bookmark, so stay tuned.

长期吸烟的人比非吸烟者肺癌发病率显著更高。.en: People who smoke for a long time have a significantly higher incidence of lung cancer than non-smokers.

早期发现困难的肺癌是死亡率非常高的癌症之一。.en: Lung cancer, which is difficult to detect early, is one of the cancers with a very high mortality rate.

乙型肝炎病毒被认为是肝癌的主要原因之一。.en: The hepatitis B virus is considered one of the main causes of liver cancer.

定期的超声波检查对早期发现肝癌有很大帮助。.en: Regular ultrasound examinations are very helpful for early detection of liver cancer.

最近由于西化的饮食习惯，韩国的大肠癌发病率也呈增长趋势。.en: Recently, due to Westernized eating habits, the incidence of colorectal cancer in Korea is also on the rise.

政府为了降低交通事故发生率，正在开展多种宣传活动。.en: The government is running various awareness campaigns to reduce the incidence of traffic accidents.

酒精中毒不仅仅是嗜好问题，而是必须接受治疗的疾病。.en: Alcoholism is not just a matter of habit but a disease that requires treatment.

他为了摆脱酒精中毒，决心去咨询专业咨询中心。.en: He decided to consult a professional counseling center to overcome his alcohol addiction.

我特别讨厌升到高处的游乐设施，所以绝对不会坐。.en: I really hate rides that go up high, so I never ride them.

他非常讨厌说谎的人，所以和那种朋友断绝了来往。.en: He really hates liars, so he cut ties with that kind of friend.

过山车从顶点突然掉下来的一瞬间，所有人异口同声地尖叫起来。.en: The moment the roller coaster suddenly dropped from the top, everyone screamed in unison.

听到那个消息后，他的表情一下子就沉了下来，陷入了沉默。.en: After hearing that news, his expression suddenly fell and he fell silent.

旋转木马一圈圈地转起来，孩子们的脸上绽开了灿烂的笑容。.en: As the carousel spun round and round, the children's faces lit up with bright smiles.

因为问题复杂到让人头晕目眩，所以解决方案不容易想出来。.en: Because the problem was so dizzyingly complex, a solution wasn't easy to come up with.

一到春天，花粉开始飞扬，过敏患者们就会叫苦连天。.en: When spring comes and pollen starts flying, allergy patients complain bitterly.

开着窗户的话，花粉会飞进来，整个房间都被染成了黄色。.en: If you leave the window open, pollen will fly in and the whole room will turn yellow.

踢足球时和对方球员撞到，大腿上淤青了。.en: I collided with an opponent player while playing soccer and got a bruise on my thigh.

打针的地方淤青得发紫，没法穿短裤。.en: The injection site is bruised purple, so I can't wear shorts.

扭伤脚踝后冰敷了，然后缠上了绷带。.en: After spraining my ankle, I applied an ice pack and then wrapped it with a bandage.

护士在伤口上涂了消毒药，然后利落地缠上了绷带。.en: The nurse applied antiseptic to the wound and then neatly wrapped it with a bandage.

因为肩膀僵硬严重，韩医师在肩膀上放了针。.en: Because my shoulder stiffness was severe, the Korean medicine doctor inserted needles into my shoulder.

放针的部位变暖后，疼痛一下子消失了。.en: After the area where the needles were inserted warmed up, the pain disappeared all at once.

运动后膝盖肿了，马上开始冰敷。.en: After exercising, my knee swelled up, so I immediately applied an ice pack.

脚踝扭伤初期，冰敷比热敷更有效。.en: In the early stage of an ankle sprain, applying an ice pack is more effective than applying heat.

虽然打了加时赛，但最终没有分出胜负，以平局收场。.en: Although we played overtime, we couldn't decide the winner in the end and it ended in a draw.

最后一球进到谁那里，胜负就分出来了。.en: The winner was decided by who scored the last goal.

那位选手胜负欲很强，非常讨厌输。.en: That player has a very strong desire to win and really hates losing.

胜负欲强是好事，但尊重对手的态度也很重要。.en: Having a strong desire to win is good, but having an attitude of respect for your opponent is also important.

常规时间没有分出胜负，最终进行了加时赛。.en: The regular time didn't decide the winner, so they eventually played overtime.

进行加时赛时，选手们的体力开始见底了。.en: During overtime, the players' stamina started to run out.

在半决赛中取得惊心动魄的逆转胜利，球队晋级了决赛。.en: After a thrilling comeback victory in the semifinals, the team advanced to the finals.

晋级决赛的两支队伍都展现出了史上级别的竞技水平。.en: Both teams that advanced to the finals showed a historic level of performance.

他在采访中自信满满地说这次比赛一定会赢。.en: He said confidently in the interview that he would definitely win this match.

他带着自信满满的表情上场比赛的样子令人印象深刻。.en: His expression full of confidence as he went on the field to play was impressive.

最后一球击中门柱弹入球门，真是一场惊险的胜负。.en: The last ball hit the post and went into the goal — it was a truly thrilling win.

他惊险地躲过对方的铲球，朝球门跑去。.en: He narrowly dodged the opponent's tackle and ran toward the goal.

这部小说从头到尾引人入胜，我一口气读完了。.en: This novel was captivating from start to finish, so I read it all in one sitting.

两支队伍的胶着激战持续进行，比赛变得更加引人入胜。.en: The fierce, close battle between the two teams continued, making the game even more captivating.

因球员在比赛开始仅10分钟就被罚下场，球队陷入了人数劣势。.en: Because a player was sent off just 10 minutes into the game, the team was at a numerical disadvantage.

他因粗野的铲球导致对方球员受伤，立即被罚下场。.en: He was immediately sent off for a rough tackle that injured an opposing player.

两支队伍实力差距太大，比赛呈一边倒的态势。.en: The skill gap between the two teams was too big, making the game one-sided.

与实力悬殊的对手交锋，虽然有很多可学之处，但很难取胜。.en: Facing an opponent with a huge skill gap, there is a lot to learn, but it's hard to win.

随着比赛进入尾声，选手们的体力下降，传球失误也增多了。.en: As the game neared its end, the players' stamina decreased and passing errors increased.

在体力下降的状态下勉强比赛，极有可能导致受伤。.en: Forcing a game while stamina is decreased can easily lead to injury.

随着绝杀球的入网，观众席爆发出的欢呼声响彻整个棒球场。.en: As the game-winning shot went in, the cheers from the stands echoed throughout the baseball stadium.

他的呐喊声中混杂着愤怒和悲伤，让周围的人都变得肃静起来。.en: His shouts, mixed with anger and sadness, made everyone around him fall silent.

他站在颁奖台最高的位置上，在听到自己国家国歌奏响的那一刻忍不住流下了眼泪。.en: Standing on the highest spot of the podium, he couldn't help but cry when he heard his country's national anthem play.

他坚信，站上颁奖台之前的过程比结果更加珍贵。.en: He firmly believes that the process before standing on the podium is more precious than the result.

因为在最后一个山谷爆胎，他遗憾地失去了第一名。.en: Because he got a flat tire in the last valley, he unfortunately lost first place.

失去第一名的遗憾只是暂时的，他下定决心要为下一次比赛做更充分的准备。.en: The regret of losing first place was only temporary; he made up his mind to prepare more thoroughly for the next competition.

选手没有对判罚提出异议，而是谦虚地接受了结果，展现了成熟的一面。.en: The player did not dispute the penalty but humbly accepted the result, showing a mature side.

我们必须承认有些结果无论怎么努力也无法改变，并学会接受结果。.en: We must acknowledge that some results cannot be changed no matter how hard we try, and learn to accept the result.

作为篮球选手，他的体格算是比较小的，但他凭借出色的弹跳力和爆发力克服了这一点。.en: As a basketball player, his physique is relatively small, but he overcomes this with excellent jumping ability and explosive power.

体格条件虽然不能绝对地决定运动能力，但在某些项目中确实会起到有利作用。.en: Although physique cannot absolutely determine athletic ability, it does play a favorable role in certain sports.

他与对方防守队员碰撞后失去平衡摔倒，但马上站起来参与了防守。.en: He collided with the opposing defender, lost his balance, and fell, but immediately got up and joined the defense.

要想在生活中不失去平衡，工作与休息、成就与人际关系之间的和谐是必不可少的。.en: To avoid losing balance in life, harmony between work and rest, and between achievements and relationships, is essential.

他虽然个子小，但掰腕子从不输给任何人。.en: Although he is small, he never loses to anyone in arm wrestling.

他在掰腕子比赛中一举压制对手，夺得了冠军。.en: He overpowered his opponent in the arm wrestling match and won the championship.

他气得一脚把椅子踢翻了。.en: He was so angry that he kicked the chair over.

足球选手朝着球门一脚踢出了球。.en: The soccer player kicked the ball toward the goal.

两队一直打到加时赛，但最终以平局结束了比赛。.en: The two teams played into overtime, but the match ended in a draw.

如果出现平局，将用点球大战决出胜者。.en: If there is a draw, the winner will be decided by a penalty shootout.

他因为没有计划性，总是在截止日期前手忙脚乱。.en: Because he lacks planning, he always scrambles at the last minute before the deadline.

和没有计划性的人一起工作，进展会很慢，而且有压力。.en: Working with someone who lacks planning is slow and stressful.

会议气氛那么严肃他还在开玩笑，看来他真的很没眼力见儿。.en: He was joking even though the meeting atmosphere was so serious; he really lacks social awareness.

因为没眼力见儿的后辈，前辈们之间发生了尴尬的情况。.en: Because of the junior who lacks social awareness, an awkward situation occurred among the seniors.

她自尊心很强，很难向别人求助。.en: She has a strong sense of pride and finds it hard to ask others for help.

自尊心越强的人，受到伤害时反应越大。.en: The stronger a person's self-esteem, the bigger their reaction when hurt.

他是那种连很小的玩笑都会轻易生气的人。.en: He's the type who easily gets angry over even small jokes.

上司无视我的报告，他一下子就生气了并提出了抗议。.en: When my boss ignored my report, he immediately got angry and protested.

她拥有端庄且女性化的魅力。.en: She has a dignified and feminine charm.

最近男性中间也流行女性化的时尚风格。.en: Recently, feminine fashion styles have become popular among men too.

他性格圆滑，和谁都能相处得好。.en: He has a harmonious personality and gets along well with everyone.

谈判在双方的让步下圆满达成了协议。.en: The negotiations reached a harmonious agreement thanks to both sides making concessions.

和难得见面的朋友一起吃美味的晚餐，聊得很开心。.en: I had a great time chatting over a delicious dinner with a friend I rarely get to see.

难得的休息日却下雨了，所以决定在家休息。.en: It rained on my rare day off, so I decided to rest at home.

宝宝在闹，我一看是到了该换尿布的时候了。.en: The baby was fussing, and when I checked, it was time to change the diaper.

刚开始换尿布还很生疏，但现在闭着眼睛都能做了。.en: At first, changing diapers was awkward, but now I can do it with my eyes closed.

因为怕迟到而慌慌张张的，结果把重要文件落在家里了。.en: In a fluster about being late, I ended up leaving the important documents at home.

客人突然多了起来，厨房里的员工明显在慌张地忙活。.en: Suddenly, a lot of guests showed up, and the kitchen staff were clearly flustered and busy.

发生大事故时，越沉着行动，越能减少损失。.en: In a major accident, the calmer you act, the more you can reduce the damage.

他是一个在任何情况下都能保持沉着的领导者。.en: He is a leader who can stay calm in any situation.

如果这次给予的机会不尽全力，将来会后悔的。.en: If you don't give it your all with this opportunity you've been given, you'll regret it later.

如果给予的时间不充足，就很难期待好的结果。.en: If not enough time is given, it's hard to expect good results.

他的语言感觉出众，学习外语的速度比其他人快得多。.en: He has an outstanding sense of language, so he learns foreign languages much faster than others.

这款产品不仅设计出众，耐久性也很卓越，受到了消费者的好评。.en: This product not only has an outstanding design, but its durability is also excellent, receiving praise from consumers.

那位演员情感丰富，仅凭眼神就能让观众落泪。.en: That actor is so emotionally rich that he can make the audience cry just with his eyes.

情感丰富的人往往能更深入地理解和共鸣艺术作品。.en: People who are emotionally rich often understand and resonate with art more deeply.

千里之行始于足下.en: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

再庞大的项目也得从小事做起，正所谓‘千里之行始于足下’。.en: Even the biggest project has to start with small tasks, as they say, 'A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.'

学一门新语言可能让人感到茫然，但‘千里之行始于足下’，今天先背第一个单词吧。.en: Learning a new language can feel overwhelming, but 'a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step'—start by memorizing the first word today.

好的开始是成功的一半，万事开头难。.en: A good start is half the battle; the beginning is always the hardest.

既然已经开始写论文摘要了，那就是成功的一半，接下来只要填充正文就行了。.en: Since you've already started writing the thesis abstract, that's half the battle—now you just need to fill in the main body.

开始运动是最难的，但一旦穿上跑鞋，就是‘好的开始是成功的一半’。.en: Starting to exercise is the hardest part, but once you put on your running shoes, it's 'a good start is half the battle.'

那个人嘴不严，绝对不能跟他说秘密。.en: That person is loose-lipped; you absolutely cannot tell them a secret.

因为一个嘴碎的同事，公司的机密信息泄露，造成了严重问题。.en: Because of a gossipy coworker, the company's confidential information leaked, causing serious problems.

律师必须保护委托人的秘密，所以当然得嘴严。.en: Lawyers must protect their clients' secrets, so of course they have to be tight-lipped.

他是个无论如何都不会开口的嘴严的人。.en: He is a tight-lipped person who never opens his mouth no matter what.

孩子嘴巴太刁，我每天都发愁该给他做什么吃的。.en: My child is such a picky eater that I worry every day about what to cook for him.

她挑食，出去吃饭也总是点同样的菜。.en: She's a picky eater and always orders the same dish when eating out.

他眼光太高了，一般的产品根本满足不了他。.en: His standards are too high; ordinary products simply can't satisfy him.

朋友对相亲对象挑剔得厉害，也许是他自己眼光太高了。.en: My friend is very picky about blind dates; maybe his own standards are too high.

我们家人吃饭时总是以当天发生的事情为话题。.en: In our family, we always talk about what happened that day during meals.

他在舞台上失误后，把自己变成了笑柄，逗乐了观众。.en: After his mistake on stage, he became a laughingstock and entertained the audience.

他那滑稽的表情在朋友之间成了笑柄。.en: His funny expressions became a laughingstock among friends.

那位政治人物的私生活丑闻足以成为大众的关注点。.en: That politician's private life scandal was enough to become a public focus.

他将踢踏舞富有节奏的脚步声升华为音乐的一部分。.en: He sublimated the rhythmic tapping of tap dance into part of the music.

此次庆典准备了传统与现代艺术同台融合的特别舞台。.en: This festival has prepared a special stage where traditional and modern arts blend together.

他们时隔许久聚在同一个地方，聊着近况，度过了愉快的时光。.en: They gathered in the same place after a long time, catching up and having a good time.

他犹豫不决，最终错过了好机会，深感后悔。.en: He hesitated and ended up missing a good opportunity, deeply regretting it.

蜂拥而至，拥过来；聚拢；袭来.en: swarm, flock, surge; crowd in; rush over

他没有正面反驳对方的意见，而是隐约流露出不悦的神色。.en: He didn't directly refute the other person's opinion, but subtly showed displeasure.

这食物看起来不辣，但辣味却有些刺激。.en: This food doesn't look spicy, but the spiciness is a bit intense.

心上人.en: the one in one's heart / beloved

想着心上人写的信还留在他书桌抽屉里。.en: The letter written thinking of the beloved is still in his desk drawer.

他昨天说的话和今天说的话完全前后矛盾。.en: What he said yesterday and what he said today are completely contradictory.

散布那种假新闻的行为，只能说没有良心。.en: Spreading that kind of fake news can only be described as having no conscience.

从一大早起隔壁就在敲锤子，把我觉都吵没了。.en: The neighbor next door has been hammering since early morning, and it completely ruined my sleep.

敲锤子敲久了，手腕很疼。.en: After hammering for a long time, my wrist hurts a lot.

她害怕别人的目光和指责，甚至不愿出门。.en: She is afraid of others' stares and criticism, to the point that she doesn't even want to go out.

双重态度终究会招致周围人的指责。.en: A double-faced attitude will eventually invite criticism from those around you.

严重的打嗝停不下来，最后还是去了医院。.en: The severe hiccups wouldn't stop, so I ended up going to the hospital.

发表途中突然打起嗝来，真的很慌张。.en: I suddenly started hiccuping in the middle of my presentation, and it was really embarrassing.

体力劳动比脑力劳动消耗体力大得多。.en: Physical labor consumes much more energy than mental labor.

他从事体力劳动20年，但仍不忘为保持健康而坚持锻炼。.en: He has done physical labor for 20 years, but still doesn't forget to exercise to stay healthy.

脑力劳动虽然看不见，但压力容易累积。.en: Although mental labor is invisible, stress tends to build up easily.

如今的研究职位是典型的脑力劳动，同时要求长时间的专注力。.en: Today's research positions are typical mental labor, requiring long periods of concentration.

那件事之后，他和所有朋友都断绝了关系。.en: After that incident, he severed ties with all his friends.

如果关系已经变得有害，也需要果断断绝关系。.en: If a relationship has become harmful, you need to decisively sever ties.

不能说他的所有行为都是错的，但至少那个方法显然是错误的。.en: You can't say everything he does is wrong, but at least that method is clearly incorrect.

打孩子在教育上是错误的，这种认识正在逐渐扩散。.en: The awareness that hitting children is wrong in education is gradually spreading.

掀开；使后仰；翻过来.en: Flip over; tilt back; turn over

他整理书桌时，把文件掀到了一边。.en: While organizing his desk, he flipped the documents to one side.

在酒席上，他仰起头大笑起来。.en: At the drinking party, he tilted his head back and laughed loudly.

地铁突然停运，乘客们经历了很大的不便。.en: The subway suddenly stopped running, and passengers experienced great inconvenience.

残疾人在使用公共交通时仍然经历着诸多不便。.en: People with disabilities still experience many inconveniences when using public transportation.

他的证词生动得仿佛亲眼目睹了案发现场，令陪审团为之震撼。.en: His testimony was so vivid, as if he had witnessed the scene firsthand, that it stunned the jury.

这个村庄的人们坚守着传承数百年的独特婚礼传统。.en: The people of this village uphold a unique wedding tradition that has been passed down for hundreds of years.

在变化的时代中坚守传统是维持身份认同的重要方法。.en: Upholding tradition in a time of change is an important way to maintain identity.

手足无措；诚惶诚恐.en: at a loss; overwhelmed with awe and fear

放任高血压和糖尿病不管，中风发生的概率会升高。.en: If high blood pressure and diabetes are left untreated, the probability of having a stroke increases.

昨晚没睡好，今天一整天头昏脑涨，很疲惫。.en: I didn't sleep well last night, so I've been feeling dizzy and exhausted all day today.

考试前一天因为紧张而睡眠不足，反而可能发挥不出实力。.en: If you don't get enough sleep due to nervousness the day before an exam, you might not be able to perform to your full potential.

该产品自购买日起适用两年质量保证书，请放心使用。.en: This product comes with a two-year quality warranty from the date of purchase, so please use it with confidence.

如果发生人权侵害事件，应立即向相关机构举报。.en: If a human rights violation occurs, it should be reported to the relevant authorities immediately.

婚期临近却什么都没准备好，心里很着急。.en: The wedding is approaching but nothing is ready, so I'm very anxious.

这件事既能创造收益又能保护环境，是一箭双雕的事业。.en: This project can both generate profit and protect the environment — it's a kill-two-birds-with-one-stone endeavor.

公司公告栏上贴出了本月的人事动态。.en: This month's personnel changes were posted on the company bulletin board.

报纸的时政漫画尖锐地讽刺政治现实。.en: The newspaper's political cartoon sharply satirizes political reality.

孩子正缠着妈妈让再给点饭。.en: The child is pestering his mom to give him more rice.

他再三叮嘱我，让我一定要完成这件事。.en: He repeatedly urged me to make sure I finish this task.

做了好梦之后，事情开始顺利起来。.en: After having a good dream, things started going smoothly.

整晚都睡得很轻，早上起来身体像千斤重。.en: I slept very lightly all night, and when I woke up in the morning, my body felt as heavy as lead.

他们成了可以彼此开诚布公、无话不谈的朋友。.en: They became friends who could open up to each other and talk about anything.

那篇电影评论侧重于分析作品的深度。.en: That movie review focuses on analyzing the depth of the work.

孩子们好奇地一瞟一瞟地看着陌生的客人。.en: The children curiously stole glances at the unfamiliar guest.

那个社团对新会员表现出了排斥的态度。.en: That club showed an exclusionary attitude toward new members.

排斥的民族主义可能会阻碍国际合作。.en: Exclusionary nationalism can hinder international cooperation.

劳资之间的矛盾严重加深，谈判破裂了。.en: The conflict between labor and management became severely aggravated, and negotiations broke down.

两国之间的矛盾严重，和平会谈告吹了。.en: The conflict between the two countries was severe, and peace talks fell through.

他为了决定前途而深思熟虑。.en: He thought deeply to decide his future.

经过深思熟虑，她最终决定辞职。.en: After careful consideration, she finally decided to resign.

这份工作报酬虽好，但有许多苦衷。.en: This job pays well, but there are many difficulties.

职场新人在工作中常常伴随着各种苦衷。.en: Newcomers in the workplace often face various difficulties at work.

因意见分歧，两队之间产生了矛盾。.en: Due to differences of opinion, conflict arose between the two teams.

因遗产问题，家人之间产生了严重的矛盾。.en: Due to inheritance issues, serious conflict arose among family members.

随着时间的推移，两个群体之间的矛盾深化了。.en: Over time, the conflict between the two groups deepened.

由于资源短缺问题，地区矛盾正在深化。.en: Due to resource shortages, regional conflicts are deepening.

韩国与欧盟之间的自由贸易协定生效后，两国之间的贸易量大幅增加。.en: After the free trade agreement between Korea and the EU took effect, trade volume between the two countries increased significantly.

为了缔结自由贸易协定，双方进行了数年的激烈谈判。.en: To conclude a free trade agreement, the two sides held intense negotiations for several years.

随着新的贸易协定被缔结，相关行业的期待感正在升高。.en: As new trade agreements are concluded, expectations in related industries are rising.

在合同被订立之前，双方律师进行了多次法律审查。.en: Before the contract was concluded, lawyers from both sides conducted multiple legal reviews.

政府正在降低进口农产品的关税，以谋求物价稳定。.en: The government is lowering tariffs on imported agricultural products to stabilize prices.

为了进入关税壁垒较高的国家，需要采取在当地设立生产工厂的策略。.en: To enter countries with high tariff barriers, a strategy of setting up local production plants is needed.

政府决定设立用于支援中小企业的特别基金。.en: The government decided to establish a special fund to support small and medium-sized enterprises.

这笔基金主要用于低收入家庭学生的奖学金发放。.en: This fund is mainly used for providing scholarships to students from low-income families.

非关税壁垒有时反而比关税更能成为贸易的绊脚石。.en: Non-tariff barriers can sometimes become bigger stumbling blocks to trade than tariffs.

为了跨越语言障碍，她每天学习三个小时的韩语。.en: To overcome the language barrier, she studies Korean for three hours every day.

突如其来的金融危机给全球经济造成了严重打击。.en: The sudden financial crisis dealt a severe blow to the global economy.

那家公司因失去了主要出口市场，销售额受到了巨大打击。.en: That company suffered a huge blow to its sales after losing its main export market.

今年第一季度贸易收支创下了历史最大盈余。.en: The trade balance recorded its largest surplus ever in the first quarter of this year.

这家企业在结构调整后，时隔三年成功扭亏为盈。.en: After restructuring, this company turned a profit for the first time in three years.

为了提高国家竞争力，必须投资于技术创新和人才培养。.en: To improve national competitiveness, we must invest in technological innovation and talent development.

在世界经济论坛发布的国家竞争力排名中，韩国保持了前十名。.en: In the national competitiveness rankings released by the World Economic Forum, South Korea remained in the top ten.

国际收支虽然持续保持盈余，但服务收支赤字仍然是一个课题。.en: Although the balance of payments continues to show a surplus, the deficit in services trade remains a challenge.

国际收支统计是评估一国对外经济健全性的重要指标。.en: Balance of payments statistics are an important indicator for assessing a country's external economic health.

跨国企业正在推行针对当地市场的定制化营销策略。.en: Multinational corporations are implementing customized marketing strategies for local markets.

该地区经济在很大程度上依赖于几家跨国企业的投资。.en: The region's economy heavily depends on investments from several multinational corporations.

在全球化时代，国家间的文化交流与经济合作变得更加重要。.en: In the era of globalization, cultural exchange and economic cooperation between countries have become more important.

全球化时代的到来，对企业而言既是新的机遇也是挑战。.en: The arrival of the globalization era presents both new opportunities and challenges for businesses.

政府为了消除对农产品市场开放的忧虑，发布了多项对策。.en: The government announced several measures to alleviate concerns about opening the agricultural market.

随着市场开放压力的加大，国内制造业的竞争变得更加激烈。.en: As the pressure of market opening increases, competition in the domestic manufacturing industry becomes more intense.

随着外汇储备急剧减少，出现了对国家信用评级下调的担忧。.en: As foreign exchange reserves sharply decreased, there were concerns about a downgrade in the national credit rating.

出国旅行兑换外汇时，最好使用手续费低廉的银行。.en: When exchanging foreign currency for overseas travel, it's best to use a bank with low fees.

在1997年外汇危机时，韩国不得不向国际货币基金组织申请救济贷款。.en: During the 1997 foreign exchange crisis, South Korea had to apply for bailout loans from the International Monetary Fund.

克服外汇危机的经验成为了改善韩国经济体质的一个契机。.en: The experience of overcoming the foreign exchange crisis became an opportunity to improve the Korean economy's fundamentals.

根据两国间的自由贸易协定，主要品目的关税取消正在分阶段进行。.en: According to the free trade agreement between the two countries, tariff elimination on major items is being carried out in stages.

如果关税被完全取消，消费者将能够以更低廉的价格购买进口商品。.en: If tariffs are completely eliminated, consumers will be able to buy imported goods at lower prices.

最近一些国家为了保护本国产业，正在加强贸易保护措施。.en: Recently, some countries are strengthening trade protection measures to protect their domestic industries.

贸易保护主义的蔓延可能会对世界经济增长产生负面影响。.en: The spread of trade protectionism could have a negative impact on global economic growth.

进口自由化政策扩大了消费者的选择范围，但对部分脆弱产业构成了威胁。.en: The import liberalization policy expanded consumers' choices, but posed a threat to some vulnerable industries.

政府正在一边调整进口自由化的速度，一边摸索提升国内产业竞争力的方案。.en: The government is adjusting the pace of import liberalization while exploring ways to enhance the competitiveness of domestic industries.

有分析认为，此次谈判的背后有强大的游说团体在施加影响力。.en: There is analysis that behind this negotiation, a powerful lobbying group is exerting influence.

他下令进行彻底调查，以查明事件的幕后主使是谁。.en: He ordered a thorough investigation to find out who was behind the incident.

外国资本大举流入国内房地产市场，助推了价格上涨。.en: Foreign capital has flowed massively into the domestic real estate market, driving up prices.

那家企业为了进军新事业，大举引进了相关领域的专家。.en: That company brought in experts from related fields on a large scale to enter a new business.

政府为了扑灭山火，动员了消防员和军人等所有可用人力。.en: The government mobilized all available personnel, including firefighters and soldiers, to extinguish the forest fire.

他为了成功推进项目，动员了人脉和资金等所有资源。.en: He mobilized all resources, including connections and funds, to successfully push the project forward.

新冠疫情之后，全球物资流通体系发生了巨大变化。.en: After the COVID-19 pandemic, the global logistics system underwent major changes.

这一地区物资流通不畅，所以生活物价非常高。.en: In this region, the distribution of goods is not smooth, so the cost of living is very high.

联合国教科文组织将这里指定为世界自然遗产。.en: UNESCO designated this place as a World Natural Heritage site.

很多人认为，为了保护自然遗产，应当限制游客进入。.en: Many people think that to protect natural heritage, tourist access should be restricted.

该法案经过国会审议后最终获得通过。.en: The bill was finally passed after deliberation in the National Assembly.

电影分级审议结果比预想的更严格，引发了争议。.en: The movie rating deliberation result was stricter than expected, sparking controversy.

索性就，既然已经开始做.en: might as well, since we've already started

既然都来图书馆了，索性就借几本书走吧。.en: Since we're already at the library, we might as well borrow a few books.

索性就做完这件事再走比较好。.en: It's better to just finish this task before leaving.

战后被搁置多年的农田完全荒废了。.en: The farmland that had been neglected for years after the war was completely abandoned.

山火导致大范围的森林地区荒废，酿成了惨剧。.en: The wildfire caused a large area of forest to become abandoned, leading to a tragedy.

盗掘古代坟墓的一伙人被警察抓获了。.en: A group of people looting ancient tombs were caught by the police.

盗掘文化遗产的行为是被严格禁止的。.en: The act of looting cultural heritage is strictly prohibited.

由于过度抽取地下水，市中心地区的地基弱化现象十分严重。.en: Due to excessive groundwater extraction, the foundation weakening in the city center is very serious.

地基弱化可能直接威胁到建筑物的安全。.en: Weakening of the foundation can directly threaten the safety of a building.

因暴雨，遗址的壁画遭到了严重毁坏。.en: Due to the heavy rain, the murals at the historic site were severely damaged.

对于损害个人名誉的言论，可以采取法律措施。.en: Legal measures can be taken against statements that harm a person's reputation.

您给了与我的实力相比过高的评价，实在是过奖了。.en: You gave me a higher evaluation than my abilities deserve, I'm truly flattered.

过誉了，这种事谁都能做到。.en: You flatter me, anyone can do this.

她一个人辛苦抚养孩子的样子，真的让人很过意不去。.en: Seeing her raise her child alone with such hardship really makes me feel sorry for her.

看你工作到那么晚，我很过意不去，想帮帮你。.en: Seeing you work so late makes me feel bad, I want to help you.

这家店的泡菜汤说是这一带首屈一指的也不为过。.en: It's no exaggeration to say that this place's kimchi stew is second to none in this area.

在韩国传统文化中，韩服的美是首屈一指的。.en: In traditional Korean culture, the beauty of Hanbok is second to none.

父亲偏要反对我去上大学。.en: My father is stubbornly opposed to me going to college.

他嫌好机会，决定留在故乡。.en: He disdained the good opportunity and decided to stay in his hometown.

再忙也不嫌弃吃饭，一定会好好吃。.en: No matter how busy I am, I never skip a meal and always eat well.

奶奶行动不便，全家人轮流照料。.en: Grandma has difficulty moving, so the whole family takes turns caring for her.

他十多年来独自照料生病的父亲。.en: He has been caring for his sick father alone for over ten years.

在韩国，中秋节和春节会举行称为“茶礼”的崇拜祖先仪式。.en: In Korea, ancestor worship ceremonies called 'charye' are held during Chuseok and Lunar New Year.

崇拜祖先是儒家文化的核心价值之一。.en: Ancestor worship is one of the core values of Confucian culture.

她悉心侍奉公婆，在村里以孝顺媳妇闻名。.en: She diligently serves her in-laws and is known in the village as a filial daughter-in-law.

古代故事里有很多孝顺媳妇克服困难获得福报的内容。.en: In ancient stories, there are many tales of filial daughters-in-law overcoming hardships and receiving blessings.

通过数字化转型提高工作效率是今年的目标。.en: Improving work efficiency through digital transformation is this year's goal.

为了提高工作效率，引入了人工智能系统。.en: To improve work efficiency, an artificial intelligence system was introduced.

医生切开患者的腹部，切除了肿瘤。.en: The doctor cut open the patient's abdomen and removed the tumor.

切开手术部位时，尽量减少出血的技术很重要。.en: When cutting open the surgical site, the technique of minimizing bleeding is important.

手术后干净地缝合伤口对于预防感染是必不可少的。.en: After surgery, cleanly stitching the wound is essential to prevent infection.

医生使用显微手术线精准地缝合了神经。.en: The doctor precisely stitched the nerve using microsurgical thread.

在这个博物馆，可以通过3D立体影像生动地体验恐龙的动态。.en: In this museum, you can vividly experience the movements of dinosaurs through 3D stereoscopic images.

随着3D立体影像技术的发展，虚拟现实内容的沉浸感大大提高了。.en: With the development of 3D stereoscopic imaging technology, the immersion of virtual reality content has greatly improved.

现代社会中的人际关系疏远随着技术的发展而日益加深。.en: The alienation in interpersonal relationships in modern society is deepening with the advancement of technology.

为了解决人际关系疏远问题，他积极参与社区活动。.en: To solve the problem of alienation in human relationships, he actively participates in community activities.

在急剧变化的时代，如果无法适应，就难免被自然淘汰。.en: In a rapidly changing era, if you can't adapt, you will inevitably be naturally eliminated.

这家公司为了不在竞争中被淘汰，不断地进行创新。.en: This company constantly innovates to avoid being eliminated in the competition.

随着生命工程的发展，为治疗疑难杂症打开了新的可能性。.en: With the development of life engineering, new possibilities have opened up for treating incurable diseases.

那家研究所在生命工程领域正取得世界级的成果。.en: That research institute is achieving world-class results in the field of life engineering.

不思进取，安于现状.en: not striving for progress, being content with the status quo

不能安于现状，而应向更高的目标迈进。.en: You can't be content with the status quo; you should move toward higher goals.

他因安于小小的成功，最终错过了大好机会。.en: He was content with small successes and ultimately missed a great opportunity.

在第四次工业革命时代，为了在头脑风暴中取胜，培养创造性人才是必不可少的。.en: In the era of the Fourth Industrial Revolution, cultivating creative talent is essential to win in brainstorming.

全球企业之间的头脑风暴日益激烈。.en: Brainstorming among global companies is becoming increasingly intense.

在物质万能主义社会，人的价值很容易被金钱所衡量。.en: In a material-omnipotent society, a person's value is easily measured by money.

比起物质万能，他更看重精神的富足。.en: Rather than material omnipotence, he values spiritual richness more.

拥有乐观进取思考的人能够克服任何困难。.en: A person with optimistic and proactive thinking can overcome any difficulty.

她以乐观进取的思考给团队成员带来了巨大的激励。.en: She gave great motivation to the team members with her optimistic and proactive thinking.

具备深厚涵养的人能够与各个领域的人顺畅沟通。.en: A person with deep cultivation can communicate smoothly with people from all fields.

他是以包括历史和哲学在内的深厚涵养而闻名的学者。.en: He is a scholar known for his deep cultivation, including history and philosophy.

数得上，屈指可数.en: countable / can be counted on one's fingers

这所大学是国内屈指可数的名牌大学之一。.en: This university is one of the few prestigious universities in the country.

那位演员被评价为代表韩国的屈指可数的表演者。.en: That actor is evaluated as one of the few performers representing Korea.

他以创新的想法创办了风险企业，并取得了巨大的成功。.en: He founded a venture company with innovative ideas and achieved great success.

政府正在推行多种政策以支持风险企业的成长。.en: The government is implementing various policies to support the growth of venture companies.

中小企业因严重的雇工难而在业务扩展上遇到困难。.en: Small and medium-sized enterprises are having difficulty expanding their business due to a severe labor shortage.

为了解决雇工难，公司决定大幅改善员工福利。.en: To solve the labor shortage, the company decided to significantly improve employee benefits.

不需要专业技术的工作.en: job that doesn't require specialized skills

很多人回避不需要专业技术的工作，导致人力供需失衡。.en: Many people avoid jobs that don't require specialized skills, leading to an imbalance in labor supply and demand.

即使是简单的非技术工作，在难以自动化的领域仍然需要人力。.en: Even simple non-skilled jobs still require manpower in areas that are difficult to automate.

在决定职业方向之前，最好接受一下职业适应性检查。.en: Before deciding on a career path, it's best to take a career aptitude test.

他根据职业适应性检查的结果，梦想成为一名程序员。.en: Based on the results of his career aptitude test, he dreams of becoming a programmer.

就业、升学信息中心运营着多种职业体验项目。.en: The employment and education information center runs various career experience programs.

他通过就业、升学信息中心的咨询找到了适合自己的职业。.en: Through counseling at the employment and education information center, he found a career that suits him.

把简历上传到就业信息网后，多家企业联系了我。.en: After uploading my resume to the job portal, several companies contacted me.

最近就业信息网利用人工智能推荐定制化的招聘公告。.en: Recently, job portals use artificial intelligence to recommend customized job postings.

这家公司以提供业界最高水平的福利而闻名。.en: This company is famous for offering the best benefits in the industry.

寻找福利好的职场的人正在逐渐增多。.en: The number of people looking for workplaces with good benefits is gradually increasing.

跑完，赛完全程.en: run the full course, complete the entire race

他尽管受伤，还是跑完了马拉松全程。.en: Even though he was injured, he ran the full marathon.

真心感谢坚持到底完成这个项目的团队成员们。.en: I sincerely thank the team members who stuck with it and completed this project.

他在全国美术大赛中获奖，才华得到了认可。.en: He won an award in the national art competition, and his talent was recognized.

获奖的学生将获得奖学金以及海外研修的机会。.en: The winning students will receive a scholarship as well as an opportunity for overseas study.

用死板的思维方式很难找到创造性的解决方案。.en: It's hard to find creative solutions with a rigid way of thinking.

他的讲课过于死板，没能引起学生们的兴趣。.en: His lectures were too rigid and failed to spark the students' interest.

难如摘星.en: as hard as plucking stars from the sky

考入那所大学简直是难如摘星。.en: Getting into that university is as hard as plucking stars from the sky.

最近找好工作难如摘星。.en: Finding a good job these days is as hard as plucking stars from the sky.

手机掉了之后液晶屏坏了。.en: After I dropped my phone, the LCD screen broke.

液晶屏坏了，触摸完全没反应。.en: The LCD screen is broken, and the touch is completely unresponsive.

感冒了在吃药，但不见好转。.en: I have a cold and am taking medicine, but it's not getting better.

那家医院以治疗效果好而闻名。.en: That hospital is famous for its effective treatments.

他因事故导致鼻骨骨折，接受了手术。.en: He fractured his nasal bone in an accident and underwent surgery.

鼻骨弯曲，有时呼吸会不舒服。.en: The nasal bone is bent, so sometimes breathing is uncomfortable.

中秋是感谢丰收的日子。.en: Chuseok is a day to give thanks for the harvest.

有为中秋无法回乡的人们举办的活动。.en: There are events held for people who can't return home for Chuseok.

为了预防慢性病，要从年轻时开始保持健康的生活习惯。.en: To prevent chronic diseases, you need to maintain healthy habits from a young age.

高血压或糖尿病等慢性病需要持续管理。.en: Chronic diseases like high blood pressure or diabetes require ongoing management.

两支队伍实力势均力敌，很难预测哪一方会赢。.en: The two teams are neck and neck in strength, so it's hard to predict who will win.

和他们的对决总是势均力敌，必须看到最后才能知道胜负。.en: Matches against them are always neck and neck; you have to watch until the end to know the outcome.

他是一位总是堂堂正正地一决胜负的运动员。.en: He is an athlete who always competes fairly and squarely.

用不正当的方法赢得的胜利不是真正的胜利。.en: A victory achieved through unfair means is not a true victory.

我们队上半场领先两球，下半场却连丢三球被逆转落败。.en: Our team was leading by two goals in the first half, but then conceded three goals in the second half and lost after being overturned.

他在最后一盘拿到赛点后，却被对手反击，惨遭逆转失利。.en: After getting match point in the final set, he was counterattacked by his opponent and suffered a heartbreaking reversal defeat.

会议中意见出现分歧，大家都左右为难，没能得出结论。.en: Opinions were divided during the meeting, and everyone was in a dilemma, unable to reach a conclusion.

迷路后左右为难地徘徊，结果错过了约定时间。.en: After getting lost, I wandered around in a dilemma and ended up missing the appointment time.

说曹操曹操到，刚才我们正说到你呢。.en: Speak of the devil, we were just talking about you.

刚说他今天会缺席，说曹操曹操到，他马上出现了。.en: We were just saying he would be absent today, and speak of the devil, he showed up right away.

考砸了才开始学习，这无异于亡羊补牢。.en: Starting to study only after failing the exam is like closing the barn door after the horse has bolted.

等安全事故发生了才制定对策，这简直就是亡羊补牢。.en: Coming up with countermeasures only after a safety accident happens is like closing the barn door after the horse has bolted.

三岁看老，指本性难移.en: The child is father of the man; a leopard can't change its spots

从小养成说谎的习惯就改不掉了，要牢记‘三岁看老’这句话。.en: If you develop a habit of lying from childhood, it's hard to break, so keep in mind that 'the child is father of the man.'

他从小养成的习惯一直延续到现在，看来‘三岁看老’这句话确实没错。.en: The habits he formed as a child have continued to this day, so it seems the saying 'the child is father of the man' is indeed true.

猴子也有从树上掉下来的时候。指人有失手，马有失蹄.en: Even monkeys fall from trees. Meaning: even experts make mistakes

再资深的程序员也会犯错，正所谓‘人有失手，马有失蹄’。.en: Even the most experienced programmer can make mistakes, as the saying goes, 'even Homer sometimes nods.'

看到那位钢琴家在演奏中出错，我觉得‘猴子也有从树上掉下来的时候’这句话说得真对。.en: Seeing that pianist make a mistake during the performance, I thought the saying 'even monkeys fall from trees' is really true.

年轻时吃苦是值得的.en: Suffering when you're young is worth it.

虽然辛苦，但这段经历一定会有帮助。俗话说‘年轻时的苦是买来的财富’。.en: It's tough, but this experience will definitely help. As the saying goes, 'The hardships of youth are bought wealth.'

他二十五岁创业失败，但凭着‘年轻时吃苦是值得的’信念重新站了起来。.en: He failed in his business at age 25, but got back up with the belief that 'suffering when you're young is worth it.'

我们是从小一起长大的青梅竹马，即使不说也能明白彼此的想法。.en: We grew up together as childhood friends, so we can understand each other's thoughts without even speaking.

他是我陷入困境时最先跑来帮助我的真正的竹马之交。.en: He's the true childhood friend who runs to help me first when I'm in trouble.

关于那家公司的传闻沸沸扬扬，无风不起浪，所以我持谨慎态度。.en: Rumors about that company are swirling, and there's no smoke without fire, so I'm being cautious.

很多人怀疑两人的关系，但无风不起浪，不是吗？.en: Many people suspect the relationship between the two, but there's no smoke without fire, right?

画饼充饥.en: Drawing a cake to stave off hunger; an illusion.

他虽然升职了，但没有实权，无异于画饼充饥。.en: Although he got promoted, he has no real power, so it's like drawing a cake to stave off hunger.

富人区的房价对于普通百姓来说，不过是画饼充饥而已。.en: Housing prices in wealthy districts are just an illusion for ordinary people.

在会议上只顾坚持己见的话，很容易破坏团队合作。.en: If you just stick to your own opinion in a meeting, it's easy to ruin teamwork.

讨论时，重要的是在尊重对方意见的同时，适当地坚持自己的主张。.en: In a discussion, it's important to respect the other person's opinion while appropriately asserting your own.

在奥运会决赛中，两位选手展开了激烈的比赛。.en: In the Olympic finals, the two players engaged in a fierce match.

在象棋大赛中，他们直到最后一着棋都展开了较量。.en: In the chess tournament, they competed fiercely until the very last move.

游子，旅人；对陌生男人的古代称呼。.en: wanderer, traveler; an ancient term for a stranger.

他离开家乡在外漂泊的生活已经超过10年了。.en: He has been living away from home as a wanderer for over 10 years.

古诗中有很多吟唱漂泊旅人凄凉心境的作品。.en: There are many ancient poems that sing of the desolate feelings of wandering travelers.

那个朋友从小习惯了在网络游戏中使用缩略词，以至于现在还会在正式文件中犯写缩略词的.en: That friend got used to using abbreviations in online games from a young age, so he still makes mistakes by writing abbreviations in official documents.

有观点指出，最近的学生们习惯了在聊天时使用缩略词，导致写作能力下降。.en: Some point out that recent students have gotten used to using abbreviations in chats, which has led to a decline in their writing skills.

登上高山顶峰，望着开阔的视野，感觉心胸豁然开朗。.en: Climbing to the top of a high mountain and looking at the wide view, I felt my heart suddenly open up.

时隔许久向朋友倾诉了心里话后，感觉胸中畅快，无比舒坦。.en: After opening up to a friend for the first time in a long while, I felt a great sense of relief and comfort in my chest.

两个人吃着，其中一个死了都不知道。表示非常好吃。.en: Two people are eating, and one of them dies without the other knowing. Means something is extremely delicious.

这家店的炖排骨真的太好吃了，简直让人吃得连旁边的人死了都不知道。.en: The braised ribs at this restaurant are so delicious that you could eat them without even noticing if the person next to you died.

妈妈做的泡菜汤味道一流，好吃到两个人吃着其中一个死了都不知道。.en: Mom's kimchi stew is top-notch, so delicious that two people could be eating and one could die without the other knowing.

他为了排遣独居的寂寞，领养了一只猫。.en: He adopted a cat to relieve the loneliness of living alone.

音乐是她排解异乡生活寂寞的唯一方式。.en: Music is her only way to relieve the loneliness of living in a foreign land.

孩子在得到父母的爱时，情感会变得稳定。.en: When a child receives love from their parents, their emotions become stable.

规律的运动对情感稳定有很大帮助。.en: Regular exercise greatly helps with emotional stability.

宇宙旅行在理论上是可能的，但在现实中需要巨额费用。.en: Space travel is theoretically possible, but in reality it requires enormous costs.

理论上是可能的，并不代表就一定能实现。.en: Just because something is theoretically possible doesn't mean it can definitely be realized.

一天之内完成这个项目在现实中是不可能的。.en: Completing this project within a day is practically impossible.

他的提议很理想化，但在现实中不可能的因素很多。.en: His proposal is idealistic, but there are many factors that make it practically impossible.

棱镜具有将白光折射成多种颜色的光学特性。.en: A prism has the optical property of refracting white light into multiple colors.

通过透镜的光根据角度发生方向折射，因此成像位置会有所不同。.en: Light passing through a lens changes direction depending on the angle, so the image forms in a different position.

根据孟德尔遗传定律，圆豌豆形状相对于皱豌豆形状是显性性状。.en: According to Mendel's law of inheritance, the round pea shape is dominant over the wrinkled pea shape.

棕色眼睛由显性基因决定，因此拥有棕色眼睛的人更多。.en: Brown eyes are determined by a dominant gene, so more people have brown eyes.

在结冰的路面上，摩擦力会急剧减小，车辆容易打滑，因此需要特别注意。.en: On icy roads, friction decreases sharply, making vehicles prone to slipping, so extra caution is needed.

这款运动鞋在鞋底使用了特殊橡胶，通过最大化摩擦力来防止打滑。.en: These sneakers use special rubber on the sole to maximize friction and prevent slipping.

第一次去海外旅行那天的兴奋与恐惧至今记忆犹新。.en: The excitement and fear from the day of my first overseas trip are still fresh in my memory.

爷爷去世前最后一次和我进行的对话，即使过了10年，现在也记忆犹新。.en: The last conversation I had with my grandfather before he passed away is still fresh in my memory, even after 10 years.

她至今仍将儿时奶奶讲过的童话作为温暖的回忆珍藏在心。.en: She still cherishes the fairy tales her grandmother told her as a child as warm memories in her heart.

虽然分开了，但他下定决心将对她纯真的爱永远珍藏在心。.en: Although they parted, he resolved to forever cherish his pure love for her in his heart.

虽然分开了，但我们一起度过的时光会留下美好的回忆。.en: Although we parted, the time we spent together will leave good memories.

那段艰难的留学时光现在也成为了美好的回忆。.en: That difficult time studying abroad has now become a good memory.

时隔十年再去那座城市，已经变得面目全非。.en: When I went to that city after ten years, it had changed beyond recognition.

他振作起来开始运动后，变得判若两人。.en: After he pulled himself together and started exercising, he became a completely different person.

同学会上见到二十年没见的朋友，他变得我完全认不出来了。.en: At the class reunion, I saw a friend I hadn't seen in twenty years, and he had changed so much I couldn't recognize him at all.

可能是因为瘦了很多，她变得我差点认不出来了。.en: Maybe because she lost a lot of weight, she changed so much I almost didn't recognize her.

这个社区的风景过了三十年依然如故。.en: The scenery of this neighborhood is still the same after thirty years.

我们之间的关系依然如故，不要太担心了。.en: Our relationship is still the same, so don't worry too much.

那家店和以前相比，很多人都说味道不如从前了。.en: Compared to before, many people say that store's food is not as good as it used to be.

最近深切地感受到体力不如从前了。.en: Lately, I've really felt that my stamina is not as good as before.

在国外旅游地遇到高中同学，世界真小啊。.en: Running into a high school classmate at a tourist destination abroad — it's a small world.

我们公司的新员工竟然是我的大学学弟，世界真小。.en: The new employee at our company turned out to be my junior from college — it's a small world.

猫为了抓老鼠，悄悄地靠近了。.en: The cat quietly approached to catch the mouse.

他神不知鬼不觉地悄悄起身，走到了外面。.en: He quietly got up without anyone noticing and went outside.

他表面看起来很亲切，但心地却很恶劣。.en: He looks friendly on the surface, but he is mean-spirited.

邻居心地恶劣，小区里的人都讨厌他。.en: The neighbor is mean-spirited, so everyone in the neighborhood dislikes him.

他是在上司面前只会点头哈腰、一味拍马屁的人。.en: He is the kind of person who just bows and scrapes and sucks up to his boss.

看到他对当权者点头哈腰的样子，实在令人不齿。.en: Seeing him bow and scrape to those in power is really disgraceful.

日益膨胀.en: growing increasingly, swelling day by day

城市人口日益膨胀，住房问题正变得严重。.en: As the city population grows increasingly, the housing problem is becoming serious.

随着企业规模日益膨胀，管理体系未能跟上。.en: As the company swelled day by day, the management system couldn't keep up.

挽髻.en: putting up a topknot, tying hair in a bun

他在传统婚礼上挽起了发髻，穿上了道袍。.en: At the traditional wedding, he put up his topknot and wore a scholar's robe.

朝鲜时代，男性成年后大多会挽起发髻。.en: In the Joseon era, most men would put up a topknot after coming of age.

冠婚丧祭.en: coming-of-age, wedding, funeral, and ancestral rites

冠婚丧祭是韩国传统社会中最重要的四种礼仪。.en: The four most important rites in traditional Korean society are coming-of-age, wedding, funeral, and ancestral rites.

如今的年轻一代往往不太了解冠婚丧祭的流程。.en: Today's younger generation often doesn't know much about the procedures of coming-of-age, wedding, funeral, and ancestral rites.

这项研究旨在揭示不同文化的共同性。.en: This study aims to reveal the commonalities among different cultures.

我相信人类即使语言和习俗不同，也存在着共同性。.en: I believe that even if people have different languages and customs, there is commonality among them.

那家企业的存亡取决于这次新产品的成功与否。.en: The survival of that company depends on the success or failure of this new product.

政府就该法案的存废展开了激烈的争论。.en: The government had a heated debate over whether to keep or abolish the bill.

这款冰箱使用了环保型制冷剂。.en: This refrigerator uses an eco-friendly refrigerant.

为了防止制冷剂泄漏，需要定期检查。.en: To prevent refrigerant leaks, regular inspections are necessary.

他把失败当作逢凶化吉的契机，取得了更大的成功。.en: He turned failure into an opportunity to turn misfortune into good fortune and achieved greater success.

所谓逢凶化吉，这次危机反而可能成为好机会。.en: As they say, turning misfortune into good fortune, this crisis might actually become a good opportunity.

他以百折不挠的精神克服了无数挫折。.en: He overcame countless setbacks with an indomitable spirit.

她百折不挠的样子感动了许多人。.en: Her tenacious attitude moved many people.

没有足够的信息，很难做出正确的价值判断。.en: Without enough information, it's hard to make a correct value judgment.

对于那件事，至今仍未形成明确的价值判断。.en: A clear value judgment has yet to be formed about that matter.

乘胜追击.en: follow up a victory with hot pursuit / press on

那支队伍整个赛季乘胜追击，最终夺得了冠军。.en: That team pressed on throughout the season and eventually won the championship.

那家初创公司乘胜追击，最终成长为全球性企业。.en: That startup pressed on and eventually grew into a global company.

父母给孩子灌输正确的价值观很重要。.en: It's important for parents to instill the right values in their children.

学校教育应致力于向学生灌输民主价值观。.en: School education should focus on instilling democratic values in students.

青少年时期是形成自己价值观的重要阶段。.en: Adolescence is an important stage for forming one's own values.

通过多样化的经历，我们可以形成成熟的价值观。.en: Through diverse experiences, we can form mature values.

他在大学时期确立了自己的人生观和价值观。.en: He established his own outlook on life and values during his college years.

通过社会生活，他逐渐确立了坚定的价值观。.en: Through social life, he gradually established firm values.

由于社会的急剧变化，许多人正经历着价值观的混乱。.en: Due to rapid social changes, many people are experiencing value confusion.

他在留学期间经历了严重的价值观混乱。.en: He experienced severe value confusion during his study abroad.

研究者应排除自身主观，采取价值中立的立场。.en: Researchers should set aside their own subjectivity and adopt a value-neutral stance.

那位教授对有争议的话题采取了价值中立的立场。.en: That professor took a value-neutral stance on the controversial topic.

我们必须对那个决定慎重地做出价值判断。.en: We must carefully make a value judgment on that decision.

他基于自己的经验做出了价值判断。.en: He made a value judgment based on his own experience.

城市中骨灰存放设施不足的问题正变得日益严峻。.en: The problem of insufficient cremation remains storage facilities in the city is becoming increasingly serious.

那家人前往骨灰存放设施，向祖先行礼致意。.en: That family went to the cremation remains storage facility to pay respects to their ancestors.

由于地区利己主义现象，垃圾填埋场的建设一再被推迟。.en: Due to regional egoism, the construction of the landfill has been repeatedly delayed.

地区利己主义现象往往源于当地居民的自私心理。.en: Regional egoism often stems from the selfish psychology of local residents.

有研究结果表明，在现代社会中，具有双性特质的领导者更有效率。.en: Research results show that in modern society, leaders with androgynous traits are more effective.

他展现了兼具男性气质和女性气质的双性特质。.en: He displays androgynous traits that combine both masculinity and femininity.

那个设计是男女都适合的中性风格。.en: That design is a unisex style suitable for both men and women.

最近的时尚潮流正变得越来越中性化。.en: Recent fashion trends are becoming more and more unisex.

为了项目成功，他整天东奔西走。.en: He ran around busily all day for the success of the project.

母亲为了家人总是东奔西走，忙个不停。.en: The mother always runs around busily for her family, never stopping.

我们公司彻底贯彻长幼有序的原则，随着工龄增长，自然而然就会承担领导角色。.en: Our company thoroughly follows the principle of seniority order; as one's years of service increase, they naturally take on leadership roles.

在韩国传统社会中，长幼有序曾是非常重要的价值观，但现代社会更强调代际之间的沟通。.en: In traditional Korean society, seniority order was a very important value, but modern society emphasizes communication between generations.

他为了实践造福人类的精神，一生都奉献给了教育志愿服务。.en: He dedicated his entire life to educational volunteer work in order to practice the spirit of benefiting humanity.

这所大学的建学理念是造福人类，教育学生成为为社会做出贡献的人才。.en: The founding philosophy of this university is to benefit humanity and to educate students to become talents who contribute to society.

执刀，主刀.en: to hold the scalpel, to perform surgery

著名的外科教授亲自执刀进行了心脏手术。.en: A famous surgery professor personally performed the heart surgery.

那场手术由经验丰富的医生主刀，因此没有出现并发症，成功结束了。.en: That surgery was performed by an experienced doctor, so there were no complications and it ended successfully.

那家公司的经营方式太过依然如故，完全没有为数字化转型做好准备。.en: That company's management style is still the same as before, completely unprepared for digital transformation.

很多人批评说，用依然如故的教育方式无法培养出创造性人才。.en: Many people criticize that creative talents cannot be nurtured with an educational method that remains unchanged.

这个项目的成功，研究团队彻底的数据分析起到了重要作用。.en: The research team's thorough data analysis played an important role in the success of this project.

他在初创公司的初期阶段，在制定营销战略方面起了重要作用，引领了公司的成长。.en: He played an important role in formulating the marketing strategy during the startup's early stages, leading the company's growth.

青蛙忘了蝌蚪时。丢掉讨饭棍，忘记叫街时。比喻人忘本.en: The frog forgets it was a tadpole. Throw away the begging stick, forget the days of begging. A metaphor for someone who forgets their roots.

成功之后就忘了过去贫穷的日子，真是青蛙忘了蝌蚪时。.en: After succeeding, he forgot his poor past — it's truly a case of the frog forgetting it was a tadpole.

看到那些自己过好了就否定过去的人，就会想起‘青蛙忘了蝌蚪时’这句话。.en: Seeing people who deny their past after doing well for themselves reminds me of the saying 'the frog forgets it was a tadpole.'

鹬蚌相争，渔翁得利.en: When the snipe and the clam fight, the fisherman catches both. (A Chinese idiom meaning two parties fighting benefits a third.)

在两大巨头的并购战中，合作企业如同鹬蚌相争中的渔翁得利中的小鱼小虾一样遭受了损失.en: In the merger war between the two giants, the partner companies suffered losses like the small fish and shrimp in the 'snipe and clam' fable.

随着政界冲突加剧，普通市民成了鹬蚌相争中的牺牲品。.en: As political conflicts intensify, ordinary citizens become the victims caught in the crossfire.

相信的斧头砍到脚背，比喻被自己最信任的人背叛。.en: The ax you trust cuts your foot — a metaphor for being betrayed by the person you trust most.

得知最信任的秘书挪用公司公款后，我觉得自己真是被最信任的人背叛了。.en: After finding out that my most trusted secretary embezzled company funds, I felt truly betrayed by the person I trusted most.

老朋友把我的秘密公开了，那种感觉就像被自己最信任的人捅了一刀。.en: An old friend made my secret public, and it felt like being stabbed in the back by the person I trusted most.

光阴似箭，转眼间我们也到了中年。.en: Time flies like an arrow — before we know it, we've reached middle age.

最近真切地感受到了什么叫光阴似箭。.en: Lately, I've truly felt what it means that time flies like an arrow.

初次相识仿佛就在昨天.en: It feels like our first meeting was just yesterday.

初次相识仿佛就在昨天，却已经是结婚十周年了。.en: It feels like our first meeting was just yesterday, yet it's already our tenth wedding anniversary.

和他初次相识仿佛就在昨天，现在却成了彼此人生中最重要的人。.en: It feels like our first meeting was just yesterday, but now we've become the most important people in each other's lives.

擦肩而过也是缘分.en: Even a brush past is fate.

都说擦肩而过也是缘分，我们这样重逢看来真是很深的缘分。.en: They say even a brush past is fate — our reunion like this must mean we have a very deep connection.

虽然时间很短，但从那位身上学到了很多。擦肩而过也是缘分这句话似乎没错。.en: Although it was a short time, I learned a lot from that person. It seems the saying 'even a brush past is fate' is true.

最近联系不上，看来应该认为没有消息就是好消息了。.en: I haven't been able to get in touch lately — I guess I should assume that no news is good news.

儿子在军队期间，真切体会到了没有消息就是好消息这句话。.en: While my son was in the military, I truly understood the saying 'no news is good news.'

不知道那个人的名字。.en: I don't know that person's name.

几点睡觉？.en: What time do you go to sleep?

几点起床？.en: What time do you get up?

请看一下这个。.en: Please take a look at this.

食物很多。.en: There is a lot of food.

需要去医院。.en: I need to go to the hospital.

知道好吃的餐厅吗？.en: Do you know a good restaurant?

在商店买。.en: I buy it at the store.

在市场买水果。.en: I buy fruit at the market.

在下一站下车。.en: Get off at the next stop.

来机场接人了。.en: I came to the airport to pick someone up.

到机场要多久？.en: How long does it take to get to the airport?

住在哪个城市？.en: Which city do you live in?

机票很贵。.en: The plane ticket is very expensive.

哥哥是大学生。.en: My older brother is a college student.

哥哥很帅。.en: My older brother is very handsome.

姐姐很漂亮。.en: My older sister is very pretty.

和姐姐一起购物了。.en: I went shopping with my older sister.

有弟弟/妹妹吗？.en: Do you have a younger sibling?

弟弟/妹妹很可爱。.en: My younger sibling is very cute.

请给我一杯咖啡。.en: Please give me a cup of coffee.

要喝绿茶吗？.en: Would you like some green tea?

需要几天？.en: How many days does it take?

3月去韩国。.en: I'm going to Korea in March.

请再来一次。.en: Please do it one more time.
