几点开始可以入住？.en: From what time can I check in?

退房时间可以晚一点吗？.en: Can I check out a little later?

多人间是六人房。.en: The dormitory is a six-person room.

有单人间吗？.en: Do you have a single room?

双人间有两张床。.en: The double room has two beds.

房间在几楼？.en: Which floor is the room on?

请上到二楼。.en: Please go up to the second floor.

可以用公用厨房。.en: You can use the shared kitchen.

可以在厨房做饭吗？.en: Can I cook in the kitchen?

厨房用到几点？.en: Until what time is the kitchen available?

卫生间在房间里吗？.en: Is the bathroom in the room?

淋浴间在走廊尽头。.en: The shower room is at the end of the hallway.

淋浴间没有热水。.en: There's no hot water in the shower room.

被子有点薄。.en: The blanket is a bit thin.

可以多要一床被子吗？.en: Can I have an extra blanket?

在玄关脱鞋。.en: Take off your shoes at the entrance.

请告诉我大门密码。.en: Please tell me the front door password.

请把钥匙放在这里再走。.en: Please leave the key here before you go.

请把暖气调高一点。.en: Please turn up the heating a bit.

空调遥控器在哪里？.en: Where is the air conditioner remote?

热水几点开始供应？.en: What time does the hot water start?

灯好像坏了。.en: The light seems to be broken.

修好要多久？.en: How long will the repair take?

想换到隔壁房间。.en: I'd like to change to the next room.

隔壁房间太吵了。.en: The next room is too noisy.

晚上外面很吵。.en: It's very noisy outside at night.

退房后可以寄存行李吗？.en: Can I store my luggage after checkout?

押金退房时退还。.en: The deposit is refunded at checkout.

取消预订能退款吗？.en: Can I get a refund if I cancel the reservation?

退款要几天？.en: How many days for a refund?

想取消预订。.en: I'd like to cancel the reservation.

可以再续住一天吗？.en: Can I extend my stay by one more day?

续住的话费用怎么算？.en: How is the fee calculated if I extend my stay?

您在这里住几天？.en: How many days are you staying here?

房东大叔很亲切。.en: The host uncle is very kind.

住处离车站很近。.en: The accommodation is very close to the station.

到住处怎么走？.en: How do I get to the accommodation?

不知道这里是哪里。.en: I don't know where this is.

不知道手机在哪儿弄丢了。.en: I don't know where I lost my phone.

得补办护照。.en: I need to reissue my passport.

钱包里的卡都在里面。.en: All the cards in my wallet are still inside.

手机落在出租车上了。.en: I left my phone in the taxi.

请帮我叫警察。.en: Please call the police for me.

最近的警察局在哪里？.en: Where is the nearest police station?

在警察局报了案。.en: I reported it at the police station.

想报失窃案。.en: I want to report a theft.

好像在地铁上被偷了。.en: It seems like it was stolen on the subway.

护照可以补办吗？.en: Can I get a passport reissued?

补办要几天？.en: How many days does the reissue take?

办了银行卡挂失。.en: I reported my bank card as lost.

请填写遗失申报单。.en: Please fill out the loss report form.

去失物招领处看过了吗？.en: Have you checked the lost and found office?

请咨询地铁失物招领处。.en: Please ask at the subway lost and found.

疼、难受、不舒服.en: to hurt, to be painful, to feel unwell

请带我去医院。.en: Please take me to the hospital.

好像得去急诊室。.en: I think I need to go to the emergency room.

急诊室24小时开吗？.en: Is the emergency room open 24 hours?

请帮我叫救护车。.en: Please call an ambulance for me.

打119叫了救护车。.en: I called 119 and got an ambulance.

出交通事故了。.en: I got into a traffic accident.

晚上这条路很危险。.en: This road is dangerous at night.

得联系家人。.en: I need to contact my family.

请帮我联系大使馆。.en: Please help me contact the embassy.

能帮我叫翻译吗？.en: Can you call an interpreter for me?

拿到了遗失证明。.en: I got the lost document certificate.

有证明才能补办。.en: You need the certificate to reissue it.

没有身份证件怎么办？.en: What if I don't have an ID?

请告诉我住处的地址。.en: Please tell me the address of your residence.

附近有警察局吗？.en: Is there a police station nearby?

这附近我不太熟。.en: I'm not very familiar with this area.

最近的地铁站在哪里？.en: Where is the nearest subway station?

请带我到地铁站。.en: Please take me to the subway station.

指路、告诉路怎么走.en: give directions, tell how to get somewhere

请告诉我去这里的路。.en: Please tell me the way to get here.

请送我到医院。.en: Please take me to the hospital.

能送我到车站吗？.en: Can you take me to the station?

大使馆的电话号码是多少？.en: What is the embassy's phone number?

没关系、没事、还好.en: It's okay, no problem, it's fine

您没事吧？受伤了吗？.en: Are you okay? Are you hurt?

韩语说得不好、不太会韩语.en: not good at Korean, don't know Korean well

我韩语说得不太好。.en: I'm not very good at Korean.

我韩语不好，请说慢一点。.en: I'm not good at Korean, so please speak slowly.

我有外国人登录证。.en: I have a foreigner registration card.

我邀请了朋友们来生日派对。.en: I invited my friends to the birthday party.

想邀请你来我的乔迁宴。.en: I'd like to invite you to my housewarming party.

好久不见，很高兴见到你。.en: Long time no see, nice to meet you.

定约、敲定见面（安排具体时间地点）.en: making plans, setting up a meeting (arranging specific time and place)

我们这周约一下吧？.en: Shall we meet up this week?

有空、时间方便.en: to have free time, to be available

明天下午有时间吗？.en: Do you have time tomorrow afternoon?

现在没时间。.en: I don't have time right now.

哪天一起吃个饭吧。.en: Let's have a meal together sometime.

这个周末有点忙。.en: I'm a bit busy this weekend.

工作日因为上班很忙。.en: I'm busy on weekdays because of work.

晚上一起吃饭吗？.en: Shall we have dinner together in the evening?

今天晚饭我请。.en: I'll treat you to dinner today.

喝一杯（约酒的委婉说法）.en: Have a drink (euphemism for inviting someone for a drink)

今天下班后喝一杯吗？.en: How about a drink after work today?

好久没喝了，喝一杯吧。.en: It's been a while since we had a drink. Let's have one.

找机会吃个饭（约人见面的常用铺垫，不一定真定日子）.en: Let's grab a meal sometime (common lead-in to suggest meeting, not necessarily setting a date)

我们哪天吃个饭吧。.en: Let's have a meal together sometime.

改天一起吃个饭。.en: Let's have a meal together another day.

协调时间、对时间（凑出双方都行的时段）.en: Coordinate schedules, find a common time (to fit a time that works for both)

互相凑个时间见面吧。.en: Let's find a time that works for both of us and meet.

对时间有点难啊。.en: It's a bit hard to coordinate the time.

约会推到下周可以吗？.en: Can we push the date to next week?

不能老是往后拖。.en: You can't keep putting it off.

会议延后了一天。.en: The meeting was postponed by a day.

有点情况，想把约会改期。.en: Something came up, I want to reschedule the date.

不好意思，今天的约可能得取消。.en: Sorry, I might have to cancel today's appointment.

被放鸽子（对方没来，自己白等）.en: Being stood up (the other person didn't show, you waited for nothing)

昨天相亲被放鸽子了。.en: I got stood up at the blind date yesterday.

等了一小时，还以为被放鸽子了。.en: I waited for an hour, thought I got stood up.

放某人鸽子（让对方白等）.en: Standing someone up (making them wait for nothing)

放了朋友鸽子，很抱歉。.en: I stood up my friend, I'm really sorry.

我不是故意放你鸽子的。.en: I didn't mean to stand you up.

堵车了，可能会晚一点。.en: There's a traffic jam, I might be a little late.

迟到（多用于上班上学等正式场合）.en: Being late (often used for formal occasions like work or school)

今天睡过头迟到了。.en: I overslept and was late today.

早点出门别迟到。.en: Leave early so you won't be late.

约的是几点来着？.en: What time was the appointment again?

正好卡着约定时间到了。.en: I arrived right at the appointed time.

定、决定（时间、地点等）.en: to set, to decide (time, place, etc.)

菜还没定。.en: The food hasn't been decided yet.

下次（婉拒或改约常用）.en: next time (commonly used to politely decline or reschedule)

今天不太方便，下次见吧。.en: Today isn't convenient, let's meet next time.

下次一定一起去。.en: Let's definitely go together next time.

以后、回头（时间上稍后）.en: later, afterwards (a bit later in time)

回头再联系你。.en: I'll get back to you later.

突然（临时改约、有事时常用）.en: Suddenly (commonly used when rescheduling or something comes up)

突然有事，可能去不了了。.en: Something suddenly came up, I might not be able to go.

怎么这么突然就取消了？.en: Why was it canceled so suddenly?

有事、出了状况（改约最常用的理由）.en: Something came up, a situation (the most common reason for rescheduling)

因为突然有急事。.en: Because something urgent suddenly came up.

家里有事，出不了门。.en: Something came up at home, I can't go out.

有急事，我先走了。.en: I have an urgent matter, I'll go first.

不是急事的话待会儿再说。.en: If it's not urgent, let's talk about it later.

我确认一下行程再告诉你。.en: I'll check my schedule and let you know.

空、空出来（指时间有空档）.en: Free, open (referring to having free time)

周末完全没安排。.en: I have no plans at all this weekend.

……怎么样？（敬语征求意见，提议时间地点常用）.en: How about...? (polite way to ask for opinions, commonly used for suggesting times or places)

我在咖啡厅等你。.en: I'll wait for you at the café.

我去地铁站接你。.en: I'll pick you up at the subway station.

几点去接你好？.en: What time should I pick you up?

这周有同学聚会。.en: There's a class reunion this week.

聚会一定要来哦。.en: You must come to the gathering.

公司聚餐（韩国职场文化里下班后的集体吃喝）.en: company dinner (after-work group eating and drinking in Korean workplace culture)

聚餐一般几点结束？.en: What time does the company dinner usually end?

玩、一起玩耍（朋友间约出去玩）.en: play, hang out (used among friends to suggest going out)

好久没聚了，出来玩吧。.en: We haven't met in a while, let's go out and have fun.

下周时间可以吗？.en: Is next week okay for you?

那就推到下周吧。.en: Then let's push it to next week.

待会儿、过一会儿（当天稍后）.en: later, in a bit (later the same day)

这次一定守约。.en: I'll definitely keep my promise this time.

我喜欢守约的人。.en: I like people who keep their promises.

先约、已经有约在先（婉拒时的高级理由）.en: prior appointment, already have a prior engagement (a high-level excuse when declining)

那天已经有约了。.en: I already have plans that day.

抱歉，已经有约在先，去不了。.en: Sorry, I already have a prior engagement, so I can't go.

一会儿、片刻（约“见一下”时常用）.en: a moment, a little while (often used when suggesting a quick meet-up)

就见一面就走。.en: I'll just see you for a moment and then leave.

待会儿有一小会儿时间吗？.en: Do you have a little time in a bit?

谢谢、感谢（固有词，语感更亲切）.en: thanks, gratitude (native Korean word, feels warmer)

感谢（汉字词，比 고맙다 更郑重）.en: thanks (Sino-Korean word, more formal than 고맙다)

谢谢（最标准的正式道谢，对长辈、店员、陌生人都能用）.en: thank you (the most standard formal thanks, can be used with elders, staff, strangers)

谢谢（해요体，对平辈、熟人温和又礼貌）.en: thanks (해요체, polite and friendly to peers and acquaintances)

谢谢你照顾我。.en: Thank you for taking care of me.

谢啦（半语，对亲近的朋友、晚辈）.en: Thanks (casual, to close friends or juniors)

致谢、深表感谢（谦语，最郑重的道谢）.en: Express gratitude, deep thanks (humble, most formal way to say thank you)

感谢大家的关注。.en: Thank you all for your attention.

借此机会向您致谢。.en: I'd like to take this opportunity to thank you.

多亏了、托……的福（把功劳归给对方，很地道的感谢表达）.en: Thanks to…, thanks to (giving credit to someone, a very natural way to express gratitude)

多亏了你才顺利结束。.en: Thanks to you, it ended well.

多亏老师我才考上了。.en: Thanks to the teacher, I passed the exam.

承蒙关照、欠人情.en: I'm indebted to you, I owe you one.

这次多承蒙您关照了。.en: Thank you for your help this time.

总是麻烦您，很不好意思。.en: I'm sorry for always troubling you.

抱歉、对不起（比 죄송하다 轻，对平辈、熟人）.en: Sorry, I'm sorry (lighter than 죄송하다, used with peers or acquaintances)

抱歉、非常抱歉（比 미안하다 郑重，对长辈、上司、客人）.en: Sorry, I'm very sorry (more formal than 미안하다, used with elders, superiors, guests)

对不起（最标准的正式道歉，职场、服务业万能）.en: I'm sorry (the most standard formal apology, used in workplaces and service industries)

都是我的错，对不起。.en: It's all my fault, I'm sorry.

道歉、赔礼（正式表达“道歉”这一行为）.en: Apologize, make an apology (formal expression of the act of apologizing)

道歉（此处指赔礼，与“苹果”同形异义）.en: Apology (here meaning an apology, homonym with 'apple')

故意地（辩解“不是故意的”时常用）.en: on purpose (often used when denying intent)

没关系、不要紧（回应道歉/道谢的万能词）.en: it's okay, no problem (all-purpose response to apologies/thanks)

没关系，别在意。.en: It's okay, don't worry about it.

不客气、哪里的话（回应感谢，略书面）.en: you're welcome, not at all (responding to thanks, slightly formal)

不客气，这是应该的。.en: You're welcome, it's the least I could do.

不客气，能帮上忙就好。.en: You're welcome, glad I could help.

哪里的话、您太客气了（谦逊地回应感谢或称赞）.en: Not at all, you're too kind (humble response to thanks or praise)

哪里的话，该我谢您才对。.en: Not at all, I should be thanking you.

您太客气了，请随意。.en: You're too kind, please make yourself at home.

不是啦、不用（口语里回应感谢，最自然常用）.en: No, it's nothing / Don't mention it (casual response to thanks, most natural and common)

不用啦，该我谢你才对。.en: No need, I should be thanking you.

给、呈上（주다 的谦语，对长辈递东西）.en: to give, to present (humble form of 주다, used when handing something to an elder)

这个作为礼物送给您。.en: I give this to you as a gift.

照顾、张罗、（特意）准备好.en: to take care of, to prepare (specially)

谢谢您一直照顾我。.en: Thank you for always taking care of me.

心意（送礼收礼时说“这是我的心意”）.en: one's feelings / sincerity (said when giving or receiving a gift: 'It's just a small token of my appreciation')

虽然不贵，是我的一点心意。.en: It's not expensive, just a small token of my appreciation.

费心、在意（“您太费心了/别在意”）.en: to go to trouble / to be concerned ('You're too kind / Don't worry about it')

谢谢您这么费心。.en: Thank you for going to so much trouble.

您不用费心。.en: You don't need to go to any trouble.

因为我，让您费心了吧。.en: I must have caused you trouble because of me.

报答、回报.en: to repay, to return a favor

这份恩情我一定报答。.en: I will definitely repay this kindness.

下次一定回报你。.en: I'll return the favor next time.

请客（为了道谢或庆祝而请对方吃喝）.en: treat (someone to a meal/drink) (to thank or celebrate)

为了谢你，今天我请客。.en: To thank you, I'll treat you today.

找到工作了，得请客啊。.en: You got a job, so you have to treat us.

难得地、多亏（叙述时带感激语气）.en: thankfully / fortunately (with a grateful tone when narrating)

真心地、由衷地（加重感谢或道歉的诚意）.en: sincerely / from the bottom of one's heart (to emphasize gratitude or apology)

福气、多亏（常与에一起用，把好结果归功于对方）.en: blessing / thanks to (often used with 에, attributing a good result to someone)

这全靠各位。.en: This is all thanks to everyone.

那全是多亏了你。.en: That was all thanks to you.

添麻烦、打扰（郑重致歉时说“给您添麻烦了”）.en: to cause trouble / to bother (said politely when apologizing, e.g., 'Sorry for the trouble')

不想再打扰您了。.en: I don't want to bother you anymore.

反省、检讨（深刻道歉时表态）.en: reflection / self-examination (said when making a sincere apology)

是我错了，我在反省。.en: It was my fault. I'm reflecting on it.

做错、犯错.en: to make a mistake, to do wrong

我不知道自己错在哪。.en: I don't know what I did wrong.

低头（鞠躬致歉或致谢的肢体动作）.en: bowing (a physical gesture of apology or thanks)

我低头行礼道谢。.en: I bowed and expressed my thanks.

受宠若惊、不知如何是好（收到过分的好意或称赞时的谦辞）.en: overwhelmed, at a loss (a humble expression when receiving excessive kindness or praise)

您这么照顾我，真让我受宠若惊。.en: You're taking such good care of me, I'm truly overwhelmed.

过奖了，真让我不知如何是好。.en: You flatter me, I really don't know what to say.

虽然像是辩解，但确实有原因。.en: It sounds like an excuse, but there is a reason.

今后、以后（道歉后表态“今后会注意”）.en: From now on, in the future (used after apologizing to say 'I'll be careful from now on')

今后我会小心的。.en: I'll be careful from now on.

道谢、致谢的问候.en: Expression of thanks, greeting of gratitude

我想先向您道谢。.en: I'd like to thank you first.

我是来道谢的。.en: I came to say thank you.

感谢您施予的恩惠。.en: Thank you for the favor you've shown me.

拒绝的时候有点不好意思。.en: I felt a bit embarrassed when I declined.

我是不太会拒绝人的性格。.en: I have a personality that finds it hard to say no.

为难、不方便（委婉表示做不到的经典词）.en: inconvenient, difficult (a classic word for politely saying you can't do something)

难、困难（委婉说“恐怕不行”时用“좀 어려울 것 같아요”）.en: difficult, hard (used politely to say 'I'm afraid it won't work' with '좀 어려울 것 같아요')

这次恐怕有点难。.en: I'm afraid it's a bit difficult this time.

忙（婉拒最常见的理由）.en: busy (the most common reason for politely declining)

最近有点忙。.en: I've been a bit busy lately.

那天工作忙，恐怕不行。.en: I'm busy with work that day, so I'm afraid I can't.

得找个合适的借口。.en: I need to come up with a good excuse.

找借口、拿……当托辞.en: make an excuse, use… as a pretext

别老是找借口。.en: Stop making excuses all the time.

借口说累就没去。.en: I didn't go, using tiredness as an excuse.

心意我领了，就不收了。.en: I appreciate the thought, but I'll pass.

不用了、够了（婉拒好意，语气随场合，稍不注意会显冷）.en: no thanks, that's enough (politely refuse, tone depends on context, can sound cold if not careful)

不用了、没关系（婉拒时的高频“软拒绝”，比 됐어요 更客气）.en: no thanks, it's fine (a common soft refusal, more polite than 됐어요)

我没关系，别费心了。.en: I'm fine, don't go to the trouble.

可惜、遗憾（拒绝时先说“真可惜”来缓冲）.en: too bad, a pity (used to soften a refusal by saying 'what a shame' first)

很可惜，这次可能去不了。.en: Too bad, I probably can't go this time.

真的很可惜，下次吧。.en: It's really a pity. Next time.

下次机会（婉拒的经典收尾“다음 기회에요”）.en: Next time (classic polite refusal ending: "Next time")

这次先留到下次吧。.en: Let's save this for next time.

有约在先（婉拒最体面的理由，对方无法追问）.en: Prior commitment (the most polite refusal reason, the other person can't press further)

那天有约在先。.en: I have a prior commitment that day.

身体状态（“컨디션이 안 좋다”是委婉推掉约的常用理由）.en: Physical condition ("I'm not feeling well" is a common polite excuse to decline plans)

今天身体状态不太好。.en: I'm not feeling too well today.

状态不好，得休息一下。.en: I'm not in good shape, I need to rest.

今天太累了，我要休息。.en: I'm too tired today, I need to rest.

太累了，得早点回去。.en: I'm too tired, I need to head back early.

勉强、超出能力（“무리예요”＝做不到、太勉强了）.en: Too much, beyond one's ability ("It's too much" = can't do it, it's too demanding)

今天之内恐怕做不到。.en: I'm afraid I can't do it by today.

负担、压力（婉拒好意时“부담스러워요”很常用）.en: burden, pressure (commonly used when politely declining kindness, as in '부담스러워요')

您这么客气我会有负担的。.en: I'd feel burdened if you're so kind.

感到有负担、觉得为难（好意过重时的委婉回绝）.en: to feel burdened, to find it difficult (a polite refusal when kindness is too much)

太贵重的礼物我会有负担。.en: I'd feel burdened by such an expensive gift.

让我收下有点为难。.en: It's a bit difficult for me to accept it.

我再想想（软性婉拒，往往意味着倾向于不做）.en: I'll think about it (soft refusal, often implying a tendency to decline)

我再考虑一下，回头联系您。.en: I'll think it over and get back to you.

下次见吧（婉拒当下邀约、留有余地的常用语）.en: See you next time (common phrase to politely decline an invitation while leaving room for later)

今天不行，下次见吧。.en: Not today, see you next time.

下次见，我一定联系你。.en: See you next time, I'll definitely contact you.

不太、不怎么（委婉表达不喜欢、不想去）.en: not really, not so much (polite way to express dislike or reluctance to go)

我不太想去啊。.en: I don't really want to go.

那里我不太想去。.en: I don't really want to go there.

有心情、乐意（多用否定“안 내켜요”＝不太想）.en: to be in the mood, to feel like (often used in negative '안 내켜요' = don't really feel like it)

今天不太想。.en: I don't really feel like it today.

不想去的话不去也行。.en: If you don't want to go, you don't have to.

眼力见儿、察言观色（韩国社交核心概念，拒绝时靠察觉气氛）.en: reading the room, social awareness (core Korean social concept; used when refusing by sensing the atmosphere)

我看气氛悄悄避开了。.en: I read the atmosphere and quietly stepped away.

他很会看眼色，会先察觉。.en: He's good at reading the room and notices things early.

拒绝、抵制（比 거절 更强硬、正式，多用于制度性场合）.en: to reject, to refuse (stronger and more formal than 거절, often used in institutional contexts)

有权拒绝这个要求。.en: You have the right to refuse this request.

讨厌、不愿意（直接拒绝，语气强，慎用于长辈）.en: to dislike, to be unwilling (direct refusal, strong tone, use cautiously with elders)

那个我不太愿意。.en: I'm not really up for that.

我不喜欢勉强去做。.en: I don't like doing things reluctantly.

请求、拜托（拒绝的对象常是对方的 부탁）.en: request, favor (the thing being refused is often the other person's 부탁)

能帮我一个忙吗？.en: Could you do me a favor?

这个忙恐怕帮不了。.en: I'm afraid I can't help with that favor.

这次的请求恐怕答应不了。.en: I'm afraid I can't accept this request.

我也想答应，但条件不允许。.en: I'd like to say yes, but the circumstances don't allow it.

缘由、情况（“사정이 있어서”是不便明说时的挡箭牌）.en: reason, circumstance (used as a vague excuse when you can't explain clearly)

有些原因去不了。.en: I can't go for some reasons.

不好意思、抱歉（拒绝开头的缓冲垫，几乎必备）.en: sorry, excuse me (a polite buffer at the start of a refusal, almost essential)

不好意思，今天恐怕不行。.en: Sorry, I'm afraid today won't work.

抱歉，那个我帮不了您。.en: Sorry, I can't help you with that.

不好意思（拒绝平辈、熟人时的缓冲开头）.en: sorry (a casual buffer when refusing a peer or acquaintance)

抱歉，这次帮不了你。.en: Sorry, I can't help you this time.

这可怎么办呢（面露难色的婉拒语气词）.en: What should I do? (a polite refusal tone showing hesitation)

这可怎么办，那天好像不行。.en: What should I do? That day doesn't seem possible.

啊，怎么办，我已经有约了。.en: Oh, what should I do? I already have plans.

谅解、体谅（正式拒绝后请求对方谅解）.en: Understanding, consideration (asking for understanding after a formal refusal)

感谢您的宽容谅解。.en: Thank you for your understanding and consideration.

保持距离（婉拒进一步来往的行为表达）.en: Keeping distance (a behavioral expression of politely refusing further interaction)

我想保持一点距离。.en: I'd like to keep some distance.

最近我倾向于保持距离。.en: Lately, I tend to keep my distance.

略过、揭过（把话题岔开以回避）.en: Skip, gloss over (changing the subject to avoid something)

那事就翻篇儿吧。.en: Let's just move on from that.

不会拒绝人的性格（韩国人常自嘲的社交困扰）.en: A personality that can't say no (a social struggle Koreans often joke about)

我就是不会拒绝人的性格。.en: I'm just the type who can't say no.

因为不会拒绝，总是吃亏。.en: Because I can't say no, I always end up losing out.

心情受伤、不高兴（拒绝时最怕让对方 기분 상하다）.en: To feel hurt, to be upset (the biggest fear when refusing is making the other person feel this way)

我说得很小心，怕伤到他。.en: I spoke very carefully, afraid of hurting him.

谨慎、小心翼翼（说难以启齿的拒绝前铺垫）.en: To be cautious, to be careful (used as a lead-in before saying something difficult to refuse)

虽然难以启齿，但我还是拒绝。.en: It's hard to say, but I have to refuse.

这话说出来有点为难。.en: It's a bit awkward to say this.

推脱、扭捏推辞（口语里“몸을 빼다”式的躲避）.en: To make excuses, to shy away (in spoken language, like '몸을 빼다' — dodging)

怕显得矫情，就去了。.en: Afraid of seeming pretentious, I went.

拒绝的意向（正式场合表达“拒绝的意思”）.en: Intention to refuse (expressing 'the meaning of refusal' in formal situations)

我委婉地表明了拒绝的意向。.en: I politely indicated my intention to refuse.

为难、难堪（比 곤란하다 更强调进退两难）.en: To be in a difficult position, to be embarrassed (stronger than 곤란하다, emphasizing being caught between a rock and a hard place)

您突然这么问，我有点为难。.en: You suddenly ask like that, and I'm a bit embarrassed.

被拒绝也没关系。.en: It's okay even if I get rejected.

果断、坚决（该硬起来拒绝时的态度）.en: Decisive, firm (the attitude to have when you need to be tough and say no)

给人压力、让人为难（拒绝时避免“부담 주는” 说法）.en: Putting pressure on someone, making it awkward (avoid saying '부담 주는' when refusing)

我不是想给你压力。.en: I don't mean to put pressure on you.

怕给你添压力，就没说。.en: I didn't say it because I was afraid it would put pressure on you.

最近这档综艺真好看。.en: This variety show is really good lately.

周末刷了一堆综艺。.en: I binge-watched a bunch of variety shows over the weekend.

字幕（综艺里花字，制作组的吐槽神器）.en: Subtitles (the playful text in variety shows, the production team's trolling tool)

这节目的字幕真的搞笑。.en: The subtitles on this show are really funny.

字幕的梗玩得太绝了。.en: The subtitle jokes are so on point.

超有趣、贼好玩（꿀＝蜂蜜＋재미，网络缩语）.en: Super fun, super entertaining (꿀 = honey + 재미, internet slang)

超好看，一定要看。.en: It's super good, you have to watch it.

本来挺期待，结果超无聊。.en: I was looking forward to it, but it turned out super boring.

这一期有点无聊啊。.en: This episode is a bit boring.

抖包袱、玩梗（来自 ad-lib，指临场搞笑的话）.en: Drop a punchline, crack a joke (from ad-lib, referring to improvised funny lines)

抖包袱、开玩笑（临场说搞笑的话）.en: Drop a punchline, joke around (say something funny on the spot)

正经着呢，别开玩笑。.en: I'm being serious, stop joking around.

传说级、名场面（legend，指经典到载入史册的片段）.en: Legendary, iconic scene (legend, referring to a classic moment that goes down in history)

这一幕是名场面。.en: This scene is an iconic moment.

经典的那期看多少遍都好笑。.en: That classic episode is funny no matter how many times you watch it.

截图、表情包图（网络上流传的搞笑图片）.en: Screenshot, meme (funny images that spread online)

这张图哪来的？.en: Where did this picture come from?

做成表情包肯定火。.en: If you make it into a meme, it'll definitely go viral.

动图（움직이는 짤，会动的表情图）.en: animated GIF (움직이는 짤, moving meme image)

看动图更好笑。.en: It's funnier when you watch the animated GIF.

整段被剪掉（통＝整个＋편집，戏份全没了）.en: whole segment cut out (통 = whole + 편집, all the screen time is gone)

戏份被整段剪掉了，好可惜。.en: The whole scene got cut out, such a shame.

戏份、镜头量（综艺里出镜时长）.en: screen time, camera time (how much you appear in a variety show)

这期戏份给得挺多。.en: They gave a lot of screen time this episode.

为了多点镜头拼命表现呢。.en: They're trying hard to get more camera time.

反应（reaction，综艺里夸张的即时反应）.en: reaction (reaction, exaggerated instant reactions in variety shows)

反应真的很浮夸。.en: The reaction is really over the top.

突然冷场（갑자기 분위기 싸해짐 的缩语）.en: sudden awkward silence (short for 갑자기 분위기 싸해짐)

那话一出口就冷场了。.en: As soon as that was said, it got awkward.

很会把气氛搞冷。.en: Really good at killing the mood.

大家默认的惯例、约定俗成（국민 룰 的缩语）.en: Commonly accepted rule, convention (short for 국민 룰)

炸鸡配可乐是标配啊。.en: Fried chicken with cola is the standard combo.

这基本是公认的惯例了。.en: This is basically a widely accepted rule.

认同、同意（弹幕里刷“ㅇㅈ”表示赞同）.en: Agree, approval (spam 'ㅇㅈ' in comments to show agreement)

带劲、绝了（强调程度很高，弹幕高频）.en: Awesome, insane (emphasizes high degree, frequent in comments)

实力太顶了。.en: The skill level is too top-tier.

最近常看这个主播的直播。.en: I've been watching this streamer's live streams a lot lately.

这主播游戏打得真好。.en: This streamer is really good at the game.

看直播才有意思。.en: It's only fun to watch the live stream.

实时聊天刷得飞快。.en: The real-time chat is scrolling super fast.

喜欢实时互动的感觉。.en: I like the feeling of real-time interaction.

聊天框、弹幕框（直播里观众打字的地方）.en: Chat box, comment box (where viewers type during a live stream)

弹幕框都刷疯了。.en: The comment box is going crazy.

弹幕刷慢一点吧。.en: Slow down the comments a bit.

观众、看直播的人.en: Viewer, person watching the live stream

观众超过一万了。.en: The number of viewers has exceeded ten thousand.

打赏（donation 的缩略，配文字念出的付费留言）.en: Donation (short for donation, a paid message read aloud)

打赏留言会被念出来。.en: Donation messages will be read out loud.

星星气球（아프리카TV 的打赏道具，简称별풍）.en: Star balloon (a donation item on AfreecaTV, abbreviated as 별풍)

谢谢您刷的星星气球。.en: Thank you for the star balloons you sent.

星星气球数量太夸张了。.en: The number of star balloons is insane.

记得订阅还有开启通知哦。.en: Remember to subscribe and turn on notifications.

订阅数涨得很快。.en: The subscriber count is growing fast.

各位订阅者大家好。.en: Hello, everyone, to all our subscribers.

喜欢视频的话请点赞。.en: If you like the video, please hit like.

开启通知（订阅铃铛，上新片时提醒）.en: Turn on notifications (subscription bell, alerts for new uploads)

一定要开启通知哦。.en: Make sure to turn on notifications.

开了通知就不会错过直播。.en: If you turn on notifications, you won't miss the live stream.

最近在 CHZZK 上直播。.en: I'm streaming on CHZZK these days.

很多主播转到 CHZZK 了。.en: A lot of streamers have moved to CHZZK.

我把视频传到 YouTube 了。.en: I uploaded the video to YouTube.

在 YouTube 直播上看吧。.en: Watch it on the YouTube live stream.

守着看首播（本방＝首播＋사수＝死守，不看重播）.en: Catch the premiere live (본방 = premiere + 사수 = hold on tight, meaning not watching the rerun)

今天首播我要守着看。.en: I'm going to catch the premiere live today.

打卡守首播！.en: Check in and catch the premiere live!

入坑、开始追（这里指因某综艺片段而喜欢上）.en: Get hooked, start following (here, it means liking something because of a variety show clip)

看了这个视频就入坑了。.en: I got hooked after watching this video.

求推荐入坑视频。.en: Please recommend a video to get hooked on.

黑历史（不愿被翻出来的过去糗事）.en: Cringey past (embarrassing moments from the past that you don't want brought up)

以前的视频都是黑历史。.en: All my old videos are cringey.

别翻我黑历史。.en: Don't dig up my cringey past.

多亏剪辑，更好笑了。.en: Thanks to the editing, it's funnier.

字幕匠人（花字玩得神的制作组）.en: subtitle artisan (production team skilled with fancy captions)

这节目的字幕像匠人手笔。.en: This show's subtitles are like an artisan's work.

字幕匠人的功力很出彩。.en: The subtitle artisan's skill really stands out.

这会成为名场面的。.en: This will become an iconic scene.

这是名场面合集视频。.en: This is a compilation video of iconic scenes.

听说那句台词是即兴的。.en: I heard that line was ad-libbed.

那段即兴简直神来一笔。.en: That ad-lib was a stroke of genius.

主持人控场很好。.en: The host controls the stage well.

主持人一抖包袱大家都笑喷了。.en: Everyone burst out laughing when the host delivered the punchline.

笑喷、笑炸（突然被逗得大笑）.en: burst out laughing, crack up (suddenly laugh hard)

看到那一幕就笑喷了。.en: I burst out laughing when I saw that scene.

被剪掉（口语，정확히는 잘리다，指镜头被剪）.en: cut out (colloquial, exactly 잘리다, referring to footage being cut)

有意思的部分全被剪了。.en: All the interesting parts got cut out.

带节奏、博眼球（aggro，故意挑事引关注）.en: stir the pot, bait (aggro, deliberately provoke to get attention)

固定成员（综艺里每期都在的常驻）.en: regular cast member (permanent member in a variety show)

固定成员换人了。.en: The regular cast member was replaced.

常驻成员的默契很好。.en: The regular cast members have great chemistry.

没看的话看重播吧。.en: If you didn't watch it, watch the replay.

终于要去看演唱会了！.en: Finally going to see the concert!

抢票（ticketing，开票瞬间的抢购大战）.en: ticketing (the rush to buy tickets the moment they go on sale)

明天抢票一定要成功啊。.en: I hope I succeed in getting tickets tomorrow.

地狱级抢票（피 튀기는 티켓팅＝见血的抢票，秒空）.en: hell-level ticketing (bloody ticketing, sold out in seconds)

这次演出简直是地狱抢票。.en: This show is absolute hell-level ticketing.

杀出重围终于抢到了。.en: I fought through the crowd and finally got them.

优先预售（팬클럽 会员先买的场次）.en: Priority pre-sale (fan club members buy first)

用粉丝会优先购抢到了。.en: I managed to get tickets using the fan club priority purchase.

优先购比普通订票早一天。.en: Priority purchase is one day earlier than regular ticket sales.

捡漏抢退票（취소표 티켓팅，蹲别人退的票）.en: Snatching up canceled tickets (waiting for others to return tickets)

靠捡退票好不容易搞到一个位子。.en: I barely got a seat by snatching up a canceled ticket.

演出前一天蹲蹲退票吧。.en: Try waiting for canceled tickets the day before the show.

座位离舞台很近。.en: The seat is very close to the stage.

我的座位号是几号来着？.en: What was my seat number again?

站席按号码顺序入场。.en: The standing section enters in order of number.

抢到了站席前排区。.en: I got a spot in the front of the standing section.

我是对号座，比较轻松。.en: I have a reserved seat, so it's more relaxing.

指定座位不会被抢。.en: Reserved seats won't be taken by others.

视线受限座位（被设备遮挡、看不全舞台的便宜票）.en: Obstructed view seat (cheaper ticket with blocked view due to equipment)

是视线受限座，有点被挡。.en: It's a restricted view seat, a bit blocked.

前排位子脸都看得清清楚楚。.en: From the front row, you can see faces clearly.

这次抽到前排了。.en: I got front row this time.

应援棒、灯棒（每个团专属的官方手灯）.en: Light stick, fan light (official light stick unique to each group)

应援棒带了吗？.en: Did you bring your light stick?

应援棒会随歌变颜色。.en: The light stick changes color with the song.

应援横幅、口号布条（举着或挂脖上的应援物）.en: Cheering banner, slogan banner (held up or hung around the neck as fan support)

入口处发了应援横幅。.en: They handed out cheering banners at the entrance.

举着横幅应援。.en: Cheering with a banner held up.

应援口号、应援方式（每首歌该喊的固定词和节奏）.en: Fan chant, cheering method (fixed words and rhythm to shout for each song)

提前把应援口号背好了。.en: I memorized the fan chant in advance.

看着应援教学视频练习了。.en: I practiced by watching the fan chant tutorial video.

全场大合唱（观众齐声跟唱，韩国演唱会名场面）.en: Full audience sing-along (audience singing together, iconic scene at Korean concerts)

全场合唱听得我起鸡皮疙瘩。.en: The whole audience singing along gave me goosebumps.

这首歌全场合唱是惯例。.en: It's customary for the whole audience to sing along to this song.

一登台欢呼声就炸了。.en: The cheers exploded as soon as I stepped on stage.

安可、返场（encore，喊着让偶像再唱一首）.en: Encore (shouting for the idol to sing one more song)

喊安可他们又出来了。.en: When we shouted encore, they came back out.

安可舞台是我最喜欢的。.en: The encore stage is my favorite.

偶像下班路（演出结束偶像离场时粉丝在门口相送的场面）.en: Idol's exit route (fans waiting at the door to see them off after the show)

下班路上他向我们挥手了。.en: He waved to us on his way out.

为了看下班路一直等到最后。.en: I waited until the very end to see the exit route.

入场时会核对身份证。.en: They check your ID when you enter.

入场顺序（站席按抽到的号码排队进场）.en: Entry order (standing section enters by number drawn)

入场顺序靠前，站到前面了。.en: My entry number was early, so I got to stand in front.

入场顺序按号码牌决定。.en: The order of entry is determined by the number tag.

为了买周边早早就去了。.en: I went early to buy merchandise.

买周边的队排得超长。.en: The line to buy merchandise was super long.

演唱会周边（MD＝merchandise，现场卖的官方商品）.en: Concert merchandise (MD = merchandise, official items sold on-site)

这周边只在现场卖。.en: This merchandise is only sold on-site.

小卡（photo card，简称포카，随机附赠的偶像卡片）.en: Photo card (also called 포카, a random idol card included as a bonus)

小卡抽到本命了！.en: I got my bias in the photo card!

有人要换小卡吗？.en: Anyone want to trade photo cards?

小卡（포토카드 的缩语，粉丝口语最常用）.en: Photo card (short for 포토카드, most common in fan slang)

集小卡挺有乐趣的。.en: Collecting photo cards is quite fun.

重复的小卡我出。.en: I'm selling my duplicate photo cards.

转让（把多余的票或周边原价让给别人）.en: Transfer (selling extra tickets or merchandise at face value to someone else)

溢价、加价（프리미엄 的缩语，黄牛加价转卖，粉圈很反感）.en: Premium, markup (abbreviation of 프리미엄, referring to scalpers reselling at a higher price, which fans strongly dislike)

加价转让恕不接受。.en: I will not accept a transfer at a marked-up price.

真讨厌加价倒卖的人。.en: I really hate people who resell at a markup.

线下活动（오프라인 的缩语，指到现场的追星活动）.en: Offline event (abbreviation of 오프라인, referring to in-person fan events)

这次线下活动一起去吗？.en: Want to go to this offline event together?

跑线下活动的粉丝很多。.en: There are a lot of fans who go to offline events.

全场演唱会都去（all concert，每一场都不落）.en: Going to all concerts of the tour (all concert, attending every single one)

这次巡演我全场都去了。.en: I went to all the shows on this tour.

为了场场都去连假都请了。.en: I even took time off work to go to every single show.

最后一场（마지막 콘서트，巡演收官场，最催泪）.en: The last show (마지막 콘서트, the final concert of the tour, the most emotional)

因为是收官场大家都哭了。.en: Everyone cried because it was the final show.

收官场的票更难抢。.en: Tickets for the final show are even harder to get.

首场演唱会（첫 콘서트，巡演开场场次）.en: The first concert (첫 콘서트, the opening show of the tour)

首场气氛就很火热。.en: The atmosphere was already heated at the first show.

好奇首场的歌单。.en: I'm curious about the setlist for the first show.

歌单、曲目表（setlist，简称세트리，当场表演的曲目顺序）.en: Setlist (the order of songs performed at a show)

歌单里名曲全都有。.en: All the famous songs are on the setlist.

我不提前看歌单，讨厌剧透。.en: I don't look at the setlist in advance; I hate spoilers.

直拍（粉丝对着一个成员单独拍的现场视频）.en: Fancam (a fan-taken video focusing on one member during a live performance)

直拍画质真的好。.en: The fancam quality is really good.

本命的直拍一直循环看。.en: I keep watching my bias's fancam on repeat.

谢幕致辞、舞台问候（表演间隙偶像的讲话环节）.en: Ment (the part where idols talk during a performance)

谢幕致辞时我鼻子一酸。.en: I got teary-eyed during the ment.

对视、眼神交流（粉丝最珍视的“和爱豆对上眼”瞬间）.en: Eye contact (the moment fans treasure most—locking eyes with their idol)

今天对上眼了，心脏差点炸。.en: I made eye contact today, and my heart almost exploded.

对视一次就能开心一整天。.en: Just one eye contact can make you happy all day.

粉丝福利、宠粉（fan service，偶像对粉丝的互动招呼，简称팬써）.en: Fan service (interaction with fans, abbreviated as 팬써)

宠粉宠得太好了。.en: The fan service was really good.

给粉丝比了个爱心。.en: Made a heart sign for the fans.

场馆就在地铁站正前方。.en: The venue is right in front of the subway station.

手环（入场发的LED联动手环，随灯光变色）.en: LED wristband (given at entry, changes color with lights)

入场时发了手环。.en: They gave out wristbands at the entrance.

手环随音乐闪烁。.en: The wristbands flash along with the music.

占位子、留座位.en: Save a spot, reserve a seat

我先去占个位子。.en: I'll go save a spot first.

站席占位很激烈。.en: Saving spots in the standing area is intense.

起鸡皮疙瘩（被震撼或感动到，现场高频感叹）.en: Get goosebumps (from being moved or amazed, common at live events)

听了现场直接起鸡皮疙瘩。.en: Listening to it live gave me goosebumps right away.

高音部分听得我起鸡皮疙瘩。.en: The high notes gave me goosebumps.

现场实力真的强。.en: Their live performance skills are really strong.

现场听真的很感动。.en: Listening to it live is really moving.

粉丝席（팬클럽 专属的座位区）.en: fan section (exclusive seating area for the fan club)

粉丝席应援氛围超热烈。.en: The cheering atmosphere in the fan section was super intense.

粉丝席正对着舞台。.en: The fan section is directly facing the stage.

中央区块（중앙 블록 的缩语，正对舞台的黄金视野区）.en: center block (abbreviation of 중앙 블록, the golden view area facing the stage)

中央区视野完美。.en: The view from the center block is perfect.

中央区的位子竞争很激烈。.en: Competition for seats in the center block is fierce.

回归舞台（发新专后的首次现场表演）.en: comeback stage (first live performance after releasing a new album)

我到现场看了回归舞台。.en: I went to see the comeback stage live.

回归舞台的服装好美。.en: The outfits for the comeback stage were so beautiful.

我在那家咖啡店打工。.en: I work part-time at that coffee shop.

放假时在找兼职。.en: I'm looking for a part-time job during the break.

有打工经验吗？.en: Do you have any part-time work experience?

找周末的兼职。.en: Look for a weekend part-time job.

周薪什么时候到账？.en: When does the weekly pay come in?

工资打到账户了。.en: The salary has been deposited into the account.

薪资每月月末发放。.en: Wages are paid at the end of each month.

今天几点开始上班？.en: What time do you start work today?

工作时间是怎样的？.en: What are the working hours like?

工作时间是一天8小时。.en: Working hours are 8 hours a day.

这周的排班出来了吗？.en: Has this week's schedule come out?

几点换班？.en: What time is the shift change?

和下午班的换班。.en: I'm switching with the afternoon shift.

找能上打烊班的人。.en: Looking for someone who can work the closing shift.

明天是开门班所以要早点去。.en: Tomorrow is the opening shift, so I need to go early.

开门准备都做好了吗？.en: Are all the opening preparations done?

今天是打烊班所以下班晚。.en: Today is the closing shift, so I get off work late.

夜间时薪更高。.en: The night shift hourly wage is higher.

这周是夜班。.en: This week is the night shift.

上班；到岗.en: Go to work; report for duty

几点前要到岗？.en: What time do I need to report for duty?

明天不用上班。.en: I don't have to go to work tomorrow.

几点下班？.en: What time do you get off work?

现在可以下班了。.en: You can get off work now.

堵车了，好像会迟到。.en: There's a traffic jam, so I might be late.

迟到的话请联系老板。.en: If you're late, please contact the boss.

老板，有空聊一下吗？.en: Boss, do you have a moment to talk?

老板今天不在。.en: The boss is not in today.

一起工作的同事很亲切。.en: The coworker I work with is very friendly.

拜托了同事。.en: I asked the coworker for a favor.

客人多所以很忙。.en: There are many customers, so it's busy.

客人，要点单吗？.en: Customer, would you like to order?

接待客人最累。.en: Attending to customers is the most tiring.

收银不能出错。.en: The cash register can't make mistakes.

请教我用收银机。.en: Please teach me how to use the cash register.

收银机突然用不了了。.en: The cash register suddenly stopped working.

得整理库存。.en: We need to organize the inventory.

能帮忙上架商品吗？.en: Can you help stock the shelves?

按保质期顺序陈列。.en: Display them in order of expiration date.

工作服在哪里换？.en: Where do you change into work clothes?

明天去面试兼职。.en: I'm going to a part-time job interview tomorrow.

面试时会问什么？.en: What will they ask at the interview?

简历上贴了照片。.en: There's a photo attached to the resume.

应聘了咖啡店兼职。.en: I applied for a part-time job at a coffee shop.

第一天接受培训。.en: Receive training on the first day.

培训期时薪较低。.en: The hourly wage is lower during the training period.

向下一个人做了交接。.en: Did a handover to the next person.

今天能帮我顶班吗？.en: Can you cover my shift today?

生病了所以找人替班。.en: I got sick, so I found someone to cover my shift.

打算做到这个月就辞职。.en: I plan to quit after this month.

抱歉，我做到这个月就辞职。.en: Sorry, I'll resign after this month.

因个人原因我要辞职。.en: I'm going to resign for personal reasons.

每周15小时以上可以领周休津贴。.en: You can receive the weekly rest allowance if you work 15 hours or more per week.

周休津贴也一定要争取。.en: You must also claim the weekly rest allowance.

一定要签劳动合同。.en: You must sign an employment contract.

请给我一份劳动合同。.en: Please give me an employment contract.

试用期是一个月。.en: The probation period is one month.

试用期时薪稍低。.en: The hourly wage during the probation period is a bit lower.

今天不忙太好了。.en: It's good that it's not busy today.

上视频课很难集中。.en: It's hard to concentrate during a video lesson.

点链接就能进去。.en: Click the link and you can enter.

连不上网。.en: I can't connect to the internet.

摄像头画面很模糊。.en: The camera image is very blurry.

画面看得清吗？.en: Can you see the screen clearly?

下周有发表。.en: There is a presentation next week.

发表资料都准备好了吗？.en: Are the presentation materials all ready?

问题请写在聊天框里。.en: Please write your question in the chat box.

把链接发到聊天框了。.en: I sent the link in the chat box.

在课程下用评论提问了。.en: I asked a question using the comment under the lesson.

我用评论回复您。.en: I'll reply to you via comment.

没听到的部分用回看看。.en: Use the replay to catch the parts you missed.

回看什么时候上传？.en: When will the replay be uploaded?

作业用邮件交了。.en: I submitted the assignment by email.

作业还没交。.en: I haven't submitted the assignment yet.

得在今天之前提交。.en: I have to submit it before today.

因为连接不稳声音断断续续。.en: The sound keeps cutting out because of the unstable connection.

画面卡住翻不过去。.en: The screen is stuck and won't turn.

老卡顿真让人着急。.en: The constant lag is really frustrating.

我的声音听得清吗？.en: Can you hear my voice clearly?

字太小看不清。.en: The letters are too small to read.

音质不太好。.en: The sound quality isn't very good.

用耳机的话音质会好些。.en: The sound quality will be better with headphones.

耳机只有一边有声音。.en: Only one side of the headphones has sound.

有问题请举手。.en: If you have a question, please raise your hand.

有问题请按举手。.en: If you have a question, please press the raise hand button.

用举手申请发言了。.en: I raised my hand to ask to speak.

分到讨论室里讨论。.en: We were assigned to a breakout room to discuss.

在讨论室里准备小组发表。.en: We prepared the group presentation in the breakout room.

这次小组作业主题是什么？.en: What is the topic of this group assignment?

为了小组作业开会。.en: We had a meeting for the group assignment.

给教授发了邮件。.en: I sent an email to the professor.

听课学生超过一百人。.en: There are over a hundred students enrolled in the course.

确认学员名单。.en: Check the list of enrolled students.

在家很难集中。.en: It's hard to concentrate at home.

下午的课太困了。.en: The afternoon class was so boring I felt sleepy.

预习了理解起来就容易。.en: If you preview, it's easier to understand.

掉线了所以重新进来了。.en: I got disconnected, so I came back in.

课堂里还没人。.en: No one is in the classroom yet.

图书馆几点关门？.en: What time does the library close?

阅览室在3楼。.en: The reading room is on the 3rd floor.

阅览室里要保持安静。.en: Keep quiet in the reading room.

自习室没座位了。.en: There are no seats left in the study room.

自习室24小时开放。.en: The study room is open 24 hours.

座位预约用App做。.en: Seat reservations are made through the app.

不预约座位就进不去。.en: You can't get in without reserving a seat.

取号；出票（座位）.en: Take a number; issue a ticket (for a seat)

请在入口处取号。.en: Please take a number at the entrance.

取号的座位号是多少？.en: What is the seat number from the ticket?

刷学生证进去。.en: Swipe your student ID to get in.

没带学生证。.en: I didn't bring my student ID.

请把出入证贴到闸机上。.en: Please tap your access card on the gate.

借书在哪里办？.en: Where do I go to borrow books?

一次可以借五本。.en: You can borrow up to five books at a time.

还书截止到什么时候？.en: What is the deadline for returning books?

还书在1楼的机器上办。.en: Return books at the machine on the first floor.

借阅期可以续借吗？.en: Can I renew the borrowing period?

逾期就没法借书了。.en: If it's overdue, you can't borrow books.

滞纳金是多少？.en: How much is the late fee?

用志愿时间代替滞纳金。.en: Use volunteer hours instead of the late fee.

我来查一下图书。.en: Let me look up the book.

这本书正在被借出。.en: This book is currently checked out.

在书架上找到了书。.en: I found the book on the shelf.

这本书在哪个书架？.en: Which shelf is this book on?

看索书号找书。.en: Look up the book by its call number.

贴着索书号。.en: It's labeled with the call number.

在检索台确认书的位置。.en: Check the book's location at the search terminal.

检索台在那边。.en: The search terminal is over there.

因为噪音没法集中。.en: I can't concentrate because of the noise.

手机请调成振动。.en: Please set your phone to vibrate.

通话；打电话.en: Phone call; to make a call

这里不能打电话。.en: You can't make phone calls here.

用包占了座位。.en: I saved a seat with my bag.

占好座去吃饭了。.en: I saved a seat and went to eat.

离座；空出座位.en: Leave a seat; vacate a seat

不能长时间离座。.en: You can't leave your seat for a long time.

暂时离开了一下座位。.en: I stepped away from my seat for a moment.

用笔记本的座位是分开的。.en: The seats for using a laptop are separate.

想给手机充个电。.en: I want to charge my phone.

在图书馆容易集中。.en: It's easy to concentrate in the library.

因为安静所以很专注。.en: Because it's quiet, I'm very focused.

因为是考试期间没座位。.en: There are no seats because it's exam period.

考试期间通宵学习。.en: I study all night during exam period.

旧报纸在资料室。.en: The old newspapers are in the reference room.

资料室的东西不能外借。.en: Items in the reference room cannot be borrowed.

想打印资料。.en: I want to print the materials.

打印一张多少钱？.en: How much is it to print one page?

闭馆后请放进还书箱。.en: Please put it in the book return box after closing.

还书箱在正门旁边。.en: The book return box is next to the main entrance.

不好意思，请安静一点。.en: Excuse me, please be a little quieter.

专注座有隔板。.en: The focus seat has a divider.

在专注座学习很舒服。.en: It's comfortable studying in the focus seat.

有隔板所以很有安全感。.en: Having a divider makes me feel secure.

在休息室歇一会儿。.en: Take a break in the lounge.

食物请在休息室吃。.en: Please eat your food in the lounge.

这个条件很难接受。.en: It's hard to accept this condition.

能稍微调整一下条件吗？.en: Could you adjust the conditions a bit?

正在协调双方立场。.en: We are coordinating the positions of both sides.

就这一条款向您咨询。.en: I am consulting you about this clause.

整理好了需要修改的地方。.en: I've organized the parts that need revision.

修改后再发给您。.en: I'll send it to you after revising it.

可以向您提出修改请求吗？.en: May I make a request for revision?

我们会采纳修改请求。.en: We will accept the modification request.

能赶上交货期吗？.en: Can we meet the delivery date?

交货期太紧了。.en: The delivery date is too tight.

我们下周前交货。.en: We will deliver by next week.

交货延迟了一天。.en: The delivery was delayed by one day.

能稍微延长一下期限吗？.en: Can we extend the deadline a bit?

我们会在期限内处理。.en: We will handle it within the deadline.

能稍微降低一下单价吗？.en: Can we lower the unit price a bit?

单价比预想的高。.en: The unit price is higher than expected.

能把报价单发给我吗？.en: Can you send me the quotation?

大量订购时能打折吗？.en: Can I get a discount for ordering in bulk?

我想提一个建议。.en: I'd like to make a suggestion.

感谢您的好建议。.en: Thank you for your good suggestion.

我建议这样推进。.en: I suggest we proceed this way.

审阅后给您答复。.en: We'll get back to you after the review.

我会仔细审阅提案书。.en: I will carefully review the proposal.

我们把协议内容形成书面。.en: Let's put the agreement in writing.

双方各让一步比较好。.en: It's better for both sides to give a little.

这部分很难妥协。.en: This part is hard to compromise on.

在价格方面我们让步。.en: We'll make a concession on the price.

不能再让步了。.en: We can't make any more concessions.

违约会产生违约金。.en: A breach of contract will incur a penalty.

如需解约请提前通知。.en: Please give notice in advance if you need to cancel.

中途解约有违约金。.en: There is a penalty for early cancellation.

合同再续签一年。.en: Renew the contract for another year.

续约条件不变。.en: The renewal terms remain the same.

需要签名或盖章。.en: A signature or seal is required.

请求协调一下日程。.en: Please request an adjustment to the schedule.

可以请求协调交货期吗？.en: Can I request to coordinate the delivery date?

我没有决定权。.en: I don't have the decision-making authority.

决定权在组长那里。.en: The decision-making authority lies with the team leader.

要获批才能推进。.en: We can only proceed after getting approval.

审批还没下来。.en: The approval hasn't come through yet.

整理好审阅意见后发给您。.en: I'll organize the review comments and send them to you.

感谢您给出的审阅意见。.en: Thank you for your review comments.

若能考虑我方立场，将不胜感激。.en: I would greatly appreciate it if you could consider our position.

目前还有立场分歧。.en: There is still a difference in position.

我们会逐步缩小立场分歧。.en: We will gradually narrow the differences in our positions.

这部分需要重新审阅。.en: This part needs to be reviewed.

重新审阅后再回复您。.en: I'll get back to you after reviewing it.

会尽快给您回复。.en: I'll get back to you as soon as possible.

请先把合同草案发给我。.en: Please send me the contract draft first.

以草案为基础展开讨论。.en: Let's discuss based on the draft.

很难接受这些条件。.en: It's hard to accept these conditions.

很遗憾，这次只能拒绝。.en: Unfortunately, I can only decline this time.

只想避免谈崩。.en: Just want to avoid a breakdown.

我们尽量满足条件。.en: We'll try our best to meet the conditions.

很难满足那个条件。.en: It's hard to meet that condition.

我们朝双赢的方向走吧。.en: Let's go in a win-win direction.

双赢是最理想的。.en: A win-win is the most ideal.

我来汇报一下进展情况。.en: Let me report on the progress.

把结果向组长汇报了。.en: I reported the results to the team leader.

我来汇报业绩。.en: Let me report on the performance.

演示准备都完成了。.en: All preparations for the presentation are done.

介绍下一位发言人。.en: Let me introduce the next speaker.

我把资料投到屏幕上。.en: I'll put the materials on the screen.

资料已用邮件分享给大家。.en: The materials have been shared via email.

从这一页开始说明。.en: I'll explain starting from this page.

把页面顺序稍微调整了。.en: I adjusted the page order a bit.

基于数据来说明。.en: I'll explain based on the data.

数据有点旧了。.en: The data is a bit old.

看这张图表就能了解趋势。.en: You can see the trend from this chart.

图表呈上升趋势。.en: The chart shows an upward trend.

数值比上一季度上升了。.en: The value increased compared to last quarter.

同比呈增长趋势。.en: It shows an increasing trend year-over-year.

用户数在减少。.en: The number of users is decreasing.

我来说明整体趋势。.en: Let me explain the overall trend.

用比例来看更容易理解。.en: It's easier to understand when you look at the ratio.

我只把要点总结一下。.en: I'll just summarize the key points.

最后做个总结。.en: Let me wrap up with a summary.

结论是建议引入。.en: The conclusion is to suggest introducing it.

只点一下重点就过去。.en: Just briefly touch on the key points and move on.

现在进入问答环节。.en: Now we'll move to the Q&A session.

问答在演示后进行。.en: The Q&A will take place after the presentation.

有问题请提出来。.en: If you have any questions, please ask.

感谢您的好问题。.en: Thank you for your great question.

那部分我确认后再答复。.en: I'll confirm that part and then reply.

再补充说明一点。.en: Let me add one more point of explanation.

我尤其想强调这一点。.en: I especially want to emphasize this point.

我来说明主要指标。.en: Let me explain the main indicators.

这个指标最重要。.en: This indicator is the most important.

第三季度销售额最高。.en: Sales were highest in the third quarter.

我来说明下季度计划。.en: Let me explain next quarter's plan.

同比没有大的变化。.en: There is no big change year-on-year.

详细内容请参考附件资料。.en: Please refer to the attached materials for details.

我把报告书作为附件发给您。.en: I am sending you the report as an attachment.

顺便说一下，预算很充足。.en: By the way, the budget is sufficient.

到这里能理解吗？.en: Do you understand up to this point?

如果不理解我再说明。.en: If you don't understand, I'll explain again.

我做一点补充说明。.en: Let me add a supplementary explanation.

需要补充说明请告诉我。.en: Please let me know if you need additional explanation.

演示资料已提前分发。.en: The presentation materials have been distributed in advance.

请看演示资料的最后一页。.en: Please look at the last page of the presentation materials.

演示前做了彩排。.en: We did a rehearsal before the presentation.

彩排时计了时。.en: We timed it during the rehearsal.

演示时间；汇报时长.en: Presentation time; duration of the briefing

演示前有点紧张。.en: I was a bit nervous before the presentation.

紧张得声音发抖。.en: My voice was trembling with nervousness.

给我反馈的话我会采纳。.en: If you give me feedback, I will take it into account.

感谢您的宝贵反馈。.en: Thank you for your valuable feedback.

我今天内提交报告书。.en: I will submit the report within today.

报告书初稿完成了。.en: The first draft of the report is done.

最后说几句收尾。.en: Let me say a few words to wrap up.

大家一直聆听到最后。.en: Everyone listened until the very end.

（翻页）过去；进入下一部分.en: (Turn the page) Move on; go to the next part

进入下一个主题。.en: Let's move on to the next topic.

总结来说是三个结论。.en: In summary, there are three conclusions.

和客户约好了会议。.en: I have a meeting scheduled with the client.

想和负责人通话。.en: I'd like to speak with the person in charge.

这件事由我负责。.en: I am in charge of this matter.

能把需求整理后发给我吗？.en: Could you send me the requirements after organizing them?

发送您所请求的资料。.en: I will send the materials you requested.

有额外请求请告诉我。.en: Please let me know if you have any additional requests.

再次向您索要资料。.en: Asking you for the materials again.

我们会尽量采纳反馈。.en: We will try to incorporate the feedback.

意见会体现在下一版本。.en: The opinions will be reflected in the next version.

已采纳了要求事项。.en: The requested items have been adopted.

看来得重新安排日程。.en: Looks like we need to reschedule.

会按日程推进。.en: We will proceed according to the schedule.

需要协调日程。.en: We need to coordinate the schedule.

日程协调请通过邮件进行。.en: Please coordinate the schedule via email.

截止日能推迟两天吗？.en: Can the deadline be postponed by two days?

交付日是本月底。.en: The delivery date is the end of this month.

一定按交付日完成。.en: We will definitely complete it by the delivery date.

我把报价单发给您。.en: I will send you the quotation.

您一确认我们就推进。.en: We'll proceed as soon as you confirm.

日程确定后请告诉我。.en: Please let me know once the schedule is confirmed.

最终方案敲定了。.en: The final plan has been decided.

修改事项；需要改的地方.en: Items to be modified; things that need to be changed

请把修改事项整理后发来。.en: Please organize the modifications and send them over.

修改事项有三处。.en: There are three items to be modified.

会完善不足的部分。.en: I will make up for the shortcomings.

请告知需要改进的地方。.en: Please let me know what needs to be improved.

恳请您审阅。.en: I humbly ask you to review it.

再次恳请您确认。.en: I humbly ask you to confirm once more.

我把资料发给您。.en: I am sending you the materials.

我会把内容转达给负责人。.en: I will convey the content to the person in charge.

有咨询随时联系我。.en: If you have any inquiries, feel free to contact me anytime.

有一件事想向您咨询。.en: There's something I'd like to ask you.

下周约个会议。.en: Let's schedule a meeting next week.

想协调一下会议时间。.en: I'd like to coordinate the meeting time.

会面周二下午如何？.en: How about meeting on Tuesday afternoon?

确认后回复您。.en: I'll confirm and get back to you.

想了解一下进度。.en: I'd like to check on the progress.

可以进入下一步吗？.en: Can we move to the next step?

若能告知是否可行将不胜感激。.en: I would appreciate it if you could let me know if it's feasible.

我们内部确认是否可行。.en: We'll internally confirm whether it's feasible.

想明确一下作业范围。.en: I'd like to clarify the scope of work.

（客户）对结果很满意。.en: The customer is very satisfied with the result.

会修改到您满意为止。.en: I will revise it until you are satisfied.

会迅速处理不满事项。.en: We will handle the complaint promptly.

给您添麻烦，向您道歉。.en: I apologize for the trouble I caused you.

恳请您谅解。.en: I sincerely ask for your understanding.

请说说您无法接受的地方。.en: Please tell me what you can't accept.

不辜负期待；达到期望.en: meet expectations; live up to expectations

会努力不辜负您的期待。.en: I will work hard to live up to your expectations.

每周五做中期汇报。.en: We give the interim report every Friday.

先编写需求定义书。.en: First, write the requirements definition document.

请在需求定义书上签字。.en: Please sign the requirements definition document.

再次向您确认日程。.en: Let me reconfirm the schedule with you.

能麻烦您再次确认数量吗？.en: Could you please double-check the quantity?

会确保日程不出差错。.en: I'll make sure there are no mistakes in the schedule.

出了差错，很抱歉。.en: There was a mistake. I'm sorry.
